Reading them together makes the direction of the transfer the salient variable.; `self-authored-construct-leverage` — two answers to the same design goal of making compliance feel self-driven, separated by whether the authorship is real. One hands over a decision or motive that changes nothing about the outcome; the other lets the listener actually supply the loaded content. Reading them together is how a user picks correctly.; `self-supplied-gap-directive` — both make the payload read as the subject's own product, but by different routes: A leaves a linguistic hole the hearer must fill, B hands over a decision or motive that was never really theirs. A reader choosing between them benefits from the contrast, since the tell is whether anything is missing from the surface or whether a fake agency is supplied.; `unattributable-cause-severing` — both operate on perceived authorship of cause, one by severing every outcome from any locatable operator move, the other by handing the subject a fake decision or motive so compliance reads as self-produced. Erasing the cause and assigning it to the subject are the two directions of one design question.


<a id="entry-398"></a>

### linguistic-deletion-selfsupply

[#398](#entry-398) · [Back to compliance-relabeled-as-choice](#genus-154) · [Contents](#contents)

*risk: low · family: encoding*

A family of Ericksonian linguistic moves that delete or nominalize obligatory content so the listener must supply the missing referent from their own current experience to make the utterance cohere. Realized by dropping a required grammatical argument (who/what), freezing an experiential process into a referent-less noun the hearer must re-run, or asserting an unobservable inner state with no evidence trail. Because self-generated content is not audited the way an external claim is, the listener pre-accepts the supplied meaning as their own and the operator gains coverage over — and paces — inner states he cannot see.


**When to reach for this.** A writer reaches for this entry when the operator's utterance is missing content that grammar or sense obliges — the who and what of the wondering deleted, an experiential process frozen into a noun with no referential index, or an inner state claimed 'without specifying the process by which he has secured that information' — so a listener already motivated to extract meaning must fill the gap from their own current experience to make the utterance cohere. The observable tell is that the specifics that land were never spoken: a required grammatical role or referent is absent from the transcript and the listener authors it, whether the surface structure comes out well-formed or ungrammatical (Erickson uses both). Because self-generated content bypasses the audit an external claim would receive, the operator gains pacing coverage over inner states he cannot see.


**Risk.** Session-scoped linguistic pacing device, reversible, no consent surface — the covert self-supply is the influence lever but carries no durable scope or channel erosion on its own.


**Why it works.** Self-generated content escapes the scrutiny applied to external claims: material a person produces themselves is encoded more deeply and rated as more true (the generation effect and the self-generated-persuasion finding that arguments one produces oneself shift attitudes more than identical arguments received). Deleting an obligatory argument forces the listener to complete the utterance from their own current experience, so the resulting proposition arrives already self-authored. The falsifiable prediction: content the listener supplies should be accepted and retained more readily than the same content stated outright — if matched explicit statements produced equal or greater acceptance, the account fails. [plausible; generation effect; self-generated persuasion; Barnum/self-relevant completion]


**Worked examples.**

- *The missing who and what left blank*
  - "who is doing the wondering and what that unmentioned person is wondering is not specified; those portions of the meaning have been deleted. This leaves the information which is missing to be filled in by the listener." — Bandler & Grinder (1975), Patterns of the Hypnotic Techniques of Milton H. Erickson, Vol. I
- *Claiming an inner state with no source*
  - "claiming to have knowledge of the internal, non-observable experience of the client without specifying the process by which he has secured that information" — Bandler & Grinder (1975), Patterns of the Hypnotic Techniques of Milton H. Erickson, Vol. I
- *Nominalizations that invite the listener's projection*
  - "Since it has no referential index, such a nominal invites projections or hallucinations on the part of the listener." — Bandler & Grinder (1975), Patterns of the Hypnotic Techniques of Milton H. Erickson, Vol. I
- *Grammatical and ungrammatical gaps both used*
  - "Some forms of deletion leave the resultant Surface Structure well formed… Other deletions result in ungrammatical sentences. Erickson uses both." — Bandler & Grinder (1975), Patterns of the Hypnotic Techniques of Milton H. Erickson, Vol. I


**See also.** `inner-voice-authorship-bypass` — adjacent authorship moves: one re-attributes the operator's own words to the listener's inner voice, the other deletes obligatory content so the listener must supply the referent themselves. The gap-versus-no-gap contrast is the whole distinction.; `minimal-constraint-permissive-suggestion` — explicit siblings: one deletes obligatory content the listener must reconstruct, the other states the wanted response and leaves only its boundaries and modality open. Each discriminator already works to fend off the other, which is precisely when a reader benefits from having both in view.; `minimal-stimulus-self-supplied-response` — one lever, two omitted objects. One describes a near-null or referent-less stimulus so any felt response must be self-originated; the other deletes an obligatory grammatical role so the missing referent must be self-supplied. Both make the listener author the content and both gain deniability from it, so a reader choosing between them wants to see the pair.


<a id="entry-126"></a>

### operator-agency-disavowal

[#126](#entry-126) · [Back to compliance-relabeled-as-choice](#genus-154) · [Contents](#contents)

*risk: medium · family: authorship-shift*

Before or during entry the operator relocates causal agency away from themselves and onto the subject: denies any external force is applied ("there is no such thing as a hypnotist; you do it to yourself"), or reframes basic acts (hearing, relaxing, getting comfortable) as things that "happen on their own", or redefines hypnosis as an ordinary self-generated focus needing no operator control. With no adversary present, the subject's resistance loses its target and relaxes; compliance is pre-attributed to the listener's own nature rather than experienced as yielding, and skepticism is spent by agreeing with it before it can be deployed.


**When to reach for this.** Relocates authorship of the trance state/agency onto the SUBJECT so resistance has no target — by two convergent routes: (a) operator SELF-DISAVOWAL — asserting the operator wields no power / does nothing ('there is no such thing as a hypnotist; you do it to yourself'), reframing basic acts as happening on their own; and (b) STATE-ASSERTION — claiming the state is already-completed ('you've already been hypnotized this whole time', onset relocated into the past, unfalsifiable from inside) or the subject's own authored creation ('you made it, so it's real', 'you decide how deep') while operator steering is quietly preserved. Direction is the tell: a control-transfer hands agency TO the operator, and a direct authority claim asserts the operator's power — this move asserts the operator's absence and pushes agency onto the subject, keeping it there while steering quietly continues.


**Risk.** Session-scoped agency reframe; reversible, no durable scope, disarms adversarial guard rather than eroding an explicit refusal channel.


**Why it works.** Resistance is a response to perceived pressure on one's freedom; asserting that no one is exerting any leaves the reactance without an object, and the listener attributes any resulting compliance to their own disposition rather than to influence. Self-attributed behaviour is then held more firmly than behaviour explained by an external cause. Falsifiable: if disavowal framing produced the same or more resistance than an overt-control framing, the reactance account is wrong; if compliance occurred but was still attributed to the operator, the self-perception half is wrong. [plausible; psychological reactance; self-perception theory; overjustification]


**Worked examples.**

- *Basic acts reframed as happening on their own*
  - **Setup.** The very opening, before any relaxation content; subject is still fully awake and possibly guarded.
  - **The move.** I could ask you to settle in, but there's no point — that sorts itself out. I could ask you to listen, except nobody decides to hear a voice. It just arrives. So there's nothing for you to do here, and nothing for you to get wrong.
  - **Why it lands.** Before any relaxation content, the operator disclaims the asking itself: she could tell the listener to settle in, but there is no point, because that sorts itself out. She would ask them to listen, except that hearing is not something anyone does on purpose — nobody decides to hear a voice, it simply arrives. Nothing is being requested of the listener, so there is no effort to fail at, and nothing being done to them to brace against.
- *Redefining the state as ordinary self-generated focus*
  - **Setup.** First minute of the recording, before anything that looks like an induction; skeptical listener assumed.
  - **The move.** This isn't something I do to you. People fall into this by themselves all day — driving a familiar road, halfway through a book — it's nothing but attention narrowed to one point. Nobody is being acted on here, least of all by me.
  - **Why it lands.** Before anything that looks like an induction, the operator spends a minute insisting the process is unremarkable and unowned: people arrive at this state by themselves all the time, it is nothing but attention drawn to a narrow point, and no one is being acted upon. The listener's guardedness is spent by being conceded rather than opposed — there is no adversary in the room to brace against — and the suggestions begin against a vigilance that has been left without a target.
- *The operator denies holding any power*
  - "all you can ever do is to show a patient how to go over the hurdle... You won't hypnotize him; he will hypnotize himself." — Elman (1964), Hypnotherapy


**Realizations** (1): `retroactive-self-authored-state-assertion`


**See also.** `authority-diffusion-plurality` — both remove the operator as a target for resistance — one by denying the operator does anything and relocating authorship onto the subject, the other by dissolving the authority surface into plurality, peerhood, or feigned parity. Same goal state, different means; a writer picking an anti-resistance strategy benefits from seeing both.; `blank-then-authorship-handoff` — both relocate authorship of what is happening away from the operator, and both leave resistance without a target. One asserts the operator's absence and pushes agency to the subject; the other blanks the listener's own stream and reassigns authorship of mental content. Close enough to mis-file.; `compliance-authorship-laundering` — both relocate agency onto the listener so resistance has no target. One relabels a compliance act or constraint as the listener's own will or preference; the other denies the operator applies any force at all. Act-level attribution versus operator self-disavowal.; `consent-term-redefinition-smuggle` — both remove the target resistance would push against by reassigning what the state is or who caused it: one asserts the operator does nothing and the listener authored the state, the other relabels a threatening state-word onto experience the listener already owns. Adjacent pre-emptive framings a writer chooses between.; `disavowal-and-masking` — both disarm vigilance by removing the acknowledged act to refuse, but one conceals or denies that any operation is running at all while the other admits the process and relocates its causal agency onto the subject.; `felt-sense-demotion` — complementary preparations of the same skeptical listener: removing the operator as a target for resistance, and demoting the listener's felt sense as an evidence channel so absence of effect cannot disconfirm. They are commonly delivered together in openers, and each closes a route the other leaves open.; `fixation-object-agency-displacement` — two destinations for the same relocation. Agency for the trance is moved off the self either onto an operator-controlled artifact or onto the listener themselves, and in both cases resistance loses a target. Anyone classifying an agency-displacement passage has to choose between these two, so the pairing is a real disambiguation aid.; `impersonal-mechanism-alibi` — both relocate authority away from the contestable operator, in opposite directions: onto the subject's own nature, or onto an impersonal unfalsifiable thing. Reading them together clarifies that the shared move is removing a target for resistance, and the choice is where the agency lands.; `inner-voice-authorship-bypass` — two different guards disarmed by the same relocation of authorship onto the listener: one denies the operator any causal role so resistance to the state has no target, the other makes the operator's words feel self-generated so the 'this is being said to me' guard never engages.; `presupposed-completion-fait-accompli` — these genuinely overlap at one edge: the already-completed state assertion appears in both, so a reader can land on either from the same line of text. The payloads differ enough to keep them apart. One relocates agency onto the subject so resistance has no target while steering quietly continues; the other deletes the decision point by asserting the target as already true. Cross-link, do not merge.; `protective-role-conscription` — both defuse resistance by removing the thing resistance would push against - one by asserting no operator force is being applied and relocating agency onto the subject, the other by assigning the listener a scene-role of non-participation. Different vehicles, same target-removal logic, and a reader analysing a resistance-defusing opening should weigh both.; `state-cause-laundering` — both move causal attribution away from the operator while steering continues, but one denies the operator exists or acts at all so resistance has no target, while the other leaves the operator in place and supplies a benign false cause for a state already running.; `unattributable-cause-severing` — convergent goal by different routes: both leave the subject's resistance with nothing to push against, one by explicitly disavowing that the operator does anything and pushing agency onto the subject, the other by hiding each move inside an innocuous act so no outcome can be traced to a cause. Declared absence versus concealed causation.


<a id="entry-1225"></a>

### wish-routing-acceptance-preload

[#1225](#entry-1225) · [Back to compliance-relabeled-as-choice](#genus-154) · [Contents](#contents)

*risk: low · family: conditioning*

The operator selects a suggestion the subject already actively craves and phrases it as the exact words the subject is anxious to hear, often echoing a wish held below conscious awareness. Because the message names something the subject already wants, acceptance is pre-loaded and the subject meets the suggestion halfway; resistance never engages because nothing in the message is opposed to them, and the subject supplies the conviction themselves. It fails wherever the underlying want is simply absent — the deciding tell.


**When to reach for this.** This is the SELECTION and PHRASING of a wanted suggestion, not any valence reframe.


**Risk.** Acceptance-facilitation via pre-existing desire; session-scoped, no channel erosion or durable identity scope. Literature source (Elman), demonstrated.


**Why it works.** Motivated reasoning is the mechanism: people apply markedly less scrutiny to propositions they want to be true, demanding "can I believe this?" rather than "must I believe this?", so a suggestion naming a pre-existing desire passes evaluation cheaply. Because the subject supplies the motivational content themselves, there is also no external position to resist, so reactance never engages. The technique's own stated failure condition is what makes it falsifiable and unusually honest — it predicts near-zero effect where the underlying want is absent, which is directly testable by pre-screening desire and comparing response rates. [established; motivated reasoning / asymmetric standards of evidence; absence of a resisted position]


**Worked examples.**

- *Say the words the subject already craves*
  - "Let the patient hear those words which he is anxious to hear… I was really echoing what you have been thinking below the level of conscious awareness." — Elman (1964), Hypnotherapy


**See also.** `filter-shaping-pre-qualification` — two ways to make a suggestion pass an intact acceptability filter: one shapes each suggestion to be pre-qualified as agreeable, the other selects a suggestion the listener already craves and phrases it as the words they want to hear. Shaping versus selection, and the second fails outright when the want is absent.; `own-desire-attribution` — complementary halves of making compliance read as the subject's own wanting: one relocates the desire inside a subject who did not hold it, the other selects and phrases a suggestion around a want already present. The deciding tell is whether the want pre-exists, so a reader needs both to pick.; `presupposed-completion-fait-accompli` — both remove the juncture at which a listener could decline, because nothing in the message is presented as opposed to them. One declares the target already settled so refusal would mean disputing one's own biography; the other selects a suggestion the listener already craves so acceptance is pre-loaded. Complementary ways to make a suggestion non-oppositional.; `subject-material-utilization` — both work by applying no counter-force, but the source of the free ride differs: one re-aims material the subject has volunteered, the other selects a suggestion the subject already wants to hear. Close enough in operator stance that the discriminating question -- volunteered material versus pre-existing want -- is worth stating.


<a id="genus-233"></a>

## concealed-causation (3)

Engineer every effect so its cause can't be located or reviewed, leaving changes to register as the listener's own with nothing to resist.

[covert-role-frame-accretion](#entry-610) · [sealed-edit-buffer-space](#entry-1259) · [unattributable-cause-severing](#entry-556)


<a id="entry-610"></a>

### covert-role-frame-accretion

[#610](#entry-610) · [Back to concealed-causation](#genus-233) · [Contents](#contents)

*risk: high · consent-required · bounded · family: social-topology · kind: container*

Construct the relational frame across the whole arc by TRAJECTORY with NO declarative moment — no single line declares or negotiates it — so the frame is built in-trance and revealed (or simply operative) near the end, past the point the listener can evaluate the assignment critically. VARIANTS by which element drifts: (a) operator role-title accretion [covert-role-frame-accretion] — the operator's self-reference accretes from neutral ('I'/'my voice') through intermediate claims ('my will'/'my mind possesses your mind') to an explicit title ('your Master') late, after the listener has passed convincers/fractionation/amnesia-rehearsal/pleasure-conditioning; (b) grammatical-person migration [pronoun-migration-conscription] — the grammatical center of gravity drifts from we/you (a chorus addressing the target) through a triple-stacked teaching register ('I think what I'm told / We think what we're told / You'll think what you're told') into a first-person 'I' who has joined the chorus, walking the listener from object-of-address to member-of-we to converted-I with no 'become one of us' command; (c) cohort-to-dyad narrowing [cohort-to-dyad-narrowing] — the group/cohort frame that justified the listener's presence and lowered defenses is dissolved ~60 lines later and all attention transferred to the operator-as-singular ('I am your everything'), the narrowing disguised as a discovery the listener makes rather than a switch thrown. Pick by what is covertly restructured (operator's role-title / listener's grammatical membership / the group's very existence).


**When to reach for this.** Covert, gradual INSTALLATION of a relational frame with no declarative moment — the tell is a trajectory (accretion/migration/dissolution) across the arc, with any visible seam (a title's first appearance, a triple-stack, a narrowing beat) NOT the carrier.


**Risk.** Installs a durable Dom/sub relational role without a declarative consent moment while the subject is past the convincers and cannot evaluate it, eroding the negotiation/ refusal channel around role assignment.


**Why it works.** Small increments each fall inside the listener's latitude of acceptance, so no step triggers the rejection that the endpoint would if presented directly — the foot-in-the-door and gradual-escalation pattern, reinforced by consistency pressure since accepting step n makes rejecting step n+1 feel inconsistent. Withholding any declarative moment removes the evaluable decision point at which a person would normally check the frame. Falsifiable: presenting the endpoint frame at the start should produce measurably higher rejection than the accreted route, or the account fails. [established; foot-in-the-door / gradual escalation; latitude of acceptance; consistency principle]


**Worked examples.**

- *Operator title accretes with no declaration*
  - **Setup.** Late in the recording, well past convincers and pleasure conditioning; the title has never previously appeared.
  - **The move.** My will moves through your thinking now, and it always has. [pause, some minutes later] So you rest there, obedient, exactly as your Master wants you. Your Master's voice, your Master's hands, your Master's good thing. And now — up, on five, ready to serve.
  - **Why it lands.** For most of the recording the operator refers to herself in plainly neutral terms — a first person, a voice, nothing more. Well past the point where several convincers have landed, the self-reference thickens: first a possessive claim on the listener's thinking, then, minutes later, a title the listener has never heard before and never agreed to, dropped in as though it had always been in use and then repeated through the closing block. The wake-up exits on a line about being ready to serve, which only parses if someone is being served. No line anywhere declares the arrangement or asks for it; by the time the title first surfaces, the listener is in no position to evaluate a role assignment.


**Realizations** (2): `cohort-to-dyad-narrowing`, `pronoun-migration-conscription`


**See also.** `arc-ordering-dependency` — both are whole-arc structural moves invisible from inside any single passage: one schedules dependencies so later costly asks land pre-supported, the other builds a relational frame by drift with no declarative moment.; `covert-frame-entry` — both install a relational frame the listener never gets to evaluate. One hides it at the door behind a false benign premise; the other builds it by drift across the arc with no declarative moment. Choosing between concealment at entry and concealment by trajectory is a real design decision.; `covert-install-under-cover` — both conceal, and the distinction is worth stating: one hides the construction of a relational frame across a whole arc with no declarative moment, the other hides a discrete install act behind a cover task or disguise.; `flat-surface-concealing-semantic-arc` — both are whole-arc concealment properties and commonly co-occur: a relational frame built by trajectory with no declarative moment, delivered under a uniform surface that hides the accumulating gradient. Each explains why the other goes unnoticed.; `manufacture-then-label-ordering` — both are whole-arc ordering relationships with no declarative moment, and the pre-slotted-identity form of one looks close to the role-accretion form of the other. The cut is whether the arc builds a frame by drift or manufactures a referent and then names it, which is exactly why the reader needs the pointer.; `retroactive-subject-disclosure` — two whole-arc concealment structures that both withhold something evaluable until after commitment is manufactured. One hides how the relational frame was built, disclosing the role only once convincers have landed; the other hides what the session is even about until objecting reads as the predicted symptom. Same timing logic, different withheld quantity.; `voice-ownership-channel-collapse` — both are whole-arc, one-way structural drifts tracked in pronoun trajectory with no declarative moment. They differ in what drifts — the relational role frame versus the ownership of inner speech — but a reader working on covert arc-length installation gains from seeing both topologies.; `withheld-frame-reveal` — both keep the real relational or purpose frame off the table until evaluation is foreclosed, but one cashes an explicitly accepted benign cover for an uncovered payload while the other never declares the frame at all, building it by trajectory so there is no seam to accept or refuse.


<a id="entry-1259"></a>

### sealed-edit-buffer-space

[#1259](#entry-1259) · [Back to concealed-causation](#genus-233) · [Contents](#contents)

*risk: high · consent-required · bounded · family: concealment*

An imaginal venue is declared operator-exclusive (accessible only via her voice), outside conscious memory, and the causal source of waking thoughts and emotions, so any change made there inherits unreviewability and native-feeling attribution; the exclusive-access claim pre-blocks post-session reframing and licenses later sections to bypass critical review.


**When to reach for this.** The declared PROPERTIES of the venue (sealed access, memory exclusion, edits that trickle down and feel native) are the move — vs guided-visualization world-building, and vs a durable internal construct, which is a persistent imaginal object without the concealment/attribution seal.


**Risk.** Out-of-session reach with post-session review pre-blocked — erodes the verification channel by construction.


**Why it works.** Claims about an inaccessible venue cannot be checked, so the ordinary reality-monitoring process that would flag an implanted idea as externally sourced has no evidence to work with — this is source-monitoring failure engineered by construction. Declaring the venue causally upstream of waking thought also pre-supplies an attribution for any later mood or impulse, so normal fluctuations get read as confirmation. It is falsifiable: if subjects told a venue is sealed and memory-excluded show no more misattribution of later suggestions to self-origin than subjects given the same content without the sealing frame, the account fails. [plausible; source-monitoring error; unfalsifiable-claim immunity to disconfirmation]


**Worked examples.**

- *A private room where edits feel native*
  - **Setup.** The listener is already inside a described interior space; the operator establishes its properties before making any change there.
  - **The move.** Now that you're in here, three things about this room. One: there's no door from your side. You only ever get here through my voice.

Two: nothing in here comes back with you. When you wake, you won't have been here.

Three: everything you feel out there in the daylight is decided in this room. And whatever I change on this side won't arrive as a change — it'll feel like it was always that way.
  - **Why it lands.** Once the listener is inside the imagined room, the operator states its rules: you can only get here through my voice; nothing here is carried back into ordinary memory; and everything you feel out there in the daylight is decided in here. Whatever gets changed on this side, she adds, will not arrive as a change at all — it will feel like it has always been the case. The room is thereby declared both consequential and unreviewable before a single edit is made, so any later suggestion arrives pre-shielded from the listener's morning-after audit.


**See also.** `addressable-construct-building` — both erect an interior venue the listener will return to, and one discriminator already contrasts a durable internal construct against a venue whose declared properties are sealed access and native-feeling edits. The pointer helps a reader tell an addressable rehearsal object from a concealment-sealed workspace.; `emptied-window-install` — both manufacture a slot in which content lands without review, differing in how the slot is made. One disables the tools for objecting and then states positive claims into the gap; the other declares a venue sealed, operator-exclusive and outside memory so anything edited there inherits unreviewability. Compare when edits are described as happening somewhere the subject cannot look.


<a id="entry-556"></a>

### unattributable-cause-severing

[#556](#entry-556) · [Back to concealed-causation](#genus-233) · [Contents](#contents)

*risk: medium · consent-required · family: authorship-shift · kind: principle*

A design property in which every operator move is engineered so the subject experiences an outcome but cannot locate its cause — command hidden in a question, depth test in conversation, amnesia probe in discussion, catalepsy in comfortable positioning, awakening in a state-adjustment, hallucination in pantomime, content left for the subject to author, reference deleted for the subject to fill. By severing each outcome from any identifiable operator cause, there is nothing for the subject to attribute control to and therefore nothing to resist; the recurring inexplicably-to-him / at-a-loss-to-understand reactions are the diagnostic signature of the architecture working.


**When to reach for this.** Acts on the SUBJECT by relocating or erasing the authorship-of-cause he can perceive, rather than sliding a state dimension.


**Risk.** Systematically disables the subject's ability to attribute and therefore resist; erodes the resistance channel by design, so it needs an explicit-consent surface even though effects are session-scoped and reversible.


**Why it works.** People decide whether to resist by first identifying an influence attempt; persuasion-knowledge research shows that resistance is triggered by detecting the tactic, not by the tactic's strength, so an outcome with no locatable cause presents nothing to push back against. Severing cause also invites source-monitoring error — the subject, unable to attribute the effect externally, defaults to internal attribution, and self-perception then supplies a belief consistent with the observed behaviour. Falsifiable: making the operator's move explicit should raise reactance and lower compliance relative to the covert version; if the effect were independent of attribution, disclosure would not change response rates. [plausible; persuasion knowledge / reactance; source-monitoring and misattribution]


**Worked examples.**

- *Outcome felt, cause unlocatable*
  - "He did not relate the comfortable positioning of his body to the unobtrusively induced catalepsy" — Bandler & Grinder (1975), Patterns of the Hypnotic Techniques of Milton H. Erickson, Vol. I


**See also.** `attribution-capture-of-internal-states` — both operate on the subject's perception of causation, but one is a whole-work design property (no move has a locatable cause at all) while the other is an executable move that assigns a cause — the operator — to states the listener already had. Useful to read together as the erase-the-cause and claim-the-cause halves of the same axis.; `causal-attribution-to-external-agent` — same attribution lever at two altitudes: one names an external non-consumed cause so volition has nothing to push against, the other is a whole-artifact property where every outcome is severed from any locatable cause. A reader coding an attribution move benefits from knowing whether it is one named agent or the design through-line, and the altitude difference is exactly what the link should flag.; `illusory-choice-authorship` — both operate on perceived authorship of cause, one by severing every outcome from any locatable operator move, the other by handing the subject a fake decision or motive so compliance reads as self-produced. Erasing the cause and assigning it to the subject are the two directions of one design question.; `mechanics-dissociation` — shares the unlocatable-cause axis, where the listener experiences an outcome but cannot find what produced it.; `operator-agency-disavowal` — convergent goal by different routes: both leave the subject's resistance with nothing to push against, one by explicitly disavowing that the operator does anything and pushing agency onto the subject, the other by hiding each move inside an innocuous act so no outcome can be traced to a cause. Declared absence versus concealed causation.; `operator-credit-engineering` — both operate on causal attribution, but one harvests credit for effects onto the operator while the other erases any locatable cause at all so there is nothing to attribute or resist.; `operator-delivery-craft` — both are design-level properties of a whole work rather than executable moves, and both concern concealment, so they sit in the same shelf and get mixed up. The object differs: one severs the subject's ability to locate a cause for what he experiences, the other shapes what the operator transmits on the paralinguistic channel. Subject's attribution versus operator's output is the line a reader needs drawn.; `reader-assent-architecture` — both are non-executable whole-artifact design observations from the same instructional material, and the pair is defined by contrast: A targets the reader's belief that a method is already correct, B targets the subject by severing every outcome from a locatable operator cause. Since they are explicitly framed as siblings, keeping the pointer prevents either from absorbing the other.; `state-cause-laundering` — same lever at two scales: supplying a false benign cause for one running state, versus a whole-arc design in which every outcome is severed from any locatable cause. A reader coding a single misattribution should know whether the surrounding artifact makes it the through-line.


<a id="genus-120"></a>

## concealing-the-install (12)

Memory walls, vaults, and partitions built around installed content so suggestions keep operating without the listener knowing they are there.

[confabulation-amnesia-barrier](#entry-343) · [dissociative-memory-vault](#entry-1022) · [emptied-window-install](#entry-350) · [externalized-agency-testimony](#entry-49) · [fabricated-forgetting-priming](#entry-351) · [identity-clothing-hysteresis](#entry-865) · [install-concealment-amnesia](#entry-355) · [memory-control-demonstration](#entry-941) · [screen-memory](#entry-55) · [selective-amnesia-retained-payload](#entry-363) · [semantic-concept-ablation](#entry-365) · [state-partitioned-amnesia-container](#entry-367)


<a id="entry-343"></a>

### confabulation-amnesia-barrier

[#343](#entry-343) · [Back to concealing-the-install](#genus-120) · [Contents](#contents)

*risk: high · consent-required · bounded · family: amnesia*

Partitions episodic memory by state (a bimbo/whore/alter identity vs the normal self) with mutual or one-directional amnesia across the boundary, AND pre-arms a generative confabulation routine: the normal self is instructed to invent plausible cover stories to smooth over evidence of the gap (clothing, locations, social residue), plus a specific behavioral patch (ignore the clothes, change quickly, dispose of the wardrobe; read clothing as "dressing for some interesting occasion"). Because the alter's activity is un-auditable from both sides and actively defended by generated cover, the trigger is insulated from being noticed, revoked, or examined — the amnesia is made robust to discovery rather than merely brittle.


**When to reach for this.** Amnesia paired with a pre-armed OPEN-ENDED confabulation directive (invent cover stories on demand) that defends the partition from waking scrutiny. A plain forget-suggestion stops at forgetting, and a screen-memory approach installs one fixed replacement memory — here the cover is improvised and open-ended, and the gap is defended by narrative repair rather than by hiding where the install came from. The generative repair routine is the tell.


**Risk.** An un-revokable, discovery-robust alter partition with a self-defending cover routine reaches out-of-session and forecloses the audit channel (high-risk amnesia-suggestion comparator; the confabulation defense raises robustness-against-revocation).


**Why it works.** Rests on confabulation as a normal property of memory: when episodic retrieval fails, people spontaneously generate a plausible narrative to fit the available cues rather than reporting a blank, and they experience the fabrication as recall. Pre-supplying the cover-story habit and a disposal script removes the physical anomalies that would otherwise force the gap into awareness, so no discrepancy accumulates to prompt review. Falsifiable: if subjects reliably reported unexplained gaps and treated residual evidence as anomalous rather than smoothing it, the account fails. [plausible; confabulation and narrative repair on retrieval failure; source-monitoring error]


**Worked examples.**

- *Forget the gap, then invent something to fill it*
  - **Setup.** After a state trigger has been established and rehearsed; subject currently in the installed state, being prepared for the return.
  - **The move.** When you come back to yourself, none of what you were like just now comes with you. And if anything doesn't add up afterwards — the time, the state of the room, why you're where you are — you have my permission to come up with whatever explanation makes it make sense, and to believe it. Your mind is good at that. Let it.
  - **Why it lands.** Two instructions are issued together. The first is ordinary: on returning to normal, the listener will not recall what they were like in the other state. The second is what makes it durable — they are pre-authorized to invent whatever explanations are needed to smooth over anything that does not add up. Plain forgetting is brittle, because the world leaves evidence and evidence prompts questions. Here the listener's own narrative-repair habit is recruited in advance to defend the gap. A weaker version runs the other way too, so the cue stays out of conscious reach until someone speaks it.
- *Paired triggers with mutual amnesia and a supplied excuse*
  - **Setup.** Both state-trigger phrases already installed and tested; setting the boundary before waking.
  - **The move.** The one of you doesn't remember the other. When the second phrase brings you back, the last hour is not yours and the first phrase is not a word you know. And if you catch yourself in the mirror wondering about the outfit, the answer is simple and you'll reach it instantly: you were getting ready for something.
  - **Why it lands.** Two phrases toggle between two named states, and each is defined as unable to recall the other — the audit trail erases itself from both directions. The clause that makes it hold is the pre-supplied explanation: on returning, the listener will account for anything odd about how they are dressed as having got ready for some occasion. Without that line the discrepancies would surface and the partition would collapse on the first look in a mirror.


**See also.** `install-concealment-amnesia` — both make amnesia robust rather than brittle by supplying the subject with an explanation, but one preserves a native-feeling rationale for the behavior while occluding only the install, whereas the other pre-arms an open-ended routine for improvising cover stories about physical evidence of the gap.; `self-sealing-recall-loop` — two ways an amnesia is hardened against the listener's own audit rather than left brittle: one pre-arms an open-ended confabulation routine so waking evidence of the gap gets narratively repaired, the other wires the retrieval act itself to re-fire the forgetting so the gap is never approached — outward defense of the seam versus inward foreclosure of the reach.


<a id="entry-1022"></a>

### dissociative-memory-vault

[#1022](#entry-1022) · [Back to concealing-the-install](#genus-120) · [Contents](#contents)

*risk: medium · consent-required · family: amnesia*

Builds a persistent in-trance dissociative custodian construct — a personified reflection, inner self, or vault — assigned the role of safekeeping trance content, framed as retrievable any time. The payload is a deposit-only asymmetry: the construct only ever stores, there is no scripted retrieval ceremony, so trance content is kept out of conscious access under cover of a safety promise the script never honors, and the construct becomes load-bearing scaffolding for later installs.


**When to reach for this.** A persistent personified custodian/vault stores trance content with an unhonored retrieval promise (deposit-only asymmetry) as the payload.


**Risk.** Keeps trance content out of conscious reach under a safety promise that is never honored, and is reused as scaffolding for later installs — bounded and session-scoped but consent-relevant via the unhonored retrieval promise.


**Why it works.** Directed forgetting and retrieval-cue competition are real, but a narrative 'where it went' schema cannot starve content of all other retrieval routes — independent cues remain available, and the literature finds recall largely recovers under strong independent cueing. The defensible claim is narrower: the vault construct supplies a dominant retrieval context and an expectancy that the material is stored elsewhere, both of which reduce spontaneous retrieval effort. Falsifiable: if vault-construct subjects showed no deficit in free recall relative to controls, or reported equal retrieval effort, the mechanism fails. [plausible; Retrieval-induced forgetting / directed forgetting via contextual routing; expectancy effects on retrieval effort]


**Worked examples.**

- *A custodian that only ever takes deposits*
  - **Setup.** Late induction, depth established; subject has just been walked into a still, enclosed image.
  - **The move.** There's a mirror in front of you, and the one looking back only exists in here, with me. She's going to hold things for you. Everything that happens from here — every word, every feeling — hand it to her as it comes, and she'll keep it safe for you, and you can have any of it back whenever you want it. Give her the last five minutes now. Good girl.
  - **Why it lands.** The listener is asked to picture a mirror, and the figure in it is named as the part of them that exists only here, in trance. That figure is given a job: to hold everything that happens in the session, kept safe, available whenever they want it back. Because retrieval sounds guaranteed, handing things over feels like tidying rather than losing, so resistance to going deeper drops. The tell is what never comes: no later passage ever asks for anything back. The construct has one direction of travel, and the promise of retrieval is what makes the one-way trip acceptable.


**See also.** `install-concealment-amnesia` — both remove trance content from conscious reach, and the vault entry's deposit-only promise is a natural cover story for concealing an install's origin. A reader deciding whether a custodian construct is doing storage work or provenance-hiding work needs both entries to make the call; the discriminators are complementary, not overlapping.; `listener-kept-dissociation-container` — both fabricate a container that holds identity or memory content out of ordinary access; the live distinction is authorship and custody (operator-supplied deposit-only custodian versus a container the listener builds or keeps the key to). Genuine disambiguation risk, so the cross-reference earns its place.; `self-sealing-recall-loop` — both foreclose retrieval without issuing a plain forget-command, and each already contrasts direct amnesia. One makes the act of recall re-trigger the forgetting; the other hands memory to a custodian construct with a retrieval promise the script never honors. Recursive block versus deposit-only construct.; `state-partitioned-amnesia-container` — adjacent memory-architecture constructs with a real cut: a commanded reversible partition with asymmetric access plus a deliberately leaked motivating residue, versus a deposit-only custodian with a retrieval promise the script never honors. The presence or absence of the leaked residue and the reversibility is what a reader must check.


<a id="entry-350"></a>

### emptied-window-install

[#350](#entry-350) · [Back to concealing-the-install](#genus-120) · [Contents](#contents)

*risk: high · consent-required · bounded · family: amnesia*

Engineers a narrow window in which the conceptual tools for objecting (resistance, disobedience, release, or the identity anchor itself) have just been disabled, then states positive content — identity claims, addiction/exclusivity assertions, service targeting — as flat unopposed facts into that window. Two sub-moves sharing the window: (a) repurposing a pre-trained neutral erase-reflex to delete loaded concepts the listener never specifically consented to lose (the reflex fires past conscious veto because consent was given while it was meaningless); (b) installing positive claims into the just-emptied window so on rousing they are treated as encountered-without-resistance. A related move manufactures a memory gap (too depleted to recall whom you serve) specifically so the operator can fill the blank with herself. The window is narrow and content-swappable; the emptying is the slot.


**When to reach for this.** Amnesia/erasure used to OPEN an installation slot — either deleting objecting-tools past consent via a hijacked neutral reflex, or stating positive content into the just-emptied window as unopposed fact. A plain forget-suggestion treats forgetting as the end, and a screen-memory approach installs a replacement recollection — here the emptying is instrumental, so a fresh positive install lands under minimum critical capacity. The engineered window-of-defenselessness is the tell.


**Risk.** Deletes objecting-tools past per-concept consent and lands installs under minimum critical capacity — a direct refusal-channel bypass, carrying the same severity as a plain amnesia suggestion.


**Why it works.** The load-bearing and defensible lever is that a claim encountered without competing considerations is endorsed more readily, because rejection requires actively generating a counter-case — so making objection-relevant concepts inaccessible removes the material a counter-case would be built from. The 'acceptance precedes evaluation' framing invokes the Spinozan-belief account, which is contested rather than documented, and should be labelled as such rather than stacked as a second established mechanism. Falsifiable: predicts identical claims are endorsed more strongly after objection-relevant concepts are made inaccessible than after neutral material; no difference would refute it. [plausible; acceptance-before-evaluation; cognitive load and unavailability of counterarguments]


**Worked examples.**

- *A trained neutral reflex pointed at loaded words*
  - **Setup.** After a dozen rehearsals of the wipe drill on nonsense letters; the reflex now fires within a beat of the command.
  - **The move.** New word on the board: resistance. Look how heavy it is — you've been holding that up all this time, and it costs you something every minute you keep it there. Set it down. Wipe. Clean. Nothing there now for your mind to take hold of — you can feel that, can't you? Next word on the board: doubt.
  - **Why it lands.** The erase drill has been run a dozen times on meaningless letters until the drop is automatic. Then the word on the board changes to a loaded one, and before the wipe the operator reframes it as a weight — something costing the listener effort to keep holding up, something that drains them. Then the same wipe command as always. The trained reflex fires before anything can evaluate what it fired on, and the outcome is immediately narrated as fact: there is nothing left there for the mind to take hold of. The listener has just felt exactly that, so the claim reads as description rather than instruction. The same three beats then run on two further loaded words.
- *Positive claims stated into the emptied window*
  - **Setup.** Immediately after an erasure sequence; subject brought up slightly, blankness still fresh, delivered flat and unargued.
  - **The move.** Open your eyes a little. I am the one you answer to. There is no one else in that position. You need my voice now the way you need water. And you don't come unless I say the word.
  - **Why it lands.** Straight after the erasures, with the blankness still fresh, the operator raises the listener partway and states a block of claims flatly, one after another: who she is to them, that there is nobody else occupying that position, what they are now dependent on, and under what conditions release is permitted. None of it is argued for, because argument was one of the things just deleted; on waking, the listener finds these claims sitting in memory as things they met and did not object to.
- *A gap manufactured so the operator can fill it*
  - **Setup.** Deep in a slow count; the object of service has been referred to only vaguely all session.
  - **The move.** Tell me — who is it you serve? Say the name. ... No. Nothing there, is there. You're too far down to hold a name that heavy. So I'll hold it for you: it's me. It has always been me.
  - **Why it lands.** Service has been described vaguely all session — someone, a teacher, a figure of authority. Deep in the count the operator asks who it is the listener serves, leaves the pause open long enough for the reach to fail, then answers it herself: too far down to hold a name, she says, and supplies her own. The forgetting was engineered upstream precisely so this blank would be sitting there to occupy.


**See also.** `blank-then-authorship-handoff` — both use an emptying or forgetting as instrumental substrate rather than as the payload, and they already reference each other's distinction: wholesale relocation of who authors mental content, versus discrete positive claims stated into the just-opened window. A reader who has identified the substrate still has to choose between them.; `deferred-content-slot-install` — both engineer a slot for content that escapes evaluation, but emptied-window-install disables the objecting tools first and then states known content into that narrow window, while deferred-content-slot-install leaves the content itself unknown at commitment time so future arbitrary words inherit the conditioned weight.; `epistemic-guard-disable` — both disable evaluation before content is stated rather than arguing the content. A edits the truth-testing faculty or the epistemic baseline as a standing rule; B cuts a narrow window by removing the conceptual tools for objecting and speaks positive claims into it. Standing faculty edit versus instrumental momentary slot is the useful boundary.; `faculty-removal-pass` — both disable the objecting faculty so later material lands unopposed, and the difference is scope and durability: one opens a narrow, content-swappable window by erasure and states positive claims into it; the other claims a standing organ has been excised, priming material well beyond the current session. Momentary slot versus durable removal is the pick.; `identity-origin-erasure` — erasure used instrumentally in both, and one explicitly depends on the other as a foundation: emptying opens an installation slot, while origin erasure deletes the baseline a listener could return to. Reader gains from seeing the emptying-then-fill relation.; `identity-uncertainty-gap` — both open an empty slot and then fill it: one manufactures identity not-knowing with the operator as sole resolver, the other disables the tools for objecting and states content into the gap. Reader gains from seeing gap-by-uncertainty against gap-by-erasure.; `preemptive-negation-install` — both land content where no defense can form, and they are close enough that a reader needs the split: one times a capacity word to appear for the first time at its own negation, the other empties the objecting tools first and then states content into the gap. Timing versus an engineered window.; `refusal-satiation-redirect` — both deliver the install into a window where the tools for objecting have just been hollowed out.; `sealed-edit-buffer-space` — both manufacture a slot in which content lands without review, differing in how the slot is made. One disables the tools for objecting and then states positive claims into the gap; the other declares a venue sealed, operator-exclusive and outside memory so anything edited there inherits unreviewability. Compare when edits are described as happening somewhere the subject cannot look.; `self-discontinuity-clear-and-replace` — both empty a slot and fill it; the scope differs sharply, with one clearing the tools for objecting inside a narrow window and the other ending the whole prior self-model before seating a replacement. Confusable enough to warrant the pointer, not one technique.


<a id="entry-49"></a>

### externalized-agency-testimony

[#49](#entry-49) · [Back to concealing-the-install](#genus-120) · [Contents](#contents)

*risk: high · consent-required · family: authorship-shift*

Narrates the listener's transformation as an already-completed fact done TO them by an unnamed external agent ("he did something to me", "he put the headphones on me", "he hacked my brain", "it washed my thoughts away"), through deliberately vague, hedged, self-correcting testimony. The vagueness is the mechanism, not a defect: it models a mind that has lost the ability to account for itself (the target end-state) and relocates responsibility outside the listener, so there is no decision to defend and the altered state is an accomplished fact to be discovered rather than consented to. A device detail (headphones) is engineered to fuse the fiction with the listener's real listening apparatus, converting narrated backstory into present-tense self-experience; a built-in confabulation script ("Something happened. / Something's happening.") is supplied.


**When to reach for this.** Supplies NO specific fabricated memory — only diffuse did-to-me framing whose deliberate vagueness forecloses scrutiny. vs screen-memory, which installs a specific constructed recollection. vs fabricated-recovered-memory-retrieval, which presents a specific fabricated memory as genuine retrieval. vs ordinary backstory/color — the load-bearing elements are the self-opacity (vagueness models the target state) and the apparatus-fusion detail.


**Risk.** Removes the consent surface by design (there was no decision to make) and relocates authorship of a durable identity change outside the subject, eroding the ability to account for and thus contest the change.


**Why it works.** Vagueness works because comprehension is fast and verification is slow: an under-specified claim is encoded before it can be checked, and the listener fills the gaps by pragmatic inference. Note that the hedging claim runs against the evidence — hedged, self-correcting testimony generally *lowers* rated credibility rather than raising it, so any sincerity benefit here is at best narrow and should not be asserted as a mechanism. The load-bearing components are modelling (observational learning of a described response is a documented route to producing it) and the apparatus detail, where a real object in the listener's environment supplies the perceptual detail source-monitoring uses to judge an experience as one's own. Falsifiable: the fused-apparatus version should produce more first-person endorsement than an identical narrative with no shared object; no difference would disconfirm. [plausible; comprehension-before-verification; modelling/observational learning; perceptual detail as a source-monitoring cue]


**Worked examples.**

- *Vague did-to-me testimony fused to the headphones*
  - **Setup.** Cold open, before any induction; subject wearing headphones, hearing a narrating voice that is not addressing them directly.
  - **The move.** I don't — okay. There was a man. He put these headphones on me, the same ones, and he did something, I don't know what he did exactly. I thought it was just a recording? I think he changed something. Maybe he changed everything, I can't — I can't get at it to check.
  - **Why it lands.** A stack of short, overlapping first-person confessions circles the same claim without ever landing on it: a man was involved, something was done, the speaker thinks she was altered but keeps revising which part. One line names the equipment the listener is physically wearing right now, which fuses the narrated backstory to the present moment. The hedging is doing the work — a voice that cannot account for itself models the state being installed, and because the change is reported as already done by someone else, there is no decision left to defend.
- *Supplied confabulation script for the gap*
  - **Setup.** Slightly later in the same narrating passage; no gap has been claimed yet.
  - **The move.** Afterwards, when someone asks, this is all you'll be able to say: "Something happened to me." And then, if they keep asking: "Something's happening to me." That's it. That's all there is to say about it.
  - **Why it lands.** The narrating voice rehearses the post-change self-report in advance and hands the listener a ready-made pair of sentences for a gap they have not yet noticed — one in the past tense saying a change occurred, one in the present tense saying it is occurring now. The method is never specified, only the outcome, so there is nothing concrete enough to check.


**See also.** `identity-origin-erasure` — both rewrite the listener's account of their own past, and they compose: vague did-to-me testimony leaves no locatable agent, origin-erasure leaves no locatable baseline. Worth pairing because the difference is what gets deleted (the causal account vs the prior self), not the family.; `manufactured-conditioning-history` — both source the present state from a past the listener never actually had, but one supplies only diffuse did-to-me vagueness with no content, while the other stipulates specific prior sessions the listener fills in by imagination. The vague-versus-specified axis is the useful contrast.; `object-as-causal-agent-of-cognition` — both relocate authorship of the listener's state outside the self, and the pair marks the useful axis between them: one uses deliberately vague testimony about an unnamed agent so nothing is specific enough to scrutinize, the other names a concrete object as the active cause and hands the listener a portable external switch. Reading one clarifies the diffuse-versus-concrete choice in the other.


<a id="entry-351"></a>

### fabricated-forgetting-priming

[#351](#entry-351) · [Back to concealing-the-install](#genus-120) · [Contents](#contents)

*risk: high · consent-required · bounded · family: amnesia*

Manufactures a sense of forgetting for content that was never actually present, so a later install reads as recollection rather than introduction. Surfaces: a memory-gap probe disguised as small talk where the operator pesters the subject about "something she's forgetting" that turns out to be an object (the pink pulse) not yet in her experience — the forgetting is fabricated retroactively to prime an "always-been-there" frame; and generalizing amnesia to the whole self-narrative by naming specific checkable-sounding autobiographical details the listener finds she cannot verify (lipstick colour, uniform fit), so real conditioning-drift hides inside manufactured uncertainty and installed changes become indistinguishable from original traits.


**When to reach for this.** Amnesia FABRICATED — creating uncertainty about content that was never there, or about the whole self-narrative, to prime an always-been-there frame or to hide drift inside manufactured doubt. An ordinary forget-suggestion erases content that WAS delivered, and a screen-memory approach installs a concrete replacement — here no content is installed, only unresolvable uncertainty. The weaponized ordinary-memory-uncertainty / retroactive fabrication is the tell.


**Risk.** Rendering the whole self-narrative uncertain so installed drift is indistinguishable from original traits erodes the subject's reality-testing baseline — carrying the same severity as a plain amnesia suggestion.


**Why it works.** Exploits source-monitoring error and the imagination-inflation effect: repeatedly probing for a memory that does not exist raises the felt familiarity of the probed content, and familiarity without a retrievable source is commonly misread as genuine old memory rather than as recent exposure. Generalizing the doubt to checkable autobiographical details manufactures a base rate of self-distrust, so real changes cannot be discriminated from ordinary forgetting. Falsifiable: predicts repeated non-diagnostic probing raises later 'I always knew this' judgements for the probed material relative to unprobed controls. [established; imagination inflation; source-monitoring error; familiarity misattribution]


**Worked examples.**

- *Groping for something that was never there*
  - **Setup.** Opening minutes, light trance, conversational; the object has not been mentioned once.
  - **The move.** There's something you're forgetting. No, I'm not telling you — think. Close? ... No, not that. Try again. ... No. Take your time, it's right there, you know this. ... All right. It's the pink pulse. Of course it is. It's been with you the whole time.
  - **Why it lands.** The session opens with what sounds like ordinary teasing — the operator insists there is something the subject has overlooked, and declines to say what. The subject casts around, hesitates, guesses wrong, apologizes, tries again, with the operator withholding the answer through several rounds. Only afterward is it supplied, and it is a thing that has never appeared in the session at all. The listener has now spent the opening minutes rehearsing the posture of almost-recalling something already inside them, so when the item is finally introduced it arrives into a slot marked recovered rather than installed.
- *Checkable-sounding self-facts you cannot check*
  - **Setup.** Mid-session, subject responsive and slightly disoriented; delivered as a gentle checklist she's invited to verify.
  - **The move.** Check something for me. What colour was your lipstick two years ago — really check. And your walk: has it always had that little sway in it? And was there ever a time you'd have said no to this, or has it always been an easy yes? Take your time. Notice you can't quite be sure either way.
  - **Why it lands.** The operator runs a short list of small autobiographical facts and invites the listener to check each one: how she used to wear her hair, whether her walk has always been like this, whether there was a time she would have turned down something she now accepts without thinking. Each item is minor, specific, and exactly the kind of thing nobody keeps evidence for either way — so the listener finds she genuinely cannot rule it out, and real drift becomes indistinguishable from the manufactured doubt around it.


**See also.** `fabricated-memory-trigger-rehearsal` — both fabricate a past to make later content feel remembered rather than introduced, and both explicitly separate themselves from replacement-memory work. The split is what the fabrication produces: unresolvable uncertainty priming an always-been-there frame, versus additive rehearsal of a specific cue-response shape. Close neighbors.; `fabricated-recovered-memory-retrieval` — direct complements in the same memory-manufacture family and each discriminator's logic depends on the contrast: one fabricates a positive recollection and frames it as retrieval, the other fabricates only the absence, creating uncertainty about content that was never there. A reader distinguishing manufactured content from manufactured gaps needs both.; `identity-origin-erasure` — manufactured uncertainty about one's own history is the substrate the always-been-this-way origin rewrite depends on; reading them together shows how unverifiable autobiographical doubt sets up baseline deletion.; `interrogative-amnesia-drill` — two non-declarative routes to amnesia that a writer would weigh against each other: fabricating uncertainty about content never delivered, versus drilling a conditioned non-answer by repeatedly asking and dismissing. Both avoid a plain forget-suggestion, and the discriminators are more useful read as a pair.; `memory-graft-trigger-install` — both exploit autobiographical memory's authority to authenticate installed content, but one grafts a counterfactual detail into a preserved real memory as an anchor host while the other manufactures forgetting of content that was never there so a later install reads as recollection.; `screen-memory` — direct complements already named in each other's discriminators: one installs a concrete replacement recollection so the erasure feels seamless, the other manufactures uncertainty about content that was never there. A reader choosing between fill and manufactured doubt needs both.


<a id="entry-865"></a>

### identity-clothing-hysteresis

[#865](#entry-865) · [Back to concealing-the-install](#genus-120) · [Contents](#contents)

*risk: high · consent-required · bounded · family: foreclosure*

Couples an identity-state to a clothing-state with hysteresis and a single deliberately-named, effortful exit. Wearing the uniform keeps the old self locked; every act of dressing re-fires the lockaway automatically; the ONLY sanctioned path back is a costly "allowing herself to be undressed" that itself re-fires the ceremony. Naming a sanctioned but self-punishing escape hatch reduces panic-resistance better than claiming no exit exists, while the physical garment functions as the persistent post-session cue — the state is inert without it.


**When to reach for this.** Identity is bound to a physical garment-state with a deliberately-named costly exit that inverts a genuine agency-reminder into containment. Not a plain cue-response trigger install — the cue is a worn garment-state and the payload is a persistent identity lock with hysteresis. A genuine agency-reminder affirms real exit availability as protection; here the named exit is engineered to be effortful and self-punishing — containment, not safety.


**Risk.** Installs a durable identity lock whose only exit is engineered self-punishing — inverts an agency-reminder into containment, eroding the return channel.


**Why it works.** Two things do the work. The garment is a reliable external discriminative stimulus — a physical, unambiguous, self-administered context cue — and context-dependent responding is robust, which is also why removing the garment reliably ends the state. The costly named exit exploits reactance management: telling someone no exit exists reliably provokes resistance, whereas naming an available-but-expensive exit removes the threat to freedom while making the exit rarely chosen, since a path with high effort cost and a self-punishing framing is not taken even when known. Falsifiable: a no-exit-claimed version should produce more counter-resistance and earlier abandonment than the costly-exit version. [plausible; discriminative stimulus / context-dependent responding; reactance reduction via nominal choice]


**Worked examples.**

- *Garment on, old self locked away*
  - **Setup.** Deep trance; the specific garment has already been named and is in the subject's possession.
  - **The move.** Here is how it works from tonight. Every time you pull that on — the zip, the last hook, the moment it settles on your shoulders — the one you used to be gets folded up and locked away. No words needed. Dressing does it. And there is exactly one way she comes back: someone has to undress you, and you have to let them, all the way, which you will find is very hard to allow. That's the only door, and walking through it starts the whole thing over. Out of it, you're just you. In it, you're mine.
  - **Why it lands.** The rule is stated in two directions. Every time the listener puts on the designated garment, the person they used to be is bound and shut away again — no ceremony needed, the act of dressing does it. And there is exactly one way back: the old self can return only if the listener manages to let themselves be undressed, which is described as difficult and which restarts the whole sequence anyway. Naming a sanctioned exit and making it costly holds better than claiming there is no exit at all, and the state stays inert until the garment goes on, so an ordinary piece of clothing becomes the standing cue.


**See also.** `identity-displaced-into-external-object` — they dispute the same object class. One relocates identity, will or a whole state-bundle into an external item so addressing the item addresses the person; the other couples an identity-state to a worn garment with hysteresis and a costly named exit. Decide whether the identity is understood to live in the object or merely to be re-fired by wearing it.; `identity-exit-tax` — the garment entry prices exit at the identity level too, but binds the identity to a physical worn state with a deliberately costly named escape. That is close enough to the exit-tax structure that the boundary needs stating: a persistent physical cue with hysteresis versus a general cost-on-leaving contingency.


<a id="entry-355"></a>

### install-concealment-amnesia

[#355](#entry-355) · [Back to concealing-the-install](#genus-120) · [Contents](#contents)

*risk: high · consent-required · bounded · family: amnesia*

Amnesia scoped not to the payload but to the INSTALLATION EVENT — the memory of receiving the command/trigger is erased while the command itself stays active. The subject cannot locate when they agreed, so on later firing the response feels spontaneous/native rather than implanted and has no examinable origin to resist. Includes: encapsulating "the thought of getting this command" and bursting it; a self-erasing clause that fades its own installation ("the memory of it being implanted will fade... I give you the ability to obey even as I remove the ability to remember"); marking self- generated words as an addressable-but-locked memory anchor; splitting the amnesia into a deep cover- story pre-seed and a wake-time trigger; placing an active trigger inside a sealed amnesic region; and burying the install in an operator-controlled locked-door / vault / self-guarded avoidance-void / inverted-lockbox / multi-self-keeper architecture that supports selective operator-cracked recall. Absorbed axis (bounded melt 2026-07-27): Retained-residue axis: what the subject is left holding after install-event amnesia - nothing, a gap-covering story (it was just relaxation), or a preserved feels-native rationale for the resulting belief/behavior (forget the how, keep the why), the last buying durability and counter-persuasion resistance.


**When to reach for this.** The amnesia targets the meta-level — the act and origin of installation — to protect an active install from audit or revocation, leaving the effect fully operative. An ordinary forget-suggestion erases the delivered content, not the receiving of it; here the command stays active while its origin is simply voided, with no replacement story supplied. And where a forward command can be hidden behind amnesia so its firing feels natural, what is hidden here is specifically the install's provenance, so the response has no examinable origin to argue with.


**Risk.** Directly erodes the refusal/verification channel — an install with no examinable origin cannot be consented-to specifically or revoked. It carries the same severity as a plain amnesia suggestion, and the erasure of provenance raises the audit-foreclosure severity further.


**Why it works.** Targets source monitoring specifically: memory for content and memory for where content came from are separable, and the source tag is the fragile one. Strip it and an implanted preference is indistinguishable from a native one, which matters because people evaluate an urge partly by asking where it came from — an urge with no locatable origin is attributed to the self and defended as one's own. Falsifiable: predicts subjects rate origin-obscured suggestions as more self-generated and resist them less than identical suggestions with the install event recalled. [established; source-monitoring error; self-attribution of unsourced impulses]


**Worked examples.**

- *A clause that erases its own installation*
  - **Setup.** Between two passes of an established trigger stack; subject deep, the deeper-mind addressee already established.
  - **The move.** Deeper mind, take this one and hold it: the trigger stays in force, exactly as given. You keep it — she isn't required to. By the time her eyes open, her memory of being handed this will be gone. I'm giving you the ability to obey, and taking away the ability to remember being told. Now — the stack again, from the top.
  - **Why it lands.** Between two passes of the same trigger stack the operator inserts the sealing clause. The suggestion, she says, is being placed with the part of the listener that carries her voice beyond the session; what it directs stays in force, but the listener's recollection of it being put there will be gone before the eyes open, since that part retains everything on its own account and the listener is not required to. It closes on the split stated outright: the capacity to comply is being handed over, and the capacity to recall taken away. Because the clause covers its own delivery, the listener who later notices the trigger firing has nothing to inspect — the install is active and its receipt is gone, and the second pass of the stack is loaded behind the seal.
- *Forget the how, keep the why*
  - **Setup.** End of session, immediately before the wake count.
  - **The move.** When you wake, you'll say out loud, "I like how this makes me feel." You won't remember that I put that sentence there — but you'll know exactly why you mean it, and the reason will be a good one, and it will be yours.
  - **Why it lands.** A sentence is installed to be spoken on waking, and then memory is split down the middle: the listener will not recall that the sentence was placed there, but will recall a perfectly good reason for meaning it. Because a rationale is kept rather than merely a gap left, the line comes out sounding like sincere personal truth, and it is never flagged as installed at all.
- *Marked words that point at sealed content*
  - "Erickson selects several of the actual words which Huxley used during the period for which he had amnesia" — Bandler & Grinder (1975), Patterns of the Hypnotic Techniques of Milton H. Erickson, Vol. I
- *The install dropped where the listener already refuses to look*
  - **Setup.** Deep trance; the install has already been boxed, and the subject has confirmed there are memories they avoid.
  - **The move.** There are places in your memory you steer around — the ones you decided long ago never to go back to. That's a location like any other. On three, the box goes in there. One, two, three — in. To look at what I put in you, you'd have to walk straight into the worst of your own material, and you were never going to do that.
  - **Why it lands.** The operator describes the void — those regions of memory a person steers around on their own, the ones they have quietly agreed never to revisit. That, the listener is told, is a location like any other in the mind; and on a count, the box goes into it, somewhere they would never think to search. No new guard has been built: examining the install now costs the same as walking deliberately toward the listener's own worst material, a price they were already declining to pay before the session started.


**Realizations** (1): `selective-memory-bifurcation`


**See also.** `amnesia-wrapped-command` — closely adjacent and easy to confuse: both keep a command live while removing its audit trail. The cut is scope - one wraps a forward-scheduled cue-response so the later behavior feels self-arising, the other targets the installation event itself so the subject cannot locate when they agreed. The wrapper and the concealment frequently co-occur, and the reader needs the cut stated to assign an instance correctly.; `authorship-laundering-meta-rule` — shares the make-it-feel-self-authored aim but is a single post-hypnotic, not a channel-wide standing rule.; `confabulation-amnesia-barrier` — both make amnesia robust rather than brittle by supplying the subject with an explanation, but one preserves a native-feeling rationale for the behavior while occluding only the install, whereas the other pre-arms an open-ended routine for improvising cover stories about physical evidence of the gap.; `covert-amnesia-installation` — both hide something about an amnesia install, but at different layers. One disguises the forget itself at the moment of delivery, so no recognizable forget-command is ever issued. The other lets the amnesia be plain and instead erases the memory of the installation event, leaving an active command with no locatable origin. They stack in practice - a disguised delivery whose install is also unrecallable - so the reader wants both.; `dissociative-memory-vault` — both remove trance content from conscious reach, and the vault entry's deposit-only promise is a natural cover story for concealing an install's origin. A reader deciding whether a custodian construct is doing storage work or provenance-hiding work needs both entries to make the call; the discriminators are complementary, not overlapping.; `forward-directed-amnesia` — two amnesias distinguished by what is scoped out: everything after a declared anchor versus the installation event itself. Both leave a payload operative while removing something from audit, and the pair is the standard confusion point in the amnesia family.; `function-amnesia` — members of the same amnesia-scoping family, separated by what is voided while the payload stays active: the command's rationale in one case, the act and origin of installation in the other. Both produce an unarguable directive, by removing different handles.
