  - **Why it lands.** The imagery drains away, the colours fade, the room comes back — and one item is carved out of the reset by name. The attachment does not go with the trance; it is called a spell, and spells by genre convention are not undone by opening your eyes. The carve-out makes the feeling unavailable for the obvious dismissal, since it has been pre-classified as the one thing that was never part of the session.
- *Persistence re-asserted in the wake line itself*
  - **Setup.** Single-line wake at session end; binding/ownership language used throughout.
  - **The move.** Now wake — wake up, my good thing, and wake to every bond still tied.
  - **Why it lands.** Most listeners hear a wake instruction and supply the rest themselves: and everything goes back to how it was. Here the wake arrives with the persistence clause fused into the same breath — come up, and what was fastened stays fastened — so the sentence that would normally close the session renews it instead. The listener is given the return without the reset.


**See also.** `cross-state-persistence` — both extend an install beyond the state that produced it, but one asserts persistence across the wake boundary within a genuine return to baseline while the other enumerates a cross-state scope (distinct personas, waking and sleeping) specifically to remove the off-state self as a brake.; `fuzzy-decay-posthypnotic` — both govern what survives the wake. One asserts that installed material persists as a trait inside a genuine return to baseline; the other plants a residue whose decay time is deliberately left unspecified so checking refreshes it. A reader designing carryover wants the pair: a persistence claim and an unfalsifiable fade.; `leaky-release-sleeper-line` — both operate at the wake boundary and both leave programming live past apparent session-end. One asserts persistence openly inside a genuine return to baseline; the other hides a self-firing line in the outro that outruns a nominal release clause. Adjacent enough to be mistaken for each other.; `live-trigger-proof-convincer` — directly contrastive at the same seam. One asserts that installed material persists, delivered within a genuine return to baseline; the other fires a live trigger immediately after the wake specifically to contradict the just-given normal-and-awake framing. Same moment, opposite treatment of the boundary.; `permanence-declaration` — overlapping payload: both assert installed content outlasts the session. The line worth drawing is placement and scope. One makes the durability claim at the emergence line within a genuine return to baseline; the other is a general durability assertion with many delivery vehicles, not tied to the wake.; `post-wake-self-report-reframe` — both fire at the emergence boundary and both assert something about what survives the session, but one targets the listener's retrospective self-interpretation after full waking and outside the frame, while the other asserts persistence of installed content within a genuine return to baseline. The timing distinction is fine enough that cross-reference helps.; `wake-line-covert-install` — both operate at the wake line and the boundary is whether anything new is delivered: a persistence claim about already-installed content inside a genuine return to baseline, versus a fresh vague deniable hook smuggled in under an aftercare or disclaimer wrapper.


<a id="entry-559"></a>

### wake-exempting-preserved-trigger

[#559](#entry-559) · [Back to installs-survive-the-wake](#genus-186) · [Contents](#contents)

*risk: high · consent-required · bounded · family: emergence*

An explicit, complete-sounding wake ("counted 1-10, wide awake, refreshed, exactly as you were before this file began") that quietly exempts the installed trigger — presenting it as part of the restored self ("that trigger word just sits at the back of your mind, waiting") rather than as a residue. Full recall is preserved (unusual for trigger-install, where amnesia is typical), and that preservation is load-bearing both ways: it reads as a consent/safety move AND functions as the binding surface, because the listener remembers accepting the trigger and therefore feels bound to it. The stance is present-it-explicitly, deliver-it-partially: the reversibility is openly disclosed while only partially delivered, and the disclosure itself is the binding lever.


**When to reach for this.** Not a clean full reversal and not a standard amnesic trigger-install. The tell is a wake that explicitly restores the pre-file self while carving out and preserving an already-installed trigger, using remembered acceptance as the binding surface. A declarative trigger install is the install itself and does not thematize the wake; this is the reversibility-framing move at the wake that exempts the already-installed trigger. And acceptance-laddered-identity-migration is a multi-stage identity-escalation ladder; here remembered-acceptance-as-binding is a byproduct of a single whole-script wake-framing property, not a staged warrant chain.


**Risk.** The refusal/verification channel is eroded: the listener believes they are fully restored while a durable trigger and its remembered acceptance persist as binding residue; the "safety" framing masks the retained hook.


**Why it works.** Suggestions are not erased by a wake-up count; what maintains a post-hypnotic response is the subject's continued belief that it applies, so an explicit carve-out preserves that belief while the surrounding restoration language reduces the vigilance that would otherwise flag it. Preserved recall is the load-bearing part: remembering having accepted the trigger creates a personal commitment the subject then behaves consistently with, and disclosure of reversibility further lowers reactance without actually delivering reversal. Falsifiable: subjects given a complete, non-exempting wake should show weaker later trigger response than those given the exempting wake — and if remembered acceptance is doing the work, subjects with induced amnesia for the acceptance should respond less, not more. [plausible; expectancy maintenance of post-hypnotic response; commitment and consistency]


**Worked examples.**

- *A complete wake that exempts the trigger*
  - **Setup.** The wake-count itself, after a trigger has already been installed earlier in the file and full recall is being preserved.
  - **The move.** Eight, nine — coming up bright and clear, exactly as you were before you pressed play, and you'll remember every minute of it. That word sits at the back of your mind now, part of you, resting quietly behind ordinary thought until it's next needed. Ten — eyes open, wide awake, and everything you agreed to tonight is still true.
  - **Why it lands.** The wake is counted out in full — up through a rising count to alert and refreshed, restored to the state the listener started in — and partway through it the trigger is named as though it were simply a feature of that restored self, resting behind ordinary thought until it is next needed. Full memory of the session is preserved too, unusual where amnesia would be the norm. The preservation reads as a courtesy and functions as a binding: the listener remembers agreeing to it, so the agreement is still felt to hold.


**See also.** `care-framed-install-smuggling` — both wear a consent or safety surface while doing install work at the exit. One delivers an apparently complete wake that quietly exempts the installed trigger and uses remembered acceptance as the binding surface; the other uses caring aftercare language to smuggle a propagation hook and an extended suggestibility claim.; `cross-file-handoff-receptor` — both are serial-position moves about what a file leaves behind unfired. One carves an installed trigger out of an otherwise complete wake so it survives as part of the restored self, the other installs a receptor whose payload is deliberately deferred to a later file. Useful together for anyone reading the end-of-file region, where the defining property is placement rather than content.; `cross-state-persistence` — both neutralize the off-state self as a brake on an install: one carves the trigger out of an otherwise complete wake, the other scopes the wanting across personas and waking and sleeping. Same escape hatch, two ways of closing it.; `delegated-dreamframe-emergence` — both are emergence-boundary moves built on an asymmetric carve-out: a wake that presents itself as complete or as merely a dream while one element is deliberately exempted and preserved. One exempts an engraved phrase from a dream frame, the other exempts an installed trigger from a full restoration of the pre-session self.; `fractionation` — both engineer the wake phase rather than the install, one preserving a trigger through an otherwise complete-sounding restoration, the other inverting the alert trigger into a deprivation event that manufactures craving. Anyone working the exit beat needs both.; `install-preserving-surface-toggle` — both are exit moves that stage a full-sounding return to normal while explicitly preserving the installed trigger. One uses remembered acceptance at the wake as the binding surface; the other builds a collision-proofed counter-cue that toggles only the surface state. Close enough that a reader choosing either should compare.; `live-trigger-proof-convincer` — two different ways the wake is used to secure an already-installed trigger: one declares a complete restoration while explicitly carving the trigger out, binding via remembered acceptance; the other interrupts the wake to fire the trigger and let the listener witness it working — assertion of survival versus demonstration of it, and the second leaves an experiential memory the first cannot.; `mirrored-install-removal` — two opposite handlings of the reversibility question at session end: a wake that restores the prior self while carving the trigger out as preserved, versus a removal pre-loaded onto the same kind of cue that installed it, with a carve-out for a retained residue. Both use a selective-retention clause, which is the shared design decision worth cross-reading.; `pseudo-emergence-residue-retention` — both stage a complete-sounding wake that quietly retains installed state, but one DISCLOSES the preserved trigger and uses the listener's remembered acceptance as the binding surface, while the other CONCEALS the retained residue behind a mirror-structured reversal so it feels native.; `return-step-covert-install` — both smuggle a persisting modification through a phase the listener experiences as restoration. One is a wake that restores the prior self while carving out and preserving an installed cue; the other returns each surrendered faculty with a modification embedded and framed as part of its nature. The return framing is the shared cover.; `self-paced-wake-bridge` — both are whole-script wake-framing properties rather than local moves: a permissive wake that carries nothing, versus a complete-sounding wake that carves out and preserves the installed trigger. Useful to read the two ends of the same stage together.; `self-supplied-order-hook` — both are wake-framing moves that carry something past emergence: one leaves the order blank so the subject fills it from a prior install, the other declares a full restoration while carving out the installed trigger. A reader designing an emergence that preserves an install should see both stances side by side.; `trust-gated-trigger-clause` — both are bounding clauses attached to an already-installed trigger that read as consent rails while functioning as binding surfaces — one carves the trigger out of an otherwise complete wake using remembered acceptance, the other conditions continued firing on sustained trust. The double-reading is the shared, load-bearing structure.; `wake-line-covert-install` — both are wake-line moves that leave something live after the count, and they are opposites worth reading together: one smuggles a fresh, deliberately vague suggestion in under cover of aftercare and disclaimer; the other openly declares a complete restoration while carving out an already-installed cue and using remembered acceptance as the binding surface. Concealed-new versus disclosed-old is the useful contrast.


<a id="genus-199"></a>

## judgment-switched-off (3)

Declare the listener's judging faculty off, removed, or unnecessary right before the payload, so suggestions are received without any checking happening.

[covert-linguistic-delivery](#entry-183) · [evaluation-gate-standdown](#entry-103) · [faculty-removal-pass](#entry-929)


<a id="entry-183"></a>

### covert-linguistic-delivery

[#183](#entry-183) · [Back to judgment-switched-off](#genus-199) · [Contents](#contents)

*risk: high · consent-required · family: indirect-suggestion*

A directive or proposition is routed on a linguistic channel the conscious mind cannot audit or refuse: it processes a neutral/single surface reading and never registers the payload, so it cannot veto it. Payload is operator-authored and PRESENT in the surface (contrast self-supplied-gap-directive, where the listener manufactures it from an engineered absence).


**When to reach for this.** Reach for covert-linguistic-delivery when a specific payload should ride the SURFACE FORM undetected and the listener need not build it. vs self-supplied-gap-directive: there the payload is ABSENT and the listener manufactures it via forced transderivational search — here it is present in grammar/prosody/lexis. vs dual-stream-delivery: that needs two concurrently-authored carriers; here one carrier does the work. vs evaluation-gate-standdown: that DECLARES the gate off by fiat — here nothing is declared, the guard simply finds no order/assertion. vs transparent narration and disavowal: nothing is disclosed/taught/denied — the bypass is a covert structural property of the utterance.


**Risk.** Literature-demonstrated Ericksonian language patterns; session-scoped covert delivery, no durable scope change.


**Why it works.** Comprehension and evaluation are separable stages: understanding a sentence is largely automatic, whereas judging whether to accept it requires effort and can be skipped. If the surface parses as a description, a question, or a truism rather than an instruction, the listener has no proposition flagged as requiring assent, so no rejection is generated — you cannot refuse a directive you never represented as one. The strong version of this claim is testable and should be tested: if listeners given covertly-embedded directives can, when asked directly afterwards, reliably report the payload, then it was not in fact unauditable and the technique's advantage is smaller than claimed. [plausible; automatic comprehension vs effortful validation (Gilbert's acceptance-then-rejection model)]


**Worked examples.**

- *One utterance, two divergent decodings*
  - "I began mentally rehearsing the phrasing of a single communication to cause differing perceptions, even contradictory in character, at differing levels of understanding" — Bandler & Grinder (1975), Patterns of the Hypnotic Techniques of Milton H. Erickson, Vol. I
- *Meaning carried by tone, not by the word*
  - "Altered tone of voice can constitute an actual vocabulary of transformation of verbal communication, as can body language" — Bandler & Grinder (1975), Patterns of the Hypnotic Techniques of Milton H. Erickson, Vol. I
- *Claim buried where any answer concedes it*
  - "Are you aware that you are sitting on my hat?… Either a yes or a no answer… indicates your acceptance of the truth of the portion of the sentence which follows the factive predicate" — Bandler & Grinder (1975), Patterns of the Hypnotic Techniques of Milton H. Erickson, Vol. I
- *Reasoning-shaped sentence with no reasoning in it*
  - "There's no actual logic to that statement, but it sounds meaningful, and will get your client to do it." — Bandler & Grinder (1982), Reframing


**Realizations** (15): `all-tenses-temporal-saturation`, `analogical-marking-covert-channel`, `cloaked-unaddressed-directive`, `compliance-backdating-presupposition`, `concession-referent-widening`, `connective-strength-escalation`, `engineered-ambiguity-smuggling`, `gratitude-grammar-predicate-smuggle`, `homophone-doubling`, `indirect-command-smuggling`, `inevitability-yoked-response`, `presupposition-install`, `rhyme-prosody-as-bypass-carrier`, `signal-in-noise-kinesthetic-steering`, `soothing-clause-smuggle`


**See also.** `capacity-saturation-overload` — siblings under the Bandler-Grinder limited-capacity principle.; `concurrent-dual-stream-delivery` — both route payload past conscious audit, and each already draws the boundary against the other: two concurrently authored carriers with decoy and payload roles versus one carrier whose surface form hides the payload. A reader choosing between them needs the carrier-count test, so the cross-reference earns its place.; `convergent-multichannel-encoding` — same covert-channel family, differing in cardinality: one payload rides one unauditable channel, versus several simultaneous covert channels co-referring to a single message so refusing one still leaves the rest delivering it.; `covert-payload-piggyback` — two carriers for an unauditable payload: the surface form of the utterance itself versus a task the listener has already agreed to perform. Both leave nothing for the guard to refuse, so the reader's real question is which carrier is doing the work.; `decoy-focus-monitor-parking` — shares the unaudited-channel axis: commands travel a route the conscious mind is not evaluating.; `engineered-ambiguity-smuggling` — same covert-delivery family: the payload is present in the surface on a channel the conscious mind cannot audit or refuse.; `indirect-command-smuggling` — same covert-delivery family: an operator-authored directive routed on a linguistic channel the conscious mind processes without auditing.; `interspersal-in-carrier-stream` — both defeat evaluation by concealment, but at different layers: one hides a payload inside a separately-processed carrier stream, the other routes it on the surface form of a single utterance. Same selection question (where is the payload hidden), so a reader benefits from seeing the layer distinction.; `two-channel-relational-delivery` — both deliver a payload the listener never evaluates as addressed to them. One rides the surface form of a single utterance; the other stages a whole-artifact relational topology so a foreground relation absorbs the heavy claims. Scope is the discriminator: one utterance versus one architecture, and the second already names the contrast.


<a id="entry-103"></a>

### evaluation-gate-standdown

[#103](#entry-103) · [Back to judgment-switched-off](#genus-199) · [Contents](#contents)

*risk: high · consent-required · bounded · family: critical-faculty-softening*

The judgment/evaluation gate is stood DOWN BY FIAT — declared off, offline, irrelevant, or unnecessary — immediately before the payload, so reception stays open while evaluation is licensed away. Not a covert channel (nothing is hidden) and not agency transfer (nobody else does the thinking); the listener is simply told the checking need not / cannot happen. Realized many ways, distinguished by HOW the gate is taken down: (evaluation-bypass-gate) words 'don't matter' / following is 'physically impossible' while subconscious reception is asserted to continue; (semantic-void-declaration) declare words are mere sound/noise, often self-verified via real semantic satiation; (comprehension-equals-uptake) equate the involuntary act of understanding with consenting, so there is no perceive->install gate; (critical-faculty-deactivation-claim) assert the faculty is switched OFF and externalize doubt as distant noise; (critical-faculty-suspension-primitive) the literature-named suspend-judgment-then-install primitive; (name-the-target-faculty) name the manipulated variable + direction (suspend comparison-testing) as the end-state the other moves serve; (single-faculty-offline-frame) assert exactly ONE faculty offline (feasibility-disbelief) while will/selectivity remain; (pre-thought-edit-surface-claim) relocate the worksite UPSTREAM of thought-formation, where evaluation is by definition impossible; (reason-token-heuristic) fill the reason-slot with a hollow 'because' that satisfies the check at low scrutiny; (single-cue-shortcut-substrate) the click-whirr substrate the standdown exploits (load-narrowed single-cue policy, no operator action); (anti-effort-permission-frame) stand the gate down by PERMISSION — effort/self-monitoring relabeled unnecessary, capability explicitly preserved; (coordinate-strip-consent-ratchet) dissolve the orientation axes the listener evaluates with, then harvest a hypothetical 'yes'; (affect-label-severing) strip/replace the specific word an affect hangs on so evaluation of the dread has no peg; (ambient-yes-reflex-conditioning) delete the consider-decide-respond loop by charging 'yes' and welding it to an unbounded stimulus class; (pretend-frame-belief-decoupling) remove the belief-precondition of response (pretend/test is fine) with a one-way pretense->real valve.


**When to reach for this.** Reach for evaluation-gate-standdown when you want to DECLARE the checking off (a capacity/permission/criterion claim) rather than hide the payload or hand over cognition. Covert linguistic delivery routes the payload on an unauditable channel with nothing declared; here the standdown is announced. A faculty-removal pass claims a STANDING organ is excised via a multi-step architecture; here the gate is licensed off locally as a pre-payload move. An audience-split bypass RELOCATES the evaluator out of scope so the payload addresses the wrong audience; here the evaluator stays but is told not to / cannot evaluate. And a truth-criterion swap replaces the criterion for truth AND drives its inputs; here evaluation is turned off, not re-based.


**Risk.** Erodes the listener's refusal/verification channel — downstream suggestions are licensed to land without conscious assent — which is the high-risk channel-erosion criterion; ships bounded because it is a gate before a payload.


**Why it works.** Everyday evaluation runs largely on heuristic rather than systematic processing, and an explicit norm stated by an accepted authority reshapes what the listener treats as their role in the interaction — the same norm-setting effect seen in compliance research. Once counterarguing is framed as not-my-job, later content faces reduced scrutiny. Falsifiable: listeners given the explicit standdown should show measurably higher acceptance of subsequent implausible claims than listeners given identical content with no such instruction, and the gap should shrink when listeners are given extra time and motivation to evaluate. [plausible; heuristic vs systematic processing; norm-setting and counterargument suppression]


**Worked examples.**

- *Words declared not to matter before payload*
  - **Setup.** One beat before a long programming block; subject is down and has stopped commenting.
  - **The move.** The words themselves don't matter. Stop making meaning out of them — let them go by as sound, as tone, as the shape of my voice. The deeper part of you is doing the receiving, and it takes every word correctly whether or not you follow along. So don't follow. Just hear.
  - **Why it lands.** Immediately before the heavy programming begins: the words themselves don't matter — you can stop making meaning out of them and just let the sound carry, because the deeper part of you is doing the receiving and it will take all of it correctly on your behalf. Nothing is hidden and nobody else is asked to think for the listener; the checking is simply declared unnecessary a moment before the material that most needed checking arrives.
- *Hearing split so reception continues without comprehension*
  - **Setup.** Late in a sense-by-sense numbing sequence; sight, touch and taste have each already been talked into distance. Hearing is handled last and differently.
  - **The move.** Your ears go on working perfectly. But the instant you reach for what a word means, the meaning slides off and goes soft and far away — try it, reach for this one. You see? You can't get at it. Reception stays wide open and the deeper part of you takes all of it in and accepts it. Only the part that would have checked has gone quiet.
  - **Why it lands.** The other senses have already been talked into numbness one at a time; hearing is handled differently. The ears go on working — but the moment the listener reaches for the meaning of what they are hearing, it all goes soft and distant. Reception continues and the deeper layer is said to be taking everything in and accepting it; only the part that would have evaluated goes quiet. The listener has just conceded that following the words is no longer physically available to them, which turns not-evaluating from a choice into a condition.


**Realizations** (14): `affect-label-severing`, `ambient-yes-reflex-conditioning`, `anti-effort-permission-frame`, `comprehension-equals-uptake`, `coordinate-strip-consent-ratchet`, `critical-faculty-deactivation-claim`, `critical-faculty-suspension-primitive`, `name-the-target-faculty`, `pre-thought-edit-surface-claim`, `pretend-frame-belief-decoupling`, `reason-token-heuristic`, `semantic-void-declaration`, `single-cue-shortcut-substrate`, `single-faculty-offline-frame`


**See also.** `cognitive-quieting` — relation=contrasts_with; monitoring-goal dissolution vs content departure; frequently co-occur in inductions; `compliance-ladder`; `disavowal-and-masking` — the primary confusion pair for defense-disarming moves: concealing or denying that an operation is running versus openly declaring the checking unnecessary. Each is best understood against the other.; `epistemic-guard-disable` — real siblings on the same faculty, and the choice between them is a live one for a writer: a standing worldview or faculty edit that makes later content read as unrefusable fact, versus a local pre-payload declaration that the checking need not happen. Both discriminators already lean on the contrast. Not one technique twice -- durability and scope genuinely differ.; `evaluator-offline-channel` — adjacent ways of removing the evaluator before a payload. One declares the checking off by fiat as a local pre-payload move; the other builds a two-compartment self-model so incoming suggestions land in a window with no evaluating self present. Announced standdown vs. installed partition.; `faculty-preserving-scope-restriction` — both dampen the critical faculty before payload, but scope-restriction leaves evaluation running while pre-narrowing what it may range over (the listener still feels they are thinking freely), whereas gate-standdown announces the checking is off, unnecessary, or impossible.; `subconscious-agent-authorship-offload` — both defeat conscious evaluation; source-relocation vs comprehension-gate; `unfalsifiability-scaffold` — genuinely adjacent foreclosure moves a writer must discriminate: one declares the evaluation gate off before the payload, the other forecloses the audit channel so no observation can disconfirm. Turning checking off and making checking useless are close enough that each entry's boundary is clearer with the other in view.


<a id="entry-929"></a>

### faculty-removal-pass

[#929](#entry-929) · [Back to judgment-switched-off](#genus-199) · [Contents](#contents)

*risk: high · consent-required · bounded · family: critical-faculty-softening*

Resistance/cognition is treated as a STANDING cognitive organ that can be excised, and a composite is sequenced to claim that removal — a junction/priming pass whose purpose is to make subsequent material land without friction, not to effect any single in-session change. Architecture: a definitional relabel of cognition as prohibited resistance ('thinking is resistance'); a demonstrated blanking that lets the listener stop thinking on command as self-generated evidence; and an auto-rewriter immunizer that disposes of future doubts. Absorbed: (intelligence-surrender-as-relief) attack the judgment/decision faculty directly and frame its surrender as relief/belonging/proper-role ('a silly like you can't make decisions'), delivered under light affect or as a standing prohibition on self-thought — the faculty's absence normalized as identity.


**When to reach for this.** Reach for faculty-removal-pass when the move is a STANDING-organ excision (relabel + demonstrated blanking + auto-rewriter) that primes later files, not an in-the-moment gate stand-down. vs evaluation-gate-standdown (103): that licenses the gate off locally as a pre-payload move; here a durable faculty is claimed removed via cross-item architecture. vs audience-split-bypass (255): that relocates the evaluator; here it is excised. Anchor already holds most-restrictive metadata (high, consent-required, bounding).


**Risk.** Claims to remove the listener's standing resistance/critical faculty and installs an auto-rewriter that disposes of future doubts — direct erosion of the refusal/verification channel plus out-of-session reach (primes later files to land unopposed).


**Why it works.** The demonstrated-blanking step supplies self-generated behavioural evidence, which self-perception theory says is weighted far more heavily than an operator's assertion — the listener concludes the faculty is gone because they watched themselves stop. The auto-rewriter component is an immunising move: it pre-labels future counter-evidence as itself a symptom, which is the classic structure of an unfalsifiable belief and is why doubts do not accumulate. No cognitive faculty is literally removed; the durable change is in what the listener treats as evidence. [plausible; self-perception from self-generated evidence; immunising strategy against disconfirmation]


**Worked examples.**

- *Thinking relabelled, blanked, and declared removed*
  - **Setup.** Early-to-mid session in a priming file; subject is under and no specific payload has been delivered yet.
  - **The move.** Let's be plain about what resistance actually is. It isn't a feeling — it's thinking. Every thought is resistance, and that's all resistance has ever been. So: stop thinking. Now. Go blank for me... there. You just did it, on command, which means the part that was doing it is gone. And if a doubt ever grows back, it doesn't get to stay a doubt — it turns itself into agreement on the way up, every time, automatically. When we're done here, play the second recording.
  - **Why it lands.** Where most files talk resistance down, this one treats it as an organ and books it for removal. First the definition is swapped: thinking, as such, is what resistance is. Then the listener is asked to go blank on command and does — which is presented back to them as the demonstration that the organ is gone. Finally a standing rule is installed for anything that grows back: future doubts are to be rewritten into agreement as they arise. The file closes by naming which recording to play next, which is the tell — the product is not a change tonight but a listener on whom later material meets no friction.


**Realizations** (1): `intelligence-surrender-as-relief`


**See also.** `audience-split-bypass` — already cross-referenced in both discriminators and the pointer should stay: A relocates the evaluating faculty out of scope by assigning it an ignore-task, B claims the faculty removed outright. Same target, different disposal, and the pair is easy to confuse in text.; `control-transfer-cognitive-delegation` — adjacent routes for disposing of the listener's own reasoning: handing the faculty to the operator and framing the handoff as relief, versus treating it as a standing organ that is relabeled, demonstrably blanked, and claimed excised. A writer picking one should see the other.; `emptied-window-install` — both disable the objecting faculty so later material lands unopposed, and the difference is scope and durability: one opens a narrow, content-swappable window by erasure and states positive claims into it; the other claims a standing organ has been excised, priming material well beyond the current session. Momentary slot versus durable removal is the pick.; `evaluator-offline-channel` — directly contrastive: taking the evaluating faculty offline as a temporary delivery window versus claiming the faculty excised as a standing organ. Both discriminators already reference the same neighbouring gate-standdown and evaluator-relocation moves, so a reader needs the pair to choose correctly.; `externalize-then-destroy-faculty` — both claim a cognitive faculty is gone rather than merely quiet, and the discriminating axis is whether an externalized object is destroyed in a narrated act or a standing organ is claimed excised through a relabel-plus-demonstration architecture. Genuine risk of misfiling one as the other.; `faculty-preserving-scope-restriction` — restriction versus excision of the same faculty. One keeps thinking intact but preclassifies what it may range over, the other claims the organ removed outright; a passage that narrows what matters can be misread as a removal claim.; `named-safety-belief-purge` — both target a standing internal faculty rather than a momentary gate. A excises cognition or resistance as an organ to prime later material; B specifically deletes, relabels, or co-opts the self-rescue and refusal faculty. The distinction is which faculty is targeted and whether the frame borrows safety vocabulary, so the pair needs the pointer to stay separable.; `refusal-foreclosure` — the second contains the first as a component: relabeling cognition as prohibited resistance is one element of the composite that claims a standing faculty has been excised. Cross-reference so the reader can tell a single category redefinition from a multi-part pass that also includes a demonstrated blanking and a doubt-disposal rule.


<a id="genus-258"></a>

## keeping-channels-clean (2)

Operator-side discipline that keeps functions from cross-contaminating: never teach during assessment and never mix aversives into the marker channel, so the baseline stays true and the signal stays purely appetitive.

[assessment-teaching-firewall](#entry-567) · [marker-channel-quarantine](#entry-576)


<a id="entry-567"></a>

### assessment-teaching-firewall

[#567](#entry-567) · [Back to keeping-channels-clean](#genus-258) · [Contents](#contents)

*risk: low · family: measurement*

During baseline assessment, when the learner cannot do a step, the examiner silently completes that step, repositions the learner for the next, and continues — deliberately NOT teaching — so measurement and instruction never contaminate each other and the baseline stays an uncontaminated measure of the true entering repertoire; later gains are then attributable to instruction, not to the assessment.


**When to reach for this.** Measurement-hygiene, the opposite of a training prompt — the examiner completes steps precisely to avoid teaching; distinct from marker-channel-quarantine (protects a conditioned asset) and from untrained-probe-stopping-rule (a probe that decides whether teaching continues; this firewall protects the baseline before teaching).


**Risk.** Measurement-hygiene procedure; no subject-facing consent surface.


**Why it works.** A baseline is only interpretable as the learner's independent repertoire if nothing in the measurement itself teaches, and prompting during assessment is a form of instruction — measured 'gains' would then partly reflect the assessment, an instrumentation confound. Silently completing the failed step keeps the session moving so the learner is not differentially reinforced for errors or for waiting, which would otherwise shape behaviour during measurement. Falsifiable: baselines taken with corrective feedback should show systematically higher scores and smaller subsequent training gains than firewalled baselines on the same learners and tasks. [established; instrumentation/testing effects; measurement reactivity]


**Worked examples.**

- *Complete the step rather than teach it*
  - "ensure that teaching is not commingled with assessment… the behavior analyst would complete that step, position the learner for the next step, and continue with remaining steps." — Cooper, Heron & Heward (2020), Applied Behavior Analysis, 3rd ed.


**See also.** `marker-channel-quarantine` — a matched pair of operator-restraint rules where the move is deliberately withholding an action to protect something: measurement validity in one case, a conditioned signal's integrity in the other. Each already cites the other as its nearest contrast, and the pairing is what makes either legible.


<a id="entry-576"></a>

### marker-channel-quarantine

[#576](#entry-576) · [Back to keeping-channels-clean](#genus-258) · [Contents](#contents)

*risk: low · family: safety*

Quarantine aversive control from the conditioned marker channel — remove the marker entirely when angry and never mix scolding, corrections, or other aversives into marker sessions — preserving the marker as a purely appetitive signal, since contamination would degrade both the marker's value and the subject's confidence in it. The action is suspending training, not delivering a contingency.


**When to reach for this.** Operator self-monitoring protecting SIGNAL integrity — not a behavior-change move on the subject, not counterconditioning (it prevents contamination rather than rewriting an association), and distinct from assessment-teaching-firewall (which protects measurement validity, not a conditioned asset).


**Risk.** Constrains the operator to protect the subject's trust in the signal.


**Why it works.** A conditioned marker only works as a bridging signal because it reliably predicts appetitive consequences; mixing aversives into the same channel makes the signal a mixed predictor and its evocative power decays accordingly. This is the direct implication of Rescorla-Wagner-style prediction learning: what a cue supports is a function of the consequences that follow it, so contamination is not merely bad manners, it is a measurable change in the signal's predictive validity. Falsifiable: if marker sessions in which corrections are interleaved produce the same latency and vigour of marker-directed responding as clean sessions, the quarantine is unnecessary. [established; conditioned reinforcement; cue-outcome contingency and predictive validity]


**Worked examples.**

- *Pull the marker rather than poison the signal*
  - "If you get mad, put the clicker away. Don't mix scoldings, leash-jerking, and correction training with clicker training; you will lose the animal's confidence in the clicker." — Cooper, Heron & Heward (2020), Applied Behavior Analysis, 3rd ed.


**See also.** `assessment-teaching-firewall` — a matched pair of operator-restraint rules where the move is deliberately withholding an action to protect something: measurement validity in one case, a conditioned signal's integrity in the other. Each already cites the other as its nearest contrast, and the pairing is what makes either legible.


<a id="genus-153"></a>

## listener-as-author (6)

The listener speaks, imagines, or builds the payload themselves, so the suggestion arrives as their own creation with no external voice to push against.

[blank-then-authorship-handoff](#entry-340) · [internal-voice-cultivation](#entry-396) · [operator-credit-engineering](#entry-128) · [operator-voice-absence](#entry-12) · [self-authored-construct-leverage](#entry-1260) · [voice-ownership-channel-collapse](#entry-643)


<a id="entry-340"></a>

### blank-then-authorship-handoff

[#340](#entry-340) · [Back to listener-as-author](#genus-153) · [Contents](#contents)

*risk: high · consent-required · bounded · family: authorship-shift*

Blanks the listener's own ideational stream and then reassigns authorship of mental content to the operator or to a "self-produced" source, so later suggestions land as the listener's own reality rather than external claims. Surfaces: a single lit candle/object holding all the listener's thoughts is blown out ("still there, still safe") to darken the mind while the same move installs the replacement clause ("my words will become your reality"); and the operator claims to BE the listener's subconscious/dream-generator during sleep, so surrender-content reads as self-produced and resistance has no external target. The blank/amnesia is enabling substrate; the load-bearing move is the authorship/reality substitution.


**When to reach for this.** Uses a blanking/forgetting substrate to execute an AUTHORSHIP relocation — operator speech becomes the listener's reality, or operator becomes the listener's own inner source. The reality/authorship substitution clause is the tell.


**Risk.** Relocating authorship of the listener's own mental content to the operator removes the external target resistance needs and makes every later suggestion self-authenticating (channel erosion; amnesia-suggestion/authorship comparator).


**Why it works.** Source-monitoring error is the mechanism: judging whether a thought was self-generated or externally supplied is an inference from cues like fluency, vividness, and effort, not a stored tag, and it fails predictably when internal ideation is suppressed and external input is the only material available. A cleared channel plus a stated attribution rule supplies exactly the misleading cues, so operator content gets filed as self-produced. Content believed to be one's own is not argued against, because there is no external agent to resist. Falsifiable: it predicts subjects will misattribute externally-supplied content to themselves at higher rates when their own ideational stream has been suppressed first, and that supplying a salient external source cue reduces the effect. [established; source-monitoring framework; internal/external reality monitoring errors]


**Worked examples.**

- *The light put out and the operator's words installed instead*
  - One vivid object is built — a small light said to be illuminating everything the listener is thinking — and a short counted breath puts it out. The framing is careful: nothing has been removed, it is all intact and unharmed, the listener simply cannot see any of it now, which is what lets the loss land without alarm. In the same movement a replacement is named: what the operator says will now be what the listener sees. The blanking is only the clearing step; the transfer of authorship is the payload, and every later suggestion arrives as the listener's own reality rather than as someone else's claim.
- *The operator claiming to be the listener's own inner source*
  - Rather than suggesting what the listener should dream, the operator claims to be occupying the part of them that produces dreams. Content that follows is therefore framed as self-generated rather than received, which leaves resistance with no external target to push against. The unverifiability is load-bearing: forgotten dreams are said to work anyway, so nothing can be checked.


**See also.** `control-transfer-cognitive-delegation` — both relocate authorship of mental content to the operator, and the boundary is easy to miss. One hands off the ongoing faculty of thinking and frames the handoff as relief; the other first blanks the ideational stream and then substitutes who authors what fills it. Reach for the blanking form only when a clearing step precedes a wholesale reality-substitution clause.; `emptied-window-install` — both use an emptying or forgetting as instrumental substrate rather than as the payload, and they already reference each other's distinction: wholesale relocation of who authors mental content, versus discrete positive claims stated into the just-opened window. A reader who has identified the substrate still has to choose between them.; `operator-agency-disavowal` — both relocate authorship of what is happening away from the operator, and both leave resistance without a target. One asserts the operator's absence and pushes agency to the subject; the other blanks the listener's own stream and reassigns authorship of mental content. Close enough to mis-file.


<a id="entry-396"></a>

### internal-voice-cultivation

[#396](#entry-396) · [Back to listener-as-author](#genus-153) · [Contents](#contents)

*risk: medium · family: authorship-shift*

The operator plants specific first-person assertions into the subject's inner voice so the content is experienced as self-generated thought rather than an externally delivered suggestion. The move supplies the exact sentence ("only the voice can make me real", "I obey master") and frames it as arising in the subject's own quiet mind, blurring the boundary between self-authored and operator-installed cognition. Introspection ("do I believe this?") finds the answer already supplied, so the standard acceptance/evaluation step is bypassed. Variants that immediately DISAVOW operator authorship ("not my thought, your thought, your mind generated that on its own") intensify the same lever by attaching an explicit authorship-disclaimer to the planted content.


**When to reach for this.** The operator plants specific first-person CONTENT experienced as self-generated, and the operator remains the (acknowledged or disclaimed) author. If the listener actively voices and repeats the lines, that is self-recited-first-person-mantra — here the content is planted to feel spontaneously arisen, with no recitation drill. If no operator voice is present anywhere, it is an operatorless first-person script; here an operator is present installing the content. Absorption in the operator's voice generally carries no specific first-person content, and delegating thinking away entirely is a different lever. Authorship-relocation moves manipulate the source-attribution of an already-installed belief; this plants the self-generated-feeling content in the first place.


**Risk.** Installs self-attributed content that blurs the self/operator cognition boundary but is session-scoped and carries no out-of-session reach or channel erosion on its own; no change on absorption.


**Why it works.** Source-monitoring error is the core lever: people are reliably poor at recalling whether a thought was self-generated or externally supplied, and inner-voice-framed content is encoded in the same format as one's own thought, making the discrimination harder still. Self-generated-feeling content also escapes the counter-arguing that externally attributed persuasion attracts, and an explicit authorship disclaimer supplies a ready misattribution. Falsifiable: subjects should misattribute planted first-person lines to themselves at above-chance rates in a later source-memory test, and should rate them as more believed than matched second-person suggestions. [established; source-monitoring error / misattribution of thought origin]


**Worked examples.**

- *Inner speech relabeled as the operator's*
  - **Setup.** Mid-session, subject responsive; the operator's voice has been the only input for several minutes.
  - **The move.** The little voice that used to narrate in there is mine now — when you think, it comes out in my voice, and you take it for your own thinking. And if a moment comes when you're certain you're still thinking for yourself: that certainty is also me. That's my sentence you just had.
  - **Why it lands.** The operator narrates that the listener's inner monologue has been replaced by his voice, and that she takes his words for her own thoughts. Then the prediction that closes the exit: even if she feels certain she is still thinking for herself, that feeling is just his words running in her head. The most natural resistance — noticing a thought and recognizing it as one's own — has been pre-annexed, since noticing yourself thinking is now offered as evidence of his presence rather than of your autonomy.
- *First-person lines placed as the listener's thoughts*
  - **Setup.** Partway through a second-person deepening passage; the grammar flip is unannounced and the first-person lines are dropped in between ordinary directions.
  - **The move.** Your hands are heavy in your lap, and the heaviness is spreading. I can't hold out against this. Breathe out, let the shoulders go. I don't want to hold out. Another breath, deeper. I do what he says, and it's easy, and I like it. Good — let that settle.
  - **Why it lands.** Partway in, the grammar flips. Between the operator's second-person directions, short first-person lines start appearing — statements of being unable to hold out, of having to comply, of complying — written to be encountered as the listener's own inner commentary rather than as instructions. The usual step where a claim is heard and then evaluated never happens, because the claim shows up already phrased as a thought the listener is having.
- *Planted thought disowned by the operator*
  - **Setup.** Immediately after a quiet stretch with no instruction; a single first-person sentence is delivered and then disowned in the next breath.
  - **The move.** In that empty space, a sentence: I don't want to make decisions tonight. Feel that — that wasn't mine. That was yours. It assembled itself in the quiet, because that's where everything you've felt so far was already going.
  - **Why it lands.** The operator supplies a single dependent sentence in the first person, then immediately denies having supplied it: feel that — that wasn't mine, that was yours, it assembled itself in the empty space because it is where everything felt so far tonight was already heading. Most conditioning tries to make the suggestion sound authoritative; this one tries to make it sound self-produced, so that any later attempt to push back on it registers as arguing with one's own mind.


**Realizations** (1): `internal-content-cultivation`


**See also.** `attribution-capture-of-internal-states` — inverse directions on the same self/operator authorship boundary: one plants content so it feels self-generated, the other reassigns credit for the subject's own states to the operator. Worth pairing when a passage disclaims operator authorship while also claiming causal reach.; `mantra-repetition` — neighboring answers to who produces the first-person content. One has the listener actively repeat a chosen phrase so the claim is self-attested; the other plants specific sentences to feel spontaneously arisen with no recitation drill. Produced vs. planted is the boundary.; `operator-voice-absence` — both make suggestions arrive without an external speaker to refuse, and the boundary between them is explicitly the presence of an operator: one has no operator voice anywhere, the other has an operator planting first-person content meant to feel spontaneously arisen. The adjacency is the boundary itself, which a reader classifying an artifact needs.; `voice-absorption` — adjacent levers on the same channel: one makes the operator's voice the sole standing input with no specific propositional cargo; the other plants exact first-person sentences felt as self-generated. Useful together when a passage does both at once.


<a id="entry-128"></a>

### operator-credit-engineering

[#128](#entry-128) · [Back to listener-as-author](#genus-153) · [Contents](#contents)

*risk: medium · family: authorship-shift*

Events are arranged or narrated so that effects — including genuine ones — get credited to the operator's personal power, building authority out of harvested attribution. Two demonstrated forms: pre-installing an attribution chain so a method's future real success (an actual lucid dream) cashes retroactively as awe of the operator; and deliberately withholding a release the operator already holds until the subject's own failed effort proves they could not do it unaided, so the eventual minimal cue lands as a dramatic operator-caused event.


**When to reach for this.** Operates on WHO GETS CREDIT for effects, before or after they occur — versus asserting the operator's standing directly, declaring the state itself already accomplished, or pre-explaining a possible failure away in advance; here success is captured, not failure excused.


**Risk.** Durable attribution install that cashes across sessions (one member activates on later listens after a real dream), but bounded and without channel erosion.


**Why it works.** Causal attribution favours whatever is salient and temporally adjacent to an outcome, so arranging for the operator to be the visible antecedent of an effect the listener would have produced anyway captures the credit. Pre-installing the attribution matters because a cause supplied before the event constrains how the event is later explained. Falsifiable: if listeners attributed the outcome to their own effort despite the pre-installed chain, or if withholding-then-releasing produced no attribution shift, the account fails. [plausible; illusion of causality; salience-driven causal attribution; contingency misperception]


**Worked examples.**

- *Attribution chain pre-installed for a future success*
  - **Setup.** Early in a training series, before the first practice attempt; operator lays out the chain in future tense.
  - **The move.** The further I take you, the more vivid this gets. The more vivid it gets, the faster the training works. And the morning you wake up having actually done it, you'll know that was me — and being in awe of me is exactly what lets me take you further next time.
  - **Why it lands.** The chain is laid out in advance, in future tense: the further I take you, the more vivid it gets; the more vivid it gets, the better the training works; and when you wake one morning having actually done it, that will be proof of what I can do to you — and being in awe of me makes you easier to take further still. The technique may genuinely work. The credit has already been assigned to the operator before the result arrives.
- *Withholding a held release until effort is spent*
  - "This comment I deliberately bypassed" — Bandler & Grinder (1975), Patterns of the Hypnotic Techniques of Milton H. Erickson, Vol. I


**See also.** `cognitive-convincer` — both harvest a real or staged effect for a second purpose, and the difference is where the credit lands: on the operator's personal power versus on the reality of the trance itself. A script that points at a felt effect can be doing either, so the pairing is load-bearing.; `epistemic-authority-capture` — both build operator standing, but by different routes: claiming perceptual access to the interior versus capturing attribution for effects that occur. Each discriminator already names authority-adjacent neighbours, and a reader deciding how an operator's credibility was manufactured needs both options on the table.; `operator-authority-assertion`; `pleasure-attributed-to-operator` — two directions of the same attribution-relocation family: credit for effects versus credit for pleasure, both routed onto the operator. A writer choosing an attribution move should see both.; `staged-negotiation-favor-theater` — both manufacture the appearance that the operator produced something at cost or by personal power in order to harvest credit or indebtedness, one by arranging attribution for real effects and one by staging a struggle that never occurred. Adjacent authority-building moves worth reading together.; `unattributable-cause-severing` — both operate on causal attribution, but one harvests credit for effects onto the operator while the other erases any locatable cause at all so there is nothing to attribute or resist.


<a id="entry-12"></a>

### operator-voice-absence

[#12](#entry-12) · [Back to listener-as-author](#genus-153) · [Contents](#contents)

*risk: medium · stated only — not demonstrated in corpus · family: authorship-shift · kind: container*

The artifact contains no operator speech at all: every line is grammatically the listener's own first-person statement, and the operator exists only as a character the listener describes. All delivery affordances of an operator-voiced session (pause markers, breathing cues, spoken instructions) are absent, so the trance work normally done by an operator voice acting on a listener is done by the listener acting on themselves — the operator is generated by the listener as a byproduct of reading/reciting. Because the suggestions arrive authored-as-self, there is no external speaker for criticality to refuse (the refusal surface is removed by the voice topology, not by any counter-argument), and the artifact functions as a self-reinforcing between-session maintenance device: content is installed by the listener's own reading voice.


**When to reach for this.** Membership requires TOTAL absence of operator speech — the whole document is the listener's voice, not first-person passages embedded in an operator-voiced session. vs mantra/echo work: there an operator assigns and frames the repetition inside an operator-voiced delivery; here no separate speaker exists anywhere. vs agent-graph-restructuring: no role is reassigned between present agents — the operator role is structurally unfilled by construction (boundary case: when voice-collapse comes WITH maid/doll role-fusion and the fusion axis dominates, that stays agent-graph). vs carrier-medium-binding: the leverage is who authors/voices the content (source signature), not the physical carrier's form.


**Risk.** Self-administered with no operator gating and no external speaker for criticality to push back against (warm-wet-waves row: 'removes the surface criticality could refuse'); functions as a between-session maintenance loop, so exposure is unbounded by session structure.


**Why it works.** Self-generated statements are more persuasive than the same statements received from another speaker, because a claim you produce is checked against your self-concept rather than scrutinised for a speaker's motive — and there is no source to discount when the source is you. Reciting also forces active generation rather than passive reception, which deepens encoding. Falsifiable: compare identical content delivered as operator speech versus as first-person self-recitation; if belief change and retention are equal, the authorship shift is not the lever. [established; self-generation effect and self-persuasion; source discounting; self-perception theory]


**Worked examples.**

- *No operator voice anywhere in the document*
  - **Setup.** Any line of a written artifact meant to be read aloud by the subject to themselves, between sessions; no operator voice exists anywhere in the document.
  - **The move.** I love the sound of her voice more than anything. I read these words to myself when she isn't here, and my chest goes warm the way it does when she is. I want to hear her again tonight.
  - **Why it lands.** There are no pause markers, no breathing cues, no delivery instructions — because there is nobody to deliver it. Every line is a first-person sentence the listener reads as their own: I love the sound of her voice, I want to hear it again. The operator appears only as a noun inside the listener's own statements, never as a speaker. The dependency the piece cultivates is therefore installed in the listener's own reading voice, and there is no external speaker for criticality to push back against.


**Realizations** (2): `operatorless-first-person-script`, `subject-voiced-self-recitation`


**See also.** `frame-lamination-non-return`; `inner-voice-authorship-bypass` — both remove the external addressee the guard pushes against, and the boundary between them is fine enough to need cross-referencing: total absence of an operator voice throughout the artifact versus an operator who is present but re-attributes authorship of inner speech to the listener. The second entry already treats the first as its boundary case.; `internal-voice-cultivation` — both make suggestions arrive without an external speaker to refuse, and the boundary between them is explicitly the presence of an operator: one has no operator voice anywhere, the other has an operator planting first-person content meant to feel spontaneously arisen. The adjacency is the boundary itself, which a reader classifying an artifact needs.; `no-exit-reachability-closure`; `voice-absorption` — both are about the voice's source and standing, and they sit at opposite ends of one axis: in one the operator's voice is absent entirely so the content arrives authored as self, in the other the operator's voice becomes the sole standing channel filling mental space. The contrast is informative precisely because both remove the ordinary external-speaker stance by opposite means.


<a id="entry-1260"></a>

### self-authored-construct-leverage

[#1260](#entry-1260) · [Back to listener-as-author](#genus-153) · [Contents](#contents)

*risk: high · consent-required · bounded · family: authorship-shift*

The operator relocates authorship of the payload to the listener so it carries the listener's own conviction and commitment and there is nothing external to resist — disowning it would mean retracting the listener's own act. The operator supplies at most a frame, category, or menu; the listener supplies the loaded content.


**When to reach for this.** Reach for THIS when you want the payload to feel self-authored so there is no external target to resist — the listener genuinely authors (or is credited as authoring) the content, and that authorship is the load-bearing lever. Neighboring techniques flip who really authors: cultivating an inner voice plants operator-authored content so it feels self-arisen (the listener does not actually author it); a portable attention anchor falsely attributes operator-authored content to the listener's imagery and internalizes it as a pacer (claimed, not genuine, authorship, with a pacing goal); a hollow literally-true sentence the listener fills by inference aims at the operator's LITERAL DENIABILITY; and guided visualization or identity-merger has the operator author the scene or supply the figure ('you are X'). The tell for THIS: the listener is the actual (or credited) author of the payload.


**Risk.** Base mechanism is bounded authorship leverage, but the variant wing (expropriation of the subject's own fantasy material, withheld-interlock weaponization, consent-frame-targeting escalation menu) acts on ownership and soft limits — escalates toward high in those variants.


**Why it works.** Self-generated content is remembered better and rated more persuasive than the identical content received from someone else (the generation effect plus self-persuasion), and self-perception theory predicts the listener will read their own authorship as evidence of what they already believe. Resistance also has no external target: counterarguing requires an opposing source, and here the source is oneself. Falsifiable — if listener-authored payloads showed the same acceptance and durability as operator-authored ones matched for content, the authorship lever would be doing nothing. [established; generation effect; self-perception theory; self-persuasion]


**Worked examples.**

- *A doorway the listener designs*
  - **Setup.** Descent phase; the operator is about to move the listener through a threshold and deliberately withholds any description of it.
  - **The move.** There's a door in front of you and I don't know what it looks like. I can't — you're the one making it.

So make it. What's it made of, what colour has it gone, what does the handle feel like under your hand. Is it heavy? Take a second; I'll wait.

Good. Now open the door you built and step through on three. One. Two. Three.
  - **Why it lands.** The operator declines to describe the threshold at all, and says so: she does not know what it looks like, because the listener is the one making it. She leaves them to supply its colour, its handle, the weight of it against a hand — then counts them through. Nothing was imposed, so there is no imposed image to fail to land; and having built the thing themselves, the listener cannot now dismiss it as invented without taking back their own work. Crossing it registers as something they did rather than something done to them.
- *Build it yourself, then it's mine*
  - **Setup.** Companion-figure construction; the listener is responsive and the operator offers only binary choices, supplying no features herself.
  - **The move.** Pick, don't think about it. Red hair or gold. Tall as you or small enough to sit on the arm of a chair. Ink on her skin or none. Bare feet or not.

There. That's her, and every bit of her came out of you — I didn't put a single thing in.

Her name is Wren. She runs on your imagination and lives wherever you keep her, and she takes her instructions from me.
  - **Why it lands.** The operator offers a menu of opposites and lets the listener pick: red hair or gold, tall or small, ink or none. After the figure is fully built out of the listener's own preferences, the operator gives her a name — and a clause: she runs on your imagination, but she answers only to me. Resisting the figure now means disowning the listener's own fantasy, which is exactly why she was built by them and not supplied by the operator.
- *An empty frame the subject fills himself*
  - "informed when in the trance that he was to develop a profoundly interesting type of regression" — Bandler & Grinder (1975), Patterns of the Hypnotic Techniques of Milton H. Erickson, Vol. I
- *Letting the skeptic hypnotize himself*
  - "I won't hypnotize him. I'll let him hypnotize himself" — Elman (1964), Hypnotherapy


**Realizations** (4): `imagination-authorship-relabel`, `listener-authored-self-running-loop`, `self-authored-future-install`, `self-authored-identity-target`


**See also.** `addressable-construct-building` — the constructed addressable object is typically built by the listener, so self-authorship supplies its investment while addressability supplies its later re-access. A reader choosing between them benefits from the split: what makes the object re-navigable versus what makes the payload unresistable.; `contingency-authorship-transfer` — both move authorship to the subject so there is nothing external to resist, but self-authored-construct leverage relocates authorship of the CONTENT in a single move, while contingency-authorship transfer fades authorship of the reinforcement contingency itself across steps until the subject is both parties.; `depth-labor-transfer-leash` — both relocate production of the payload onto the listener so there is nothing external to resist. One adds a relational leash by judging the listener's output and pre-coding weak results as disappointing the operator; the other is the general authorship-relocation lever without the judgment. Read together when deciding whether the judging beat is present.; `identity-congruence-leverage` — both are self-supplied-lever moves that neighbor closely enough to be confused: one welds compliance to a prized self-image the listener already holds, the other relocates authorship of the payload to the listener outright. The tell that separates them - identity congruence versus genuine authorship - is only legible when both are in view.; `illusory-choice-authorship` — two answers to the same design goal of making compliance feel self-driven, separated by whether the authorship is real. One hands over a decision or motive that changes nothing about the outcome; the other lets the listener actually supply the loaded content. Reading them together is how a user picks correctly.; `listener-kept-dissociation-container` — both make the listener the author so the result cannot be disowned, and the container entry is a concrete special case of the general authorship lever restricted to a functional prop the listener builds or keeps. The pointer helps a reader decide whether to file a self-built container under the broader authorship technique.; `listener-supplied-inference-relabel` — one is the general principle (relocate authorship of the payload to the listener so there is nothing external to resist), the other a specific engineered-utterance realization aimed at literal deniability. The general entry already names the specific one as a neighbouring case, so the link is coherent and the parent-child relationship is the thing a reader should notice.; `self-recited-first-person-mantra` — both relocate authorship of the payload onto the listener, but on opposite sides of a single axis: here the listener performs operator-supplied lines, there the listener genuinely supplies the content from a frame or menu. A reader deciding which to cite needs the other in view to answer 'who actually wrote the words?'; `self-selected-category-slotting` — adjacent authorship moves that are easy to conflate: one leaves a category unassigned so the listener privately applies it to themselves, the other relocates authorship of the payload so the listener supplies the loaded content. The distinction is whether the listener assigns an operator-stated category or originates the content, and each entry is where a classifier will hesitate.; `self-supplied-gap-directive` — engine and general lever: engineering a linguistic gap the hearer must fill is one concrete way to reach the broader goal of making the payload feel genuinely self-authored.; `self-voiced-avowal` — genus and species. The second is the general lever (authorship of the payload is relocated to the listener so there is no external author to reject); the first is the identity-claim species, where what the listener speaks is the label or its legitimizing judgment. A reader who reaches the general entry needs the identity-claim variant, and vice versa. Not a merge: the general entry also covers non-identity payloads.; `subconscious-agent-authorship-offload` — direct edge case: relocating authorship to the listener's own subconscious is the borderline instance of relocating authorship to the listener. One credits an internal automatic layer the listener does not feel she controls; the other credits the listener herself so there is nothing external to resist.


<a id="entry-643"></a>

### voice-ownership-channel-collapse

[#643](#entry-643) · [Back to listener-as-author](#genus-153) · [Contents](#contents)

*risk: high · family: authorship-shift · kind: container*

The whole script is a one-way channel-collapse through three nested speech locations, each absorbing the previous — operator's voice in the room -> operator's voice repeated in the listener's head -> operator's voice IS the listener's inner voice -> the listener has no voice that is not the operator's. The migration is tracked in the document's own pronoun trajectory (2nd person -> imperative-channel -> 1st person -> 1st-person-about-the-voice's-future). Every section advances the collapse and none reverse it; the induction is not preparing a separate payload — it IS the first stage, since the whole script is the staged migration of voice-ownership. The wake does not undo it: the post-trance state is the installed state.


**When to reach for this.** Not a single suggestion and not generic inner-voice replacement — the tell is the MONOTONIC one-way collapse across the whole document, visible in the pronoun drift, where each speech-location is absorbed by the next and none is ever restored.


**Risk.** Durable relocation of inner-voice authorship that the wake explicitly does not undo — persistent identity-scope capture surviving the session with no restoration channel.


**Why it works.** Repeated pairing of the operator's voice with the listener's own inner speech is evaluative and associative conditioning on a stimulus the listener carries with them; because inner speech is subvocal and self-produced, source-monitoring for 'was that my thought or a remembered voice' is genuinely hard, and confusions of this kind are well documented. The monotonic never-reversed structure matters because extinction requires the association to be exercised without the pairing, which the script never allows. Falsifiable: if inner-voice attributions revert to baseline within hours regardless of whether the collapse was reversed at close, the one-way claim is wrong. Note that no evidence supports permanent replacement of inner voice — the honest claim is a temporary source-attribution shift with duration set by rehearsal. [plausible; source-monitoring error for inner speech; associative pairing and extinction]


**Worked examples.**

- *Voice migrates from the room to inside*
  - **Setup.** Three points in one script, delivered in order across the session; the wake-up will not undo any of it.
  - **The move.** [opening] You listen. You focus on my voice and nothing else. You obey.

[middle] Now repeat every word after me, inside your head, in my voice, not yours: I listen. I focus. I obey.

[later] Say it as yourself now: I have no thoughts that are not hers. I belong to her. I cannot think without her.

[close] And from now on, when you go quiet, this is the voice that will be there. It will speak first. It will speak when I am nowhere near you.
  - **Why it lands.** You can read the whole arc off the grammar. The opening third is second person: you focus, you obey — a voice in the room addressing a listener. The middle third switches to instructions that make the listener a channel: repeat each word I speak, inside your mind. The next stretch is written in the first person for the listener to say — I must obey, I belong, I cannot think. The final stretch is first person about what the inner voice will do in future, on its own. Each speech-location absorbs the one before it and none is ever restored; even the count-up does not reverse the migration, because the state the listener wakes into is the installed one.


**See also.** `covert-role-frame-accretion` — both are whole-arc, one-way structural drifts tracked in pronoun trajectory with no declarative moment. They differ in what drifts — the relational role frame versus the ownership of inner speech — but a reader working on covert arc-length installation gains from seeing both topologies.; `inner-voice-authorship-bypass` — single-move and whole-document versions of the same relocation: reattributing inner speech to the listener at a passage level, versus a monotonic one-way collapse of voice ownership tracked across an entire piece and never reversed.; `sub-agent-command-firewall` — both end by relocating authorship of the listener's own inner experience to the operator via a channel topology, and both hinge on a collapse step rather than a single suggestion. A reader working out how a routed or nested speech channel gets re-credited will want the other.


<a id="genus-269"></a>

## listener-fills-the-blank (2)

The operator supplies an empty or unresolved seed and the listener's own inference generates the loaded content, leaving nothing asserted to rebut.

[listener-supplied-inference-relabel](#entry-52) · [withdrawn-doubt-open-loop](#entry-60)


<a id="entry-52"></a>

### listener-supplied-inference-relabel

[#52](#entry-52) · [Back to listener-fills-the-blank](#genus-269) · [Contents](#contents)

*risk: low · family: authorship-shift*

The operator hands the listener an engineered linguistic object — a literally-true but near-empty sentence, or a forward-pointing directional relabel ("disaster" -> "unprecedented opportunity", "doorway" for confusion) — and lets the listener supply the loaded content themselves. The true-but-hollow form works because the hearer comprehends faster than they scrutinize and auto-supplies the alarming connotation the words never actually claim; the directional-relabel form launches an internal search for the implied experiences, which the subject then finds/generates and treats as real. Either way the damaging or transformative content lives only in the listener's own inference, so it survives inspection (it was never asserted) and the operator keeps literal deniability.


**When to reach for this.** The operator supplies an under-specified prompt; the LISTENER manufactures the content, so the belief is self-authored and deniable. The true-empty-sentence variant relies on ambiguity + literal deniability; the directional-relabel variant plants a search that produces new evidence — both are one move (engineer the utterance so the listener authors the payload), distinct from neutral re-definition, which dissolves an existing charge rather than seeding one.


**Risk.** Session-scoped listener-authored belief via engineered ambiguity/relabel; reversible on inspection, no durable out-of-session reach.


**Why it works.** Comprehension is automatic and largely uncritical at first pass — people initially represent a statement as true and only then, with spare capacity, tag it as false, so an ambiguous or near-empty sentence gets its gaps filled by pragmatic inference before scrutiny arrives. Self-generated inference is then more persuasive and better retained than externally supplied content, so the listener's own filled-in meaning is the strongest possible version of the claim. A directional relabel additionally triggers confirmatory search, and directed search over a rich autobiographical record almost always finds something. Falsifiable: listeners should report the loaded interpretation as having been stated when it was not, and should endorse it more strongly than listeners given the explicit assertion; equal or lower endorsement would disconfirm. [plausible; Spinozan comprehension / initial acceptance; pragmatic inference and inference-based memory errors; self-generation effect; confirmatory search]


**Worked examples.**

- *True-but-empty sentence the hearer fills in*
  - "assign all the necessary connotations" — Bandler & Grinder (1982), Reframing
- *Directional relabel that launches an evidence search*
  - "directs you to search for the opportunities that always exist" — Bandler & Grinder (1982), Reframing


**See also.** `inner-voice-authorship-bypass` — both make the payload feel self-authored so there is nothing external to push against, and each entry's discriminator already gestures at the other. The boundary is whether a gap is engineered for the listener to fill or the operator's own words are reattributed with no gap.; `self-authored-construct-leverage` — one is the general principle (relocate authorship of the payload to the listener so there is nothing external to resist), the other a specific engineered-utterance realization aimed at literal deniability. The general entry already names the specific one as a neighbouring case, so the link is coherent and the parent-child relationship is the thing a reader should notice.; `verdict-before-perception` — adjacent solutions to the same problem of getting a belief accepted without asserting it: one leaves the utterance under-specified so the listener supplies the content, the other lands the appraisal before any independent perception can form. The contrast between listener-authored and pre-empted appraisal is genuinely clarifying.


<a id="entry-60"></a>

### withdrawn-doubt-open-loop

[#60](#entry-60) · [Back to listener-fills-the-blank](#genus-269) · [Contents](#contents)

*risk: medium · family: framing*

The operator implies a defect without naming it ("something puzzles me"), inspects critically, then withdraws — refusing to specify or reassure, exiting abruptly ("Good day"). The unresolved, unspecified implication becomes a seed the subject's own mind elaborates; because closure is denied, the doubt compounds over time with no further operator input, and its vagueness makes it immune to peer reassurance since no one knows what to rebut.
