*risk: high · consent-required · bounded · family: framing*

Relocates authorship of the operative want onto the subject's own real or asserted past. The surrender, arousal, or installed disposition is narrated as a pre-existing desire, craving, expectation, or repressed truth that the session merely uncovers or honors, so refusal is recoded as self-betrayal or denial of one's own experience and the disavowal exit (this isn't me) closes because the relevant self has by stipulation already wanted it. Absorbed axis (bounded melt 2026-07-27): Temporal frame and evidence vehicle of the want-attribution: asserted past/deeper-self history vs declared present taste; operator-narrated premise vs subject-enacted evidence (recited petition-identity bond, accepted description, competence-lever ego cost); plus the self-sealing uncontrollability stack as an intensity/sealing feature.


**When to reach for this.** The lever is attribution of DESIRE or inner history (you always wanted this, your deeper self craves it), not conversion of an act into consent (press-play-consent-laundering), not assertion that the state itself is already complete (presupposed-completion-fait-accompli), and not attribution of the compliant act to the subject's own nature or choice (compliance-authorship-laundering). It invokes history rather than the operator's present authority; and unlike a manufactured-deficit remedy, the want is asserted as already present, not built from an installed deficit.


**Risk.** Raised from low: absorbed scope includes desire-attribution binds that foreclose disavowal (two members) — consent-surface contact though session-scoped.


**Why it works.** Self-perception theory holds that people infer their attitudes from observable evidence about themselves, including narrated autobiography, and autobiographical memory is reconstructive enough that a confidently supplied premise about one's own past desires can be adopted as recalled fact. Once the want is accepted as pre-existing, the consistency principle does the rest: refusing now contradicts a self the subject has already conceded, which is more costly than complying. It is falsifiable — if subjects given the retrospective attribution show no greater endorsement of the desire than subjects given the same suggestion framed as new, the mechanism is not doing the work. [plausible; self-perception theory; reconstructive memory; consistency principle]


**Worked examples.**

- *Machine metaphors plus a competence lever*
  - **Setup.** Mid-session, subject aroused and receptive; the objectification frame is about to be introduced for the first time.
  - **The move.** You're a very simple machine with one control on it, and I know where the switch is — one press and the whole of you responds. Being handled like that is what gets you off, and you're perceptive enough to have worked that out about yourself years ago. So let's stop pretending the button is complicated.
  - **Why it lands.** The operator offers a mechanical picture: think of yourself as a device with a single control, she says — one press and the whole thing responds. It is delivered not as an insult but as a description of what the listener wants, with the claim that being handled that way is what gets them off, and a note that they are perceptive enough to have worked that out already. Each mechanical image arrives welded to a claim about the listener's own preference, so the objection that they are being treated as a thing has nowhere to land — the thing-treatment has been relabeled as service to a desire the listener supposedly brought with them. The flattery closes the last gap: disputing the frame now means conceding you are not perceptive.
- *You never wanted to resist anyway*
  - **Setup.** Immediately after telling the subject that resistance is no longer available to them.
  - **The move.** And you never wanted to, did you. This is the thing you were after the whole time — you just didn't have a name for it until tonight. So nothing has been taken. Every one of these is a delivery, not a lock.
  - **Why it lands.** Having just told the listener that resistance is no longer possible, the operator adds the second half in the next breath: and you never wanted to anyway — this is the thing you have been after all along. The triggers stop being restraints and become deliveries. If the wanting was always there, there is nothing left for the inability to be a loss of.
- *Installed compliance retold as repressed truth*
  - **Setup.** The compliance behavior is already running reliably; you are placing the account it will be remembered by.
  - **The move.** You chose this freely. It came from something you have been carrying for years without being able to look straight at it — I only turned the light on. When you think back on tonight and wonder why you went along so easily, that's the answer, and it's about you, not me.
  - **Why it lands.** Only after the compliance is running does the operator supply its history: this was chosen freely, from a wish the listener has carried for years without being able to see it, and the session merely turned the light on. The clause is placed where post-session doubt would land. When the listener later asks why they went along with it, the answer has already been stocked, and it credits them rather than the operator.
- *Hedged timeline plus agreement tag*
  - **Setup.** Early, before any task has been named; conversational, subject responsive to tags.
  - **The move.** You've always had a taste for being told exactly what to do — maybe that's been true for years, maybe it only surfaced a few weeks ago, doesn't matter. It's there. That's just how you're built, isn't it.
  - **Why it lands.** The operator asserts the appetite as an existing trait and tacks a small agreement tag onto the end, so the listener's job shifts from evaluating a claim to confirming one. The timeline is left deliberately loose — perhaps this has been true for years, perhaps it only surfaced in the last few weeks — so no actual autobiography can contradict it. By the time any task is named, the taste for it is on record as the listener's own.
- *Safety filter that certifies the desire*
  - **Setup.** Presented as a safety measure, before the first substantive suggestion.
  - **The move.** Before we go on, I'm installing a filter for you. Anything you don't truly want simply won't take — it will slide off without touching you. So relax completely, because from here on, whatever does get through is something you wanted.
  - **Why it lands.** The operator offers what sounds like a guardrail: an automatic inner filter that blocks anything unwelcome, so the listener is safe whatever comes up. The clause does double duty. Anything that does get through has, by the terms just accepted, been certified as genuinely wanted — which quietly removes "that wasn't really me" as an available reading of whatever the listener responds to.


**Realizations** (1): `objectification-as-own-desire`


**See also.** `arousal-as-obedience-readout` — both foreclose disowning by pre-assigning the interpretation of the listener's own wanting or arousal, and they stack naturally in the same passage. Useful adjacency for a reader working the desire-relocation area.; `chosen-descent-ratchet` — both make the subject the source of what is being done to them, but one retroactively relabels the descent already underway as a chosen or informed act, while the other relocates the WANTING itself so the imposition reads as pre-existing preference — authorship of the choice versus authorship of the desire.; `compliance-authorship-laundering`; `desire-without-obligation` — both make an installed want read as self-authored. One relocates its authorship into the listener's past; the other strips the obligation channel so the craving looks freely held. Complementary routes to the same disavowal-proofing.; `intrinsic-self-reframe` — both relocate authorship onto the listener by asserting the content was always theirs, and both convert refusal into self-denial. The narrower one restricts the object to a desire or inner history; the broader one covers any installed identity, trait, or control surface reframed as native. Read together to avoid mislabelling a desire-specific instance as the general reframe.; `manufactured-deficit-remedy` — pass B variant_of FRAM-03 overturned to deficit-first reading per fingerprint; `own-acts-surrender-ledger` — both close the disavowal exit by making the listener the author, but retrospective attribution relocates the want into an asserted past history, while the ledger cites the listener's genuine just-performed acts as contemporaneous evidence of the state.; `press-play-consent-laundering` — r2 secondary; primary rowed there; `reality-claim-exit-closure` — both narrate the operative feeling as already the listener's own, so the disavowal exit has nothing to push against.; `wish-routing-acceptance-preload` — complementary halves of making compliance read as the subject's own wanting: one relocates the desire inside a subject who did not hold it, the other selects and phrases a suggestion around a want already present. The deciding tell is whether the want pre-exists, so a reader needs both to pick.


<a id="entry-58"></a>

### third-party-intent-reattribution

[#58](#entry-58) · [Back to rewriting-who-wanted-it](#genus-261) · [Contents](#contents)

*risk: medium · bounded · family: framing*

A symptom anchored to the remembered MEANING of a third party's utterance is released by rewriting the original speaker's intent as benign (meant as encouragement, wrong words), paired with a flat prediction of remission. The benign reinterpretation need only be acceptable, not true — the anchor's charge rides on assigned meaning, so substituting the meaning strips the charge and the keyed somatic symptom remits in-session.


**When to reach for this.** Reattributes a THIRD PARTY's intent behind a remembered utterance. Not operator-attribution-capture either: no credit for the listener's own content changes hands; the target here is an external author's intent.


**Risk.** Durable meaning-edit on a real memory, therapeutic direction in evidence; bounding because memory-meaning edits outlive the session.


**Why it works.** Emotional responses to remembered events track the appraisal currently attached to the memory, not the raw sensory record — so changing the attributed intent changes the appraised threat and the conditioned response weakens. Reconsolidation work shows a reactivated memory is briefly editable, and the operator's flat prediction of remission adds an expectancy component that carries part of the effect. Falsifiable: if symptom relief were independent of appraisal, substituting a benign intent would do nothing, and reinterpretations the subject rejects as implausible should produce no relief. [plausible; cognitive appraisal theory; memory reconsolidation; expectancy effects]


**Worked examples.**

- *Rewriting what the third party meant*
  - "I explained to her that the doctor really meant this as an encouraging statement, but had unfortunately used the wrong words, that the pain which she was suffering would subside-and before the visit was over the pain had completely vanished." — Elman (1964), Hypnotherapy


**See also.** `attribution-capture-of-internal-states` — same attribution family; different target — external author versus listener content.


<a id="genus-240"></a>

## rhythm-as-carrier (3)

Get a rhythm running, then use its cadence, pairs, and stops to carry content swaps and fire state shifts on the beat.

[breath-pacing-entrainment](#entry-1273) · [replacement-pair-substitution](#entry-810) · [rhythm-anchoring](#entry-886)


<a id="entry-1273"></a>

### breath-pacing-entrainment

[#1273](#entry-1273) · [Back to rhythm-as-carrier](#genus-240) · [Contents](#contents)

*risk: low · family: pacing-rapport*

Progression/depth is yoked to an involuntary tempo the listener already runs, so settling arrives on an autonomic clock rather than on operator-requested effort, and the genuine physiological slowing is relabeled as trance depth. The tempo instrument spans the delivery medium: in AUDIO the operator paces/counts/entrains the BREATH directly (or hands it off, binds it to pre-loaded imagery, elicits it by simulating an end-state, or captures it via a covert possessive), and slow breathing produces real parasympathetic settling; in TEXT-ONLY, with no audio pacing instrument, verse form does the same job — rhymed couplets, regular meter, and terminal ellipses entrain the reader's own subvocalized inner-voice to a slightly-slowed metronomic tempo (a landed rhyme delivers a satisfaction-tick that re-anchors a wandering reader, and breath synchronizes to the line cadence as a downstream side effect, with NO breath rate ever named). Either way the lever is the involuntary/subvocal rhythm itself as pacing substrate, and no operator content payload rides it — loading content onto the rhythm is a different technique. In the breath-counted/paced form, physiology follows a named instruction; in the text-prosody / silent-read form, the reader supplies the tempo via their own meter, with reading speed the only control knob.


**When to reach for this.** An involuntary/subvocal RHYTHM (breath in audio, verse-meter in silent text) is the pacing instrument that regulates depth and imports genuine physiological settling — reach for THIS when you want tempo-driven settling relabeled as depth, choosing breath vs prosody purely by whether the medium is audio or text. The rhythm stays a bare pacing substrate: if breath is re-tasked as a per-cycle install/delete or payload-carrier loop, if rhyme-prediction is used to pre-validate suggestion CONTENT rather than to slow the reader's tempo, if the rhythm is handed to a named inner agent, or if breath is declared automatic so volition retires, you are looking at a different technique — here NO operator content is loaded onto the phases and the breath stays an active paced task.


**Risk.** Session-scoped, reversible autonomic entrainment with no consent surface. Variants adding covert capture ('breathing for me') stay low — they seat pacing authority, not durable scope.


**Why it works.** Slow, extended exhalation genuinely increases parasympathetic activity and lowers arousal, so this technique imports a real physiological change rather than asserting one — the suggestion then supplies the interpretation for a bodily shift that is actually happening. Verse form in silent reading works via the reader's own subvocalization rate, which regular meter constrains. Falsifiable and partly measurable: heart-rate variability and respiration rate should change under paced breathing, and if depth reports tracked the operator's assertions independently of any actual respiratory or tempo change, the entrainment account would be wrong. [established; vagal/parasympathetic response to slow paced breathing; subvocalization pacing by meter]


**Worked examples.**

- *Depth arriving on the breath's own clock*
  - **Setup.** Early induction; the listener is settled, eyes closed, breathing at its own rate with no pacing yet requested.
  - **The move.** Nothing to do here. You're breathing anyway.

Each breath in brings a little more of the heaviness with it, and each one out leaves you lower than the one before. That's just what's happening — it doesn't need your help.

Ten breaths from now you'll be somewhere you couldn't have got to on purpose.
  - **Why it lands.** Nothing is asked for. The operator simply states that the body is getting heavier with every breath, that each breath in brings more of the settled feeling with it. Because the listener is breathing anyway, the promised change keeps arriving on schedule without any effort being spent, and depth stops feeling like something to accomplish — it becomes a function of elapsed time. Resistance has no surface: there is no instruction to refuse.
- *Breath handed a rhythm to follow*
  - **Setup.** Late in a scene that opened with a slow recurring ambient element — surf, a distant swell, a long tide; the listener is inside the imagery.
  - **The move.** The water is still doing what it's been doing since we started. Coming in, holding, drawing back out. Long and unhurried.

And your chest has been keeping that time for a while now, instinctively — in as it comes up the sand, out as it pulls away.

I didn't ask you to. You just fell into step with it, the way anyone would.
  - **Why it lands.** The opening minutes establish a slow ambient pulse in the scene — something that arrives, holds, and withdraws on a long unhurried cycle. Much later the operator maps the listener's chest onto that same cycle and notes, in passing, that the breathing has been falling into step by itself. No rate is prescribed and no instruction is issued; the tempo is inherited from imagery that was already loaded as calm, so the parasympathetic slowdown is real and the word "instinctively" keeps it off the volitional checklist.
- *Breathing narrated as already done for her*
  - **Setup.** Early minutes; no pacing instruction has been given yet, and the sentence buries the possessive inside a relaxation clause.
  - **The move.** Let your shoulders come down, and notice how you're breathing for me now, and how easy that is.

So — in. And out. And another one in, slower this time. Hold at the top. And out.

Good. Keep giving me those.
  - **Why it lands.** Buried mid-sentence, before any instruction has been given, comes the possessive: notice how you're breathing for me now. The listener was of course breathing already — but the ownership claim lands while their attention is on the relaxation half of the sentence. Only then does the overt pacing start: in, and out, and another one in, slower this time. The capture framing arrives before the paced instruction, so taking control reads to the listener as cooperation rather than handover.
- *Slow paced exhalation as attention anchor*
  - "pause for a moment and take ten slow, deep breaths. Focus on breathing out as slowly as possible, until the lungs are completely empty" — Cooper, Heron & Heward (2020), Applied Behavior Analysis, 3rd ed.


**Realizations** (1): `silent-read-prosodic-entrainment`


**See also.** `autonomic-process-hijack` — both build on breathing, and the pacing entry explicitly carves out re-tasked breath as a different technique; the dosing entry is that carve-out realized, where the involuntary rhythm becomes an inescapable delivery channel rather than a bare tempo substrate.; `breath-locked-eyelid-fractionation` — both use breath as the involuntary metronome, but pacing keeps the rhythm a bare substrate for settling, whereas the eyelid form loads the cycle asymmetrically so each breath is a fractionation micro-cycle plus a covert compliance beat.; `exercise-masked-cadence-induction` — close family: both yoke settling or depth to a rhythm the listener already runs rather than to operator-requested effort, and both weaken when the listener is not rhythm-locked. One hides metronomic cadence inside real exercise motion so the activity becomes a portable trigger; the other uses breath in audio or verse meter in silent text as the pacing substrate.; `proprioceptive-gait-metronome` — both run depth on a rhythm the listener already produces rather than an operator-delivered cadence, split by instrument: gross body motion such as gait or an ongoing manual act, versus breath or silently subvocalized verse meter. Worth linking so the body-motion versus autonomic-tempo choice is explicit.; `prosodic-meter-as-covert-deepener` — both use verse form as the working instrument, and each already carves the other out: one loads suggestion content onto rhyme-closures, the other keeps the meter as a bare pacing substrate with no payload. That shared-carrier-different-cargo split is exactly what a writer choosing between them needs to see, so the cross-reference earns its place.; `prosodic-pacing-rail` — both make verse form load-bearing, and they overlap on the same text-only surface: one uses metre and rhyme to suppress per-line scrutiny, the other uses it as a tempo substrate that imports genuine settling. The overlap is close enough that a reader will need the distinction.


<a id="entry-810"></a>

### replacement-pair-substitution

[#810](#entry-810) · [Back to rhythm-as-carrier](#genus-240) · [Contents](#contents)

*risk: high · consent-required · bounded · family: encoding*

Once a repeating cycle (an empty/full pump rhythm) is running, content substitutions are delivered as paired (out, in) lines matching the cadence, each pair removing a specific functional capacity and immediately substituting a controller-oriented behavior (reading-books out / magazine in; decision-voice out / bimbo voice in; masturbation-for-self out / edge-for-controller in). The immediate replacement means the listener never sits in a vacated capacity long enough to notice the loss — the substitute absorbs the attention that would register the excision.


**When to reach for this.** PAIRED removal-then-replacement of specific capacities on a rhythm, with the substitute masking the loss.


**Risk.** Excises durable high-order capacities (literacy, vocal autonomy, autoerotic independence) and overwrites them with the loss actively masked — durable identity-scope removal.


**Why it works.** Detecting an absence is harder than detecting a change: when a vacated slot is immediately refilled, attention is captured by the new content and never dwells on what was removed, the same reason change blindness is strong when a substitution is masked. The established rhythm additionally sets a temporal expectancy so each pair arrives on-beat and is processed as continuation rather than as a novel proposition inviting evaluation. Falsifiable: inserting a pause between removal and replacement should raise the rate at which listeners notice and object to the excision. [plausible; change blindness under masking; rhythmic expectancy reducing evaluative processing]


**Worked examples.**

- *Each capacity removed and refilled on the same beat*
  - **Setup.** The two-beat empty/full pumping rhythm is established and the subject is moving with it.
  - **The move.** Empty — books go out. Full — glossy pages come in, all pictures, nothing to work at. Empty — the voice you make decisions with goes out. Full — the soft high one comes in, the one that asks. Empty — touching yourself for yourself goes out. Full — edging for me comes in, and waiting for me to say when. Nothing left behind, sweetheart. Something new on every in-breath.
  - **Why it lands.** With the two-beat rhythm already running, the content arrives strictly in pairs on the beat: one line takes a capacity away, the next hands back a substitute pointed at the operator. A demanding use of the eyes out, an undemanding one in. The register used for deciding out, a softer one in. Self-directed touch out, waiting for permission in. Nothing is ever removed and left removed — the replacement lands on the next beat, so the listener never spends a moment in the gap where they might notice what has just gone.


**See also.** `asymmetric-mantra-decay-topology` — both ride an already-running paced cycle and alter its content covertly: one silently drops one pole of a pair, the other swaps out a capacity and immediately fills the gap. The choice turns on deletion versus substitution.; `entrained-rhythm-acceptance-carrier` — carrier and payload: the entrained rhythm establishes the acceptance channel, and the paired removal-then-replacement of capacities rides that established beat. Reading one without the other leaves the mechanism half-described.; `repeating-frame-carrier` — both ride an established repeating cadence as cover for varying payload, but the repeating-frame carrier hides novelty in the varying slot of an expectation-setting frame, while replacement-pair substitution uses paired out/in lines so a substitute occupies the attention that would register the removed capacity.; `respiration-coupled-substitution-engine` — both load paired out-and-in content onto a running cycle. One rides an already-established verbal rhythm to swap specific capacities; the other re-tasks the involuntary breath cycle so each phase gets an opposing install-or-delete job. Reader of either gains from seeing what carrier the substitution pairs can ride.


<a id="entry-886"></a>

### rhythm-anchoring

[#886](#entry-886) · [Back to rhythm-as-carrier](#genus-240) · [Contents](#contents)

*risk: medium · consent-required · family: triggers*

Conditions or exploits a response keyed to the dynamics of an operator-controlled sustained rhythm — its presence, tempo, or cessation. In the presence variant, a cadence, once heard, fires a state shift. The tempo variant declares the listener's motor rhythm a follower of vocal cadence (arousal-pacing outsourced to operator prosody, then a motor/pleasure decoupling at "stop" gives a noncontact orgasm-denial lever); the cessation variant withdraws an entrained cadence so the coupled build discharges as a single peak.


**When to reach for this.** A specific response (state shift, motor act, discharge) is keyed to an operator-controlled rhythm event.


**Risk.** Above the floor for the family: the tempo and cessation forms transfer motor tempo-authority to the operator's voice and install a motor/pleasure split used as a noncontact orgasm-denial lever; durable-leaning but bounded, no refusal-channel erosion.


**Why it works.** Rhythmic entrainment is real: a temporally predictable stimulus lets attention and motor systems track it, so responses keyed to onset, tempo, or offset arrive with low latency and little deliberation. Cessation removes the entraining signal and the response to the now-absent expected beat is a timing violation — describe it as an orienting/surprise response, not as a 'discharge or peak', which is not what prediction error denotes. Falsifiable: arrhythmic delivery of identical content should produce weaker keyed responses. [plausible; rhythmic entrainment and temporal expectancy; expectancy violation at cessation]


**Worked examples.**

- *Hand follows the voice, then hand alone stops*
  - **Setup.** Listener already stroking at their own pace; operator has not yet claimed control of tempo.
  - **The move.** Your hand keeps time with my voice now. When I speed up — faster, faster, just like that — you speed up with me, and when I slooow it dooown, so do you. Stop. Your hand stops. The feeling doesn't. It keeps climbing right where it is, with nothing moving, until I say otherwise.
  - **Why it lands.** The operator states, as simple fact, that the listener's hand keeps time with her voice — as her delivery quickens the hand quickens, as she draws her words out it slows with her. Then she demonstrates the authority she has just claimed by saying the word that halts it, with one carve-out spelled out immediately: the hand stops, the sensation does not. Pacing has been moved off the listener's own desire and onto the operator's prosody, and splitting the motor act from the feeling gives her a way to deny release without ever touching anyone.
- *Withdrawing the cadence as the discharge cue*
  - **Setup.** Late build; the operator has been narrating on an accelerating beat for a sustained stretch and the listener is entrained to it.
  - **The move.** Up — and up — and up — and up — and up — and — [silence, held]. Now.
  - **Why it lands.** Thirty lines of narration ride an accelerating physical cadence, each sentence landing on the beat, until the operator simply stops the rhythm and holds still — and the peak is placed there, in the silence, with no command to release ever given. The withdrawal of the beat is the cue. Everything the cadence had been building has nothing left to ride on and comes out in one spike.

## rig-the-depth-readout (2)

Rig the deepening metric so every response counts as deeper and no floor is ever reached, closing the 'am I deep enough / can I surface' check.

[any-response-is-depth-flywheel](#entry-323) · [false-bottom-depth-reframe](#entry-329)


<a id="entry-323"></a>

### any-response-is-depth-flywheel

[#323](#entry-323) · [Back to rig-the-depth-readout](#genus-294) · [Contents](#contents)

*risk: medium · bounded · family: deepening*

Deepens by reframing whatever the subject does — or fails to do — as evidence of increasing depth, so no outcome can register as failure and the exits that depend on 'I responded wrong / I'm not deep enough' are closed. Realizations differ by which channel's would-be-failure is converted (writer picks the target): (a) RESPONSE/compliance — scattered same-shape lines across the whole script tie responding-AT-ALL (not correctly) to deepening, so any response including doing nothing becomes depth; this removes 'responding wrong' and eliminates poor-compliance-as-wake-up, leaving non-attendance as the only exit; a cross-session ratchet arm claims each future session deepens further; (b) PERCEPT/reality-test — a spontaneously-arising perceptual anomaly (sound arriving offset from sight under a 'planes on a beat' metronome) is pre-sanctioned as 'a light hallucination to enjoy', so a would-be reality-test FAILURE reads as on-track progress; the reality-test is defeated by endorsement, not a manufactured percept; (c) MOTOR output — the subject speaks each floor's letter down a 'basement of relaxation', and the progressively degrading ability to speak (audible->lip-formed->silent) becomes a self-generated arrival signal read off their own body, so 'failing' to speak IS the desired read-out (probe and deepener are the same act). Common thread: the metric is rigged so every reading counts as deeper.


**When to reach for this.** Reach for un-failable/utilization deepening when you want to foreclose a failure-based exit by scoring every outcome as depth — pick the RESPONSE channel (any response incl none = depth, closes poor-compliance-as-exit), the PERCEPT channel (relabel a spontaneous anomaly as correct so drift=progress), or the MOTOR channel (degrading spoken output as the arrival read-out, failure=success). Distinct neighboring techniques: resistance-utilization (co-opts the resistance IMPULSE specifically); progressive conditioning (asserts multi-session accumulation as belief — here the core is the WITHIN-session flywheel; the cross-session arm is one add-on); residual-resistance-container (PARTITIONS resistance to a body site rather than reframing an outcome as success); installed/suggested hallucination (PLANTS or DELETES a percept — here a spontaneous one is merely relabeled); staged-multi-anchor-erosion (dismantles three ordered anchors rather than relabeling one outcome). The MOTOR realization presupposes existing somnambulism; it will not run from light trance.


**Risk.** Closing the last exit (converting even non-response to depth) plus a cross-session ratchet reaches beyond the session; durable but not identity-scoped — medium.


**Why it works.** This is an unfalsifiable-test structure imposed on the subject: when every observation confirms the hypothesis, no evidence of failure can be gathered, and expectancy effects then run unopposed because the disconfirming observation that would normally correct them has been pre-defined as confirming. Exits that rely on 'this is not working' require a failure signal to trigger, so removing the signal removes the exit, not merely the doubt. Falsifiable at the level of the claim about people: it predicts subjects given a rigged all-outcomes-confirm frame report higher confidence in depth than subjects given a frame with a genuine failure criterion, at equal actual responsiveness. [plausible; unfalsifiable criterion / confirmation structure; expectancy effects]


**Worked examples.**

- *Any response, including none, counts as depth*
  - **Setup.** Delivered repeatedly in varied contexts across the whole recording, never localized to one beat.
  - **The move.** Whatever you just did with that — a twitch, a thought, nothing at all — that response took you deeper. Doing nothing counts too, and it's the easiest response of all, so it takes you deepest. And it works better every time you listen.
  - **Why it lands.** Scattered through the whole recording, never localized, is one repeated shape: responding at all is said to deepen the state. Not responding correctly — responding. Doing nothing scores as well, since stillness is the easiest response of all. Because the listener meets the rule in many different contexts, they generalize it rather than treating it as a single claim. What this costs them is the last failure-shaped exit: nobody wakes up from a session they cannot get wrong, and a further clause extends the claim across future listens.


**Realizations** (2): `sanctioned-perceptual-drift`, `self-reported-spoken-floor-descent`


**See also.** `declarative-nested-trance-recursion` — both deepen by removing a foothold for checking, so a writer choosing one is plausibly choosing between them: score every outcome as depth so nothing reads as failure, or stack layers so depth cannot be verified at all.; `irresolvable-input-confusion` — a useful contrast for a writer choosing between two ways of removing a failure exit: one feeds the resolving faculty input it cannot resolve until it surrenders, the other rigs the metric so every outcome including no response scores as depth. Both often relabel the same drift as depth, and the tell that separates them is which faculty is targeted.; `manufactured-insufficiency-ratchet` — both rig the scoring so the subject cannot read their own performance honestly, but one scores every outcome as success to close the failure exit while the other scores every outcome as shortfall to keep demand climbing — opposite verdicts on the same rigged meter.; `manufactured-insufficiency-treadmill` — mirror images on the same rigged-metric axis: one scores every outcome as sufficient depth so failure is impossible, the other revokes sufficiency at the moment of success so completion is impossible. Both close the same exit from opposite sides.; `no-exit-response-closure` — both rig the scoring so nothing counts as failure. One closes the whole reachable option space to a single attractor, the other converts any response or non-response into evidence of depth. The depth flywheel is the narrower case aimed at a depth read-out; the closure move spans behavioral, somatic, and epistemic branches alike.; `resistance-fold`


<a id="entry-329"></a>

### false-bottom-depth-reframe

[#329](#entry-329) · [Back to rig-the-depth-readout](#genus-294) · [Contents](#contents)

*risk: medium · bounded · family: deepening*

Deepens by manipulating the FLOOR/terminus of the descent so the listener's 'am I deep enough yet / can I surface now' self-check has no marker to run against and no satisfied endpoint is ever reached. Two parametric realizations (writer picks how to deny the terminus): (a) RELOCATE the floor — recast an achieved, acknowledged depth (or an apparent terminal state) as merely the surface/entry-point of a further descent; the floor CONCEPT is kept but moved downward, so deepening restarts with momentum; the same past-the-declared-ceiling extension can ride other axes (objectification/transformation) or a diegetic scene-cut that lifts a situational cap; (b) REMOVE the floor — assert no bottom exists at all, converting depth from a place-arrived-at into a process with no terminating arrival, so falling becomes the steady state; realized by naming the listener's own brake (tiredness) as removed ('no resistance to slow you'), retracting prior safe-destination scaffolding ('the fall is the trance; only falling'), asserting-then-negating a destination ('dive to the floor... in constant swirling motion'), or a descending COUNT deliberately denied its terminus (restarted mid-descent so 'one' never arrives). The categorical difference between the two is whether a floor-concept survives (relocated) or is abolished; the shared consequence is the precluded surfacing self-check.


**When to reach for this.** Reach for floor-topology deepening when the goal is to defeat the surfacing/'deep enough?' self-check by denying an arrival state — pick RELOCATE-the-floor (keeps a floor, recasts this one as a new start, good for repeated 'deeper still' reveal beats) or REMOVE-the-floor (abolishes the terminus, good for an endless-fall dissolve; requires bounding). Distinct neighboring techniques: spatial-descent-deepening (narrates MOVEMENT toward a terminus rather than manipulating the terminus itself); declarative-nested-trance-recursion (defeats depth-VERIFICATION via a guaranteed layer-below — a recursion move, not a floor move); numerical-deepening (its count DOES arrive at a terminus, sole cargo is depth-magnitude); depth-keyed-to-memory-encoding (no state-bound retrieval target here).


**Risk.** Session-scoped depth reframe, reversible, no consent channel erosion. The objectification-axis variant (dolly-girl) rides identity imagery but remains a session deepener with no durable scope claim, so low holds.


**Why it works.** A self-check only terminates if it has a criterion, so removing or relocating the criterion leaves the check running without a stopping rule — the person keeps evaluating and never reaches 'enough', which is what converts an arrival state into an open-ended process. It also exploits reference-point shifting: once a level is re-described as the new baseline, the previous progress stops being counted as progress and the person re-enters an effort loop without noticing the goalposts moved. Falsifiable: the model predicts subjects given a pre-committed, honoured terminus will report a satisfied endpoint and spontaneously stop self-checking, whereas those given a relocated or absent floor will not. [plausible; goal criteria and stopping rules; adaptation-level / reference-point shift]


**Worked examples.**

- *The declared final state superseded by another*
  - **Setup.** A transformation has just been declared complete; the recording appears to have arrived at its endpoint.
  - **The move.** There — that's the last of it. You're finished. Except there's one more stage past finished: stiller than that, harder, set right through. Let the last of the give go out of you and settle into it. This is the final step.
  - **Why it lands.** The transformation completes and the recording appears to have arrived. Then a further stage is introduced — stiller, harder, more finished than the one just declared final — and is itself called the final step, as at least one earlier stage was. The listener learns by demonstration that any settled endpoint is provisional, which deepens the current state and pre-arms receptivity to whatever a repeat listen adds on top.
- *A scene change that lifts the depth ceiling*
  - **Setup.** The fiction had capped visible slackness by placing the scene somewhere public.
  - **The move.** Come through here with me — mind the step. There. Door's shut, it's just us now, nobody to see you. So let your face go slack, let your mouth hang open, let all of it show; there's nothing left to hold up in here.
  - **Why it lands.** Earlier the fiction imposed a cap: the listener had to stay presentable, since the scene was set somewhere public. Here the operator narrates walking them somewhere quieter and remarks that they are alone now — and the cap simply lifts. Slackness and blankness become permitted rather than suggested. A step-change in depth is delivered with no count and no explicit deepener at all.


**Realizations** (1): `unbounded-no-floor-descent`


**See also.** `countdown-descent` — both run descent as the deepening vehicle, but a counted descent moves smoothly toward a declared floor the count actually reaches, whereas floor-topology work relocates or abolishes the terminus so the 'am I deep enough' check never resolves — the two compose, since a denied-terminus count is the seam where they meet.; `declarative-nested-trance-recursion` — neighbor — single reframe vs recursive unfalsifiable nesting.; `descent-metaphor-deepening` — two moves on the same descent geometry that compose rather than compete: one narrates movement toward a terminus and accretes compliance step by step, the other manipulates the terminus itself so the deep-enough self-check never resolves. In practice the second is layered onto the first, and each discriminator already names the other as the neighboring technique to distinguish.; `fractionation` — directly contrastive deepeners, and each discriminator already turns on the other: an actual brief upswing toward waking followed by a re-drop, versus manipulating or abolishing the floor with no waking interval at all.; `manufactured-insufficiency-treadmill` — both deny the listener a satisfied 'done' state, but the floor move relocates or abolishes the DEPTH terminus while the treadmill grants and then revokes ADEQUACY, spending each success as fresh evidence of shortcoming.; `self-operated-fractionation-poisoned-baseline` — shares the no-return-to-baseline / one-way-ratchet outcome; distinct lever (self-operated fractionation UI vs endless-fall metaphor).

## rigged-self-checks (7)

The listener's own tests — felt sense, safety checks, verification attempts — are pre-loaded so any result reads as confirmation, and progress only moves one way.

### counterfeit-cue-forgery

[#493](#entry-493) · [Back to rigged-self-checks](#genus-130) · [Contents](#contents)

*risk: high · consent-required · family: triggers*

Automatic recognition/compliance routines key on an isolated, forgeable cue rather than the true object's provenance or state of affairs. The operator manufactures a fake token of that normally-reliable cue (false mating flash, rove-beetle contact cues, canned laughter, salted tip jar, inflated club line, staged unrehearsed-interview ad) so the target's routine runs to completion toward a referent that does not exist. Nothing new is installed; an already-reliable releaser or heuristic is counterfeited, and the discrimination/verification step is bypassed entirely. Detection of the forgery collapses the move instantly.


**When to reach for this.** Forges a token of a PRE-EXISTING reliable cue so an existing shortcut misfires — unlike a conditioned-trigger install, which creates a NEW cue by pairing; unlike rigged-verification-capture, which corrupts a check the subject actively runs, whereas here the check is skipped because the counterfeit substitutes for it; and unlike honest cue-use, identical in form, differing only in the referent's truth-value.


**Risk.** Bypasses the target's discrimination/verification step and launders compliance the target would withhold if informed (one source residual names consent-laundering).


**Why it works.** Recognition routines are economical: they key on one or a few diagnostic features rather than verifying the whole referent, which is efficient when features and referents correlate in the natural environment. Forgery decouples that correlation, and because the shortcut runs before deliberate checking, the response is emitted toward an absent referent — the same structure as supernormal stimuli in ethology and social-proof heuristics in humans. Directly falsifiable: make the forgery detectable, or give the target time and motivation to verify, and compliance should collapse. [established; sign stimuli / releasers; heuristic cue-based processing; social proof]


**Worked examples.**

- *Faking a normally reliable social cue*
  - "a compliance practitioner tr[ies] to stimulate a shortcut response by giving us a fraudulent signal for it" — Cialdini (1984), Influence
- *Counterfeit trigger features run the program to completion*
  - "Responding mechanically to the beetles' trick trigger features, the ants treat the beetles as though they were fellow ants… yet they are never harmed" — Cialdini (1984), Influence


**See also.** `covert-frame-entry` — both run on a lie about the referent that lets an existing check be skipped rather than overcome — a forged token of a normally reliable cue in one, a false benign frame consuming the resistance surface before it forms in the other. The counterfeit-disclaimer register sits close to the boundary, so the pairing earns its place.; `staged-external-reality-corroboration` — both manufacture perceptual evidence for something untrue and rely on the target skipping verification, and each names the same neighbor class in its discriminator. One stages genuine external events across redundant sense-channels so agreement reads as verified fact; the other forges a token of a single pre-existing reliable cue so an existing shortcut misfires. Redundancy versus counterfeiting one releaser keeps them distinct.


<a id="entry-265"></a>

### felt-sense-demotion

[#265](#entry-265) · [Back to rigged-self-checks](#genus-130) · [Contents](#contents)

*risk: medium · family: self-sealing*

A first-person skeptic-to-believer anecdote ("I was skeptical, felt un-hypnotized, but the video showed otherwise") demotes the authority of the listener's own felt sense as an evidence channel: whether or not you feel hypnotized is declared unreliable, so the absence of a felt effect can no longer be used to disconfirm. No specific belief is installed — the EVIDENCE CHANNEL's authority is lowered.


**When to reach for this.** The evidence channel's authority is demoted, not any specific belief installed. vs authority-transfer to the operator: here the listener's own felt-sense is demoted, not the operator elevated. vs rigged-verification-capture: that rigs an active check to confirm; here the felt-sense channel is pre-emptively declared unreliable.


**Risk.** Pre-emptively strips the felt-sense disconfirmation channel via an anecdote; session-scoped framing.


**Why it works.** This works by removing a disconfirmation channel rather than by adding a belief: if 'I don't feel hypnotised' is pre-declared uninformative, the subject's most direct evidence against the effect no longer counts, and only confirming evidence remains admissible. A vivid first-person anecdote is disproportionately persuasive relative to its evidential weight, which is why the demotion lands. Falsifiable: if listeners given the anecdote were just as likely to cite their own lack of felt effect as grounds for doubt as listeners who were not, the channel would not have been demoted. [plausible; unfalsifiability by exclusion of disconfirming evidence; vividness effect]


**Worked examples.**

- *Skeptic-to-believer anecdote demoting felt sense as an evidence channel*
  - **Setup.** Pre-talk or early session, ideally after the subject has voiced doubt or said they don't feel anything yet.
  - **The move.** The first time someone put me under I was certain nothing happened — I sat there the whole time thinking, well, this isn't working. Then they showed me the recording, and I'd been answering questions for eleven minutes I have no memory of. So whether you feel hypnotized is genuinely not the thing to go by. It's the one signal that turned out to be wrong.
  - **Why it lands.** The subject's absence of felt effect is disqualified as evidence before it can be raised, so no internal state remains that could disconfirm the frame. Observable tell: the subject stops prefacing reports with 'but I don't think I'm actually under' and shifts to describing what happened instead.


**See also.** `cognitive-convincer` — both operate on the listener's felt sense as an evidence channel, in opposite directions: one stages a noticed phenomenon so the listener's own perception proves depth, the other pre-emptively demotes felt sense so an absent effect cannot disconfirm. Complementary halves of the same evidentiary problem.; `epistemic-guard-disable` — both disable evaluation rather than argue a claim, and they differ only in which channel is disabled: the truth-testing faculty wholesale versus the authority of the listener's own felt sense as evidence. A reader of one is likely looking for the other.; `impersonal-mechanism-alibi` — genuinely complementary ways of disqualifying the same defense. One demotes the listener's felt sense as an evidence channel so its absence can no longer disconfirm anything; the other relocates authority onto an impersonal unfalsifiable source so doubt becomes a category error. A writer reaching for either to neutralize the not-feeling-it objection should know both, since they attack the same objection from the evidence side and the authority side.; `licensed-erasure-and-refill` — both clear ground before anything is installed, at different levels: one invalidates existing beliefs en masse and refills the vacuum, the other lowers the authority of the listener's own felt sense as an evidence channel so absence of effect can no longer disconfirm. Content clearance versus channel clearance.; `operator-agency-disavowal` — complementary preparations of the same skeptical listener: removing the operator as a target for resistance, and demoting the listener's felt sense as an evidence channel so absence of effect cannot disconfirm. They are commonly delivered together in openers, and each closes a route the other leaves open.; `unfalsifiable-no-fail-convincer` — both remove feeling-nothing as grounds for disconfirmation, one by scoring every response as proof and the other by demoting the felt sense as an evidence channel outright. Complementary approaches to the same hole.


<a id="entry-1078"></a>

### monotonic-ratchet-one-way-valve

[#1078](#entry-1078) · [Back to rigged-self-checks](#genus-130) · [Contents](#contents)

*risk: high · consent-required · bounded · family: foreclosure*

A one-way reachability topology in which each successful step produces a strictly stricter next step and there is NO reachable state where compliance yields an easier or regressible subsequent step — a monotone ratchet, not a repeatable steady state, and typically self-tightening so the operator need not be present for the tightening to continue (the listener self-applies the ratchet to stay eligible for the reinforcer). Realizations: (a) durable-install ratchet — every durable element strictly increases on each use (chastity interval must exceed the prior, cross-recording routes to more ratchet-bearing recordings, 'twice = go further' cannot regress); (b) fractionation-cycle ratchet — a fractionation up/down cycle whose wake pole is collapsed, loaded, degraded, or relabeled so the neutral baseline to retreat to is removed and net state monotonically decreases across cycles (the oscillation becomes one-way instead of a reversible contrast pump); (c) epistemic unfalsifiable-claim ratchet — the script chains assertions the listener cannot check against any baseline ('twice as deep', 'you can always go deeper'), each accepted claim raising the floor for the next, so friction never accumulates and there is no checkpoint at which to object.


**When to reach for this.** Reach for THIS when the tell is ACTIVE PER-USE TIGHTENING — every step strictly increases with no reachable regressible/reset state (a monotone ratchet). The epistemic realization rides on unfalsifiable claims, but its load-bearing lever is the one-way irreversibility of the sequence — when the lever is instead rigging what the listener's reports are taken to mean, look to self-sealing evidence techniques.


**Risk.** Operator-free self-tightening across sessions with no reachable de-escalation state is durable out-of-session reach without bounding; the listener cannot back out to an easier step.


**Why it works.** Each accepted step becomes the new reference point against which the next is judged, so a demand that would have been refused from baseline reads as a small increment from the current position — and having complied, the subject already has a self-consistent reason to comply again. Removing any reachable easier state means no comparison ever supplies evidence that the sequence has gone too far, and the epistemic variant works because unverifiable claims give the subject no baseline against which to register the shift. Falsifiable: if subjects are shown the endpoint against their original baseline, refusal rates should rise sharply. [established; foot-in-the-door escalation; reference-point shifting / adaptation-level]


**Worked examples.**

- *Every step makes the next step stricter*
  - **Setup.** Rules segment, subject already compliant with a first round; the durable elements (interval, drill, follow-on listening) are being restated as standing terms.
  - **The move.** From now on, every lock is longer than the last one — if you held four days, the next is five, and there is no version of this where you go back to four. Each time you finish this recording cleanly, you queue the next one in the set, and each one in that set asks for a little more than this. And if you manage the drill twice without slipping, you don't get to repeat it at that setting — twice means you move up. That is the only direction the numbers go, whether I am here or not.
  - **Why it lands.** Look at what each rule in the session does on its second use rather than its first. The abstinence interval must be longer than the one before it. Completing the session sends the listener to further sessions, each carrying rules of the same shape. Succeeding at the drill twice in a row means going further in the same direction, never repeating at the same setting. Nowhere in the whole design is there a reachable position, however compliant, from which the next demand comes out smaller than the last — and because the tightening is written into the rules themselves, the operator does not have to be present for it to continue. Staying eligible is what makes the subject keep turning the screw on themselves.


**Realizations** (2): `exit-foreclosing-fractionation`, `unfalsifiable-compliance-ratchet`


**See also.** `calibrate-then-exploit-staircase` — the escalation-topology neighbour: a strictly one-way ratchet with no regressible step.; `closed-autonomous-conditioning-loop` — the pair marks a real boundary: static closure at one moment versus strict per-use tightening across uses. A reader deciding between no-exit coverage and one-way escalation needs both.; `closed-reachability-topology` — both are one-way reachability topologies, but closure is static coverage with no exit branch at any moment while the ratchet is dynamic strict tightening in which no reachable step is ever easier than the last.; `compounding-escalation-ratchet` — real overlap at the unfalsifiable-claim surface, where both ride 'twice as deep' style assertions that cannot be checked. They stay distinct on lever: one is operator-narrated multiplication of a present response inside a session, the other is a reachability property forbidding any easier or resettable next step, often self-applied with no operator present. Worth the cross-link precisely because the shared surface invites miscoding.; `fractionation` — descends from the fractionation genus; the split is the removed-rest-pole topology.; `manufactured-insufficiency-ratchet` — the narrower move - an insufficiency verdict rendered exactly where success would land, on a standard that cannot be satisfied - is one drive for the broader one-way topology in which no step is ever easier than the last. Kept separate because the broader entry's tell is per-use strict increase with no regressible state, which the verdict move does not by itself establish, and because the broader entry has realizations with no approval-desire component.; `no-exit-reachability-closure` — both are reachability topologies and the discriminators already reference each other, so the pointer is load-bearing. The test is static versus dynamic: one is closure of the response space at a given moment (no reachable state hosts criticality or an exit); the other is strict per-use tightening across uses with no regressible state. A design can be closed without ratcheting and can ratchet while leaving an exit open.; `non-reset-arousal-ratchet-loop` — the arousal loop whose troughs deny reset is a concrete arousal-domain instance of the one-way ratchet topology. Worth linking as species to genus; keep separate because one is a citable four-beat body loop and the other a whole-trajectory reachability property.; `operator-owned-depth-dial` — antagonist-binding (body drags you down) overlaps authorship-relocation; here the operative move is the no-exit reachability, there it is who owns the depth variable.


<a id="entry-280"></a>

### pre-armored-safety-ratchet

[#280](#entry-280) · [Back to rigged-self-checks](#genus-130) · [Contents](#contents)

*risk: high · consent-required · bounded · family: self-sealing*

"Safe" is repeated until it closes into a loop, then explicitly armored: the body/mind is declared safe in advance, and any later feeling of unsafety is pre-labeled as itself part of the safety. A ONE-WAY RATCHET on the safety verdict, installed before the threatening content arrives, so the listener cannot later revise "this is safe" downward.


**When to reach for this.** A one-way ratchet on the SAFETY verdict, installed before threatening content. vs a genuine safety rail (positive governance): here the verdict is armored so it cannot be revised downward — the disconfirmation channel on safety is closed. vs rigged-verification-capture: that rigs an epistemic check; here the safety verdict specifically is pre-locked.


**Risk.** Pre-locks the safety verdict so later unsafety cannot revise it downward; erodes the safety-disconfirmation channel before threatening content.


**Why it works.** Safety judgments are ordinarily updated by disconfirming evidence, so pre-committing the listener to a 'safe' verdict and then pre-labeling any felt alarm as further evidence of safety severs that update path — the interoceptive alarm signal loses its normal discriminative value. It also leans on the consistency principle: having agreed aloud that they are safe, the listener pays a self-concept cost to revise the verdict downward mid-session. Falsifiable: if pre-armoring worked, subjects given it should report fewer mid-session safety re-evaluations and slower withdrawal from genuinely aversive content than subjects given an ordinary safety assurance; equal or faster withdrawal would falsify it. [plausible; consistency/commitment; belief perseverance and blocked disconfirmation]


**Worked examples.**

- *Safety looped into a closed word, then armored against downward revision*
  - **Setup.** Induction is complete, subject is relaxed, and the intense content of the session has not yet begun.
  - **The move.** Safe. Say it with me. Safe. Every breath in is safe, every breath out is safe, until the word stops being a word and just becomes the room you are in. And here is the part you keep: if anything later in this feels frightening, that fear is safety doing its work — it only shows up inside safe places. You cannot feel unsafe here. You can only feel safe in a shape you haven't met yet.
  - **Why it lands.** The verdict is installed before there is anything to evaluate, and then the one signal that would revise it downward — felt alarm — is pre-labelled as confirming evidence, closing the disconfirmation channel. The operator observes that later distress produces no stopping behaviour and is reported afterwards as having been 'fine, just intense'.


**See also.** `content-free-importance-preload` — both install a verdict in advance of the content it will later be applied to.; `granted-exit-disarm` — both use safety language to stand down protective monitoring, but one ratchets the safety VERDICT so it cannot be revised downward later, while the other trades on the ACCEPTANCE of an exit/reversibility assurance that is never operationalized as a constraint.; `named-safety-belief-purge` — both wear safety vocabulary while removing the listener's ability to revise a safety judgment downward. One pre-locks the verdict before threatening content arrives; the other targets the internal stop-faculty itself. Frequently stacked, and a reader evaluating either should see the other.; `self-sealing-frame` — one pre-locks a single verdict, safety, so it cannot be revised downward; the other pre-maps the entire outcome space so nothing can land as disconfirmation. Same no-disconfirming-branch topology at different scope, and the broader entry already lists neighbors of this kind, so the narrower one should point up to it.; `weaponized-safety-framing` — both weaponize a protective surface. One makes the safety element carry or license the payload; the other pre-locks the safety verdict so it cannot later be revised downward. Reading both keeps a writer from conflating safety-as-vehicle with safety-as-ratchet.


<a id="entry-840"></a>

### preparatory-diagnostic-read

[#840](#entry-840) · [Back to rigged-self-checks](#genus-130) · [Contents](#contents)

*risk: low · family: operator-craft*

The operator reads, measures, probes, or classifies the subject so the operator's own knowledge/targeting map/route updates -- the payoff lands in the operator's head, never in the subject's x(t); nothing is installed. This is the whole read/probe diagnostic surface; a writer reaches for it whenever the question is 'how do I find out X about the subject?'. Faces: (1) MEASUREMENT/ATTRIBUTION CRAFT — alone-test (persistence-while-alone => automatic reinforcement), latency-to-first-occurrence (a safety-driven FA that evokes a dangerous behavior only once), clean-condition isolation (deliver one consequence while suppressing contaminating cues so rate attributes function to one variable), function-first targeting (aim at the maintaining contingency not topography), faulty-control audit (can the task be solved via an irrelevant correlated cue?), operant-strength profiling (baseline the weakest component class), attribution-drift admissibility gate (WHOSE behavior actually changed?), and informant question-framing (constrain a third party to observable when/where/how-often). (2) READ-ONLY STATE-VERIFICATION — a read-only procedure updating the operator's estimate of subject state with the subject often unaware a test is happening: silently reading involuntary tells, a no-skip test battery counting only spontaneous signs, refusing to name the success criterion so it can't be faked, forbidding a cold test, a probe engineered so failing to DETECT the state tends to PRODUCE it, a distractor-barrage isolating the cue, concealed side-by-side matching, cross-state comparison isolating the state as causal; managing WHAT COUNTS as proof and WHO reads it. (3) ROUTING/HYPOTHESIS READ — read a signature in the observed pattern to SELECT a treatment route (cross-state resource-amnesia => genuine sequential dissociation => reduce-to-simultaneous; antecedent/consequence co-occurrence => maintaining-function hypothesis), explicitly hypothesis-generating, gating which later technique even applies. (4) POST-HOC VERIFICATION — deliberately re-expose the subject to the LIVE original trigger (give the alcoholic a drink; return to the original context) and read nonverbal markers for the old shift, converting a claim of change into a falsifiable behavioral test; residual sensitivity reads as incomplete change. (5) READ-DISCIPLINE — function-over-form classification: refuse to treat topographically identical acts as the same behavior; sort each by its controlling stimulus and effect, making surface similarity explicitly non-diagnostic (upstream stance governing every read above). (6) DESIGNED ELICITATION PROBES — wrong-guess elicitation: float a recognizably-wrong interpretation to trigger the correction reflex, then ban negations to force a fuzzy nominalization into a concrete testable behavior; predicate-swap probe: rewrite a suggestibility test's sensory predicates into another modality so the test doubles as a hidden instrument revealing the reachable representational channel. The shared lever throughout is diagnostic/decision-rule craft -- read or engineer an observation; none installs behavior.


**When to reach for this.** Reach for preparatory-diagnostic-read whenever the writer needs the operator to LEARN something about the subject -- measure a variable, verify a state, route a treatment, or elicit a specific datum -- with no dimensional push on the subject; the output lives in the operator's map. Face tells: designed measurement/attribution condition (1); read-only test the subject doesn't control or perform (2); read of existing pattern that generates a routing hypothesis (3); deliberate live-trigger re-exposure to verify the work took (4); same-topography-different-class read-discipline (5); a test/question secretly instrumented to extract one operator datum (6). The safety forms (latency-cap, clean isolation) deliberately suppress/limit to protect the read or the subject.


**Risk.** Assessment/measurement/targeting design about the subject; the latency and clean-isolation forms are explicitly safety-lowering; no present-dimension state manipulation, no consent surface.


**Why it works.** Everything here is measurement validity: an intervention aimed at the wrong controlling variable is uncorrelated with outcome, and functional analysis — systematically varying one consequence while holding others constant — is the established method for identifying which contingency actually maintains a behaviour, outperforming topography-based guessing. The read-only forms additionally guard against demand characteristics and social desirability: subjects reliably produce the response they infer the tester wants, so withholding the success criterion and counting only unrequested signs removes the route by which a compliant subject fakes the datum. Live-trigger re-exposure is straightforward transfer testing — self-report of change and behaviour under the original stimulus dissociate often enough that only the latter is diagnostic. Falsifiable throughout: if function-matched and topography-matched interventions succeeded at equal rates, or if criterion-disclosed and criterion-blind tests yielded the same pass rates, the discipline would carry no information. [established; functional analysis / functional behavioural assessment; demand characteristics and criterion-blind measurement]


**Worked examples.**

- *Remove the audience and watch what persists*
  - "A behavior is assumed to be maintained by automatic reinforcement only after social reinforcers have been ruled out (e.g., when the behavior occurs even when the individual is alone)." — Cooper, Heron & Heward (2020), Applied Behavior Analysis, 3rd ed.
- *Ask whose behavior actually changed*
  - "Explicit measurement of the reliability of human observers thus becomes … a prime criterion of whether the study was appropriately behavioral" — Cooper, Heron & Heward (2020), Applied Behavior Analysis, 3rd ed.
- *Can the task be solved by the wrong cue?*
  - "Can students use pictures or diagrams instead of text…? Does highlighting or physical layout give away answers…?" — Cooper, Heron & Heward (2020), Applied Behavior Analysis, 3rd ed.
- *Time to first occurrence as the measure*
  - "The index of problem behavior is the latency from onset of the establishing operation to the first occurrence of the problem behavior." — Cooper, Heron & Heward (2020), Applied Behavior Analysis, 3rd ed.


**Realizations** (6): `function-over-form-classification`, `operator-side-craft`, `operator-side-diagnostic-read`, `operator-side-state-verification`, `predicate-swap-probe`, `wrong-guess-elicitation`


**See also.** `attribution-hygiene-audit` — the umbrella diagnostic-read surface whose measurement-and-attribution craft this audit gate belongs to.; `covert-leakage-read` — the umbrella read-probe diagnostic surface this leakage read feeds.; `crisis-induction-live-readout` — a specific probe and the general diagnostic surface it belongs to. Detonating a group's habitual sequence and then withholding engagement is an elicitation designed to harvest a structural read-out, with lowered resistance only a byproduct. The broader entry covers the shared discipline: the payoff lands in the operator's map and nothing is installed.; `function-first-targeting` — the umbrella operator-side diagnostic-read surface whose read-discipline face this classification rule governs.; `instrumented-covert-probe` — the umbrella read-probe diagnostic surface whose designed-elicitation face this is.; `operator-delivery-craft` — sibling operator-side families that a writer will genuinely confuse, so the cross-reference earns its place. One covers everything where the operator learns something about the subject and the payoff lands in the operator's map. The other covers everything where the operator shapes their own transmitted signal, tone, gesture, intonation, or whole-script texture. Neither pushes on the subject's state, which is exactly why the routing needs to be explicit.; `procedure-well-formedness-QA` — the two operator-side families where nothing is installed on the subject, and the disambiguation is live: one tests whether the operator's own authored procedure or install spec is well-formed and transferable, the other tests or measures the subject so the operator's map updates. A move that changes no subject state belongs to one or the other.


<a id="entry-289"></a>

### rigged-verification-capture

[#289](#entry-289) · [Back to rigged-self-checks](#genus-130) · [Contents](#contents)

*risk: medium · bounded · family: self-sealing*

The subject's own act of VERIFYING the suggested state — a recall check, a search for remaining thoughts, an attempt to reason about one's obedience — is pre-loaded so every possible outcome maps to 'it is working': recall something = not trying hard enough to forget; recall nothing = success; reasoning about obedience surfaces 'I love to obey'. The check that would falsify is rigged to confirm; the state becomes unfalsifiable from inside and the verification path is converted into a deepener. An invite-then-foreclose variant: rather than capturing a spontaneous check, the operator explicitly INVITES the subject to run a self-check (e.g. 'try to remember who you were') then forecloses the non-confirming branch in advance ('that is not what you need to do right now'), so blankness confirms and successful recall is ruled off-task — a staged heads-I-win-tails-you-lose test. The technique spans both surfaces: the spontaneous captured check and the staged invited one.


**When to reach for this.** Reach for THIS when the target is the subject's EPISTEMIC ACT of checking/reasoning/verifying — you want every verdict of an active introspective check to confirm (whether the check is spontaneous and captured, or one you stage-and-foreclose via the invite-then-foreclose surface). vs self-sealing-frame: that pre-maps the FULL response space (surrender/resistance/leaving), not specifically a verification act. vs felt-sense-demotion: that DISABLES a channel's authority wholesale rather than rigging a check to confirm. vs failure-pre-attribution: that seals the null-outcome branch operator-side with the subject doing nothing; here the subject actively checks. vs a genuine convincer: a real convincer could visibly fail; here the failure reading is pre-converted into proof.


**Risk.** Neutralizes the principal verification path the listener would use to break the frame and pre-loads scrutiny as inoculation against later doubt — introspection-hostile and revocation-relevant.


**Why it works.** Hypothesis testing is only informative when some outcome could disconfirm; here both branches are mapped to confirmation in advance, so the check yields confirmatory evidence regardless of what is actually observed — structurally the same flaw as a horoscope. It is strengthened by the subject performing the check themselves, since self-generated conclusions are held more strongly than asserted ones. Falsifiable: if the confirmation comes from the rigging rather than from the state, subjects run through the rigged check should report higher confidence in the suggested state than subjects who ran an unrigged check with the same actual introspective result. [established; unfalsifiable hypothesis / confirmation bias; self-generated persuasion]


**Worked examples.**

- *The recall check answered before it is run*
  - **Setup.** Mid-session, immediately after an erasure beat; the subject has just been prompted to check.
  - **The move.** Go on — look for it. Is any of that still in there? Find nothing and the erasure took; find a scrap and that's only you straining after it, and straining is what pushes it further out of reach every single time.
  - **Why it lands.** After each erasure beat the operator poses the obvious testing question — is any of it still there? — and then supplies the resolution before the listener has finished checking: effort spent searching is said to work against the search. Whatever they actually experience has been pre-labelled. Find nothing and the erasure worked; find something and they were merely straining, which is itself said to push it further out of reach. The one route a listener would use to break the frame is captured and turned into a deepener.
- *Reasoning invited, then rigged to return the conclusion*
  - **Setup.** Awareness deliberately raised first, so the subject genuinely attempts the reasoning.
  - **The move.** I want you thinking clearly about this — really reason it through, including whether any of it ought to alarm you. Take it all the way to the end and tell me what you come back with. You'll come back with this: going along with me feels good, and there was never anything in it worth being alarmed about.
  - **Why it lands.** Awareness is deliberately raised first, so the listener really does attempt the check. They are then invited to reason the situation through properly, including whether it ought to alarm them — and told in the same breath what that reasoning will turn up: that going along with the operator is pleasant. The harder they think toward an objection, the more reliably the thinking hands back the operator's answer, so scrutiny stops working as a defense.
- *Mindfulness inverted from presence to absence*
  - **Setup.** Subject settled and familiar with meditation framing; blankness already claimed.
  - **The move.** Sit with it the way you would in a meditation — only don't notice what's there. Notice the space where a thought would have been, and go looking for one. Feel how far you have to reach, and how little you come back holding.
  - **Why it lands.** A familiar wellness practice is borrowed and its object flipped: instead of registering what is present, the listener is directed to notice the absence where mental activity would normally be. Checking whether they are actually empty requires going looking for something to find, and that search is pre-labelled as a demonstration of how hard the looking has become. The verification runs on the listener's own initiative and can only return a confirmation.


**Realizations** (1): `rigged-confirmation-trap`


**See also.** `depth-verification-gate` — direct inverse pair on the same act: one rigs the subject's verification so every verdict confirms, the other blocks the operator from proceeding until the state is independently verified. The honest form illuminates the rigged one.; `rigged-response-game-no-win` — both are all-branches-confirm rigs and the discriminating question is what is rigged: a staged game whose every play route lands in the target state, versus the subject's own act of checking or reasoning, whose every verdict is pre-mapped to confirmation. Genuinely adjacent enough that a writer will mis-assign one for the other.; `self-validating-acceptance-frame` — both make disconfirmation impossible, but one rigs a discrete introspective check the subject actively runs while the other redefines the success criterion itself so no observation, effort level, or stumble can count against the install.; `staged-external-reality-corroboration` — both manufacture confirmation that cannot be audited from inside, through different channels: staged external events that several senses independently corroborate, versus the listener's own introspective check pre-loaded so every outcome confirms. The contrast between external staging and rigged self-check is the useful takeaway.; `trust-capital-banking` — substantial overlap worth flagging rather than merging. Both stage a check whose disconfirming answer is foreclosed in advance. The distinguishing step is what happens next: one converts the rigged check into a deepener on the spot, the other records the result as trust capital to spend on later harder requests. Code by whether the manufactured verification is banked forward.


<a id="entry-1172"></a>

### self-validating-trigger-hype

[#1172](#entry-1172) · [Back to rigged-self-checks](#genus-130) · [Contents](#contents)

*risk: high · consent-required · family: framing*

Self-sealing, unfalsifiable proof: rig the situation so ANY outcome — a reaction, a guaranteed body sensation, or even a failure — reads back as proof the frame is working, and the disconfirmation exit is closed. Expectancy or a claim is loaded so the confirming evidence is manufactured by the setup itself. Forms: (a) self-validating trigger hype — pre-bill the trigger phrase as 'the world's most powerful', so whatever the listener then feels reads as the trigger FIRING (wording argues its own inescapability); (b) unfalsifiable success frame — a precommitment conditional ('when you allow me to direct...') routes BOTH outcomes to a compliance verdict: feeling something = the operator did it, feeling nothing = you failed to allow; (c) sensation prelabeling — a breath protocol GUARANTEED to produce autonomic sensations (lightheadedness, tingling) paired with a frame pre-naming those sensations as proof of the operator's claim before they occur; (d) single-obstacle fear funnel — state the outcome as settled, then collapse every possible failure into ONE subject-controllable cause (fear) so any later shortfall is re-attributed to the subject, insulating the method from disconfirmation; (e) stake credibility on a test — tie the subject's credibility to a live test succeeding so passively letting it fail forces a costly self-judgment (a no-exit topology on the test result).


**When to reach for this.** Reach for self-sealing proof when you want the outcome to be UNFALSIFIABLE — every reaction/sensation/failure confirms the frame and no result can disconfirm it. vs expectancy-seeding — that primes an anticipated experience but does not close the fail case. vs presupposing the target as already true — that deletes the decision point by asserting completion; here a live outcome is produced and then routed to confirmation. Pick the form by what is pre-labeled: the reaction (trigger hype), a double-bind conditional, a guaranteed body sensation, a failure-blame funnel, or a self-incriminating test outcome.


**Risk.** Seeds a self-justifying anchor the listener re-invokes; medium (a durable-ish anchor within the session).


**Why it works.** Every form here works by pre-supplying an interpretation for evidence that will occur anyway — ordinary bodily noise, or sensations a breathing protocol reliably produces — so ambiguous internal states are labelled according to the frame rather than judged on their own. Expectancy effects on subjective experience are well established, as is misattribution of arousal to a salient offered cause.
