Choose it over general verbal-operant teaching (tact/mand for external objects/states): here the acquired form regulates or comments on the learner's existing utterance rather than naming a new referent, and it presupposes the primary verbal repertoire already exists. The three facets differ only by which autoclitic and by contrived-MO vs self-referential vs in-vivo capture.


**Risk.** Instructional mand-training arrangement, session/clinic-scoped and reversible; no refusal-channel erosion or durable identity scope.


**Why it works.** Verbal behaviour is shaped by its consequences like any other operant, and reinforcement is most effective when it is contingent on the specific response component and delivered immediately — which is exactly why the in-vivo capture variant reinforces the modifier alone rather than the whole utterance. The difficulty is a real one about stimulus control: the controlling stimulus is the speaker's own just-emitted covert speech, which is transient and inaccessible to the trainer, so a supplemental prompt supplies discriminative control until the natural motivating condition can take over. Falsifiable: reinforcing the whole utterance rather than the modifier component should yield slower acquisition of the modifier specifically. [established; operant conditioning; contingent reinforcement of response components; stimulus control and prompt fading]


**Worked examples.**

- *Contrive the motivation, then model the form*
  - "Teaching autoclitic mands involves capturing or creating the relevant MOs and using ABA teaching procedures"; "a louder voice or a certain phrase may function as an autoclitic mand to prompt a listener to attend better" — Cooper, Heron & Heward (2020), Applied Behavior Analysis, 3rd ed.
- *When motivation alone fails, prompt then fade*
  - "The first condition consisted of contriving the EO alone, which was ineffective... the second condition involving the contrived MO plus an indirect supplemental verbal prompt resulted in successful manding" — Cooper, Heron & Heward (2020), Applied Behavior Analysis, 3rd ed.


**Realizations** (2): `autoclitic-self-referential-control`, `in-vivo-autoclitic-capture`


<a id="entry-418"></a>

### differential-reinforcement

[#418](#entry-418) · [Back to teaching-by-reinforced-trials](#genus-134) · [Contents](#contents)

*risk: medium · family: contingency-engineering*

Change a behavior's rate by reinforcing SOMETHING OTHER than the target behavior in its problem form — its own absence/low-rate, an incompatible or alternative response, or a richer concurrent option — rather than removing all reinforcement (extinction) or delivering it free (NCR). One parametric technique across schedules (DRO/DRL/DRI/DRA + concurrent-choice); the schedule chosen sets which 'other' behavior earns reinforcement. Realizations: (DRO) reinforce the target's ABSENCE — momentary DRO samples only at an interval's end (trades suppression strength for monitoring cost), VI-DRO uses an unpredictable window, finite-license/coupon forms convert an unspent budget to bonus; a leak-guard form conditions delivery on absence of the WHOLE undesirable set and/or shortens the interval so a co-occurring substitute is not adventitiously reinforced; (DRL) reinforce the behavior's own occurrence only when its count stays at/under a criterion (spaced-responding DRL gives per-response reset feedback; interval DRL is a weaker two-stage form), keeping a desirable-in-small-doses behavior alive, optionally with a depleting token board; (DRI — differential reinforcement of incompatible behavior) reinforce a topographically INCOMPATIBLE competitor (silence vs noise, slack vs taut leash) that cannot co-occur; (DRA/FCT — functional reinforcer rerouting) a distinct deployment: a functional assessment identifies the maintaining reinforcer, then an alternative behavior is engineered to produce the SAME reinforcer more efficiently (teach a sign/card/'break' request; DNRA delivers escape for the alternative while the problem behavior gets escape extinction; an effort-undercut form makes the alternative cost less response effort); (graded concurrent choice) stage several concurrently-signaled options with graded payoffs (problem behavior pays worst but still works, task pays best) and raise the demand for the best over time; (rate-differential allocation) two concurrent schedules where the alternative pays richer/faster/more reliably so allocation shifts per the matching law, out-competing rather than blocking the problem behavior.


**When to reach for this.** Reach for DIFFERENTIAL REINFORCEMENT when you want to reduce (or replace) a behavior by paying SOMETHING ELSE — its absence/low-rate (DRO/DRL), an incompatible competitor (DRI), a same-reinforcer alternative (DRA/FCT), or a richer concurrent option — while keeping some reinforcement flowing. Choose it over: extinction (removes the reinforcer entirely, no alternative paid); NCR (delivers the reinforcer free on a time schedule with no behavioral contingency). Internal deployment fork: DRO/DRL reinforce the TARGET's own absence/low-rate; DRI/DRA reinforce a SEPARATE response class (DRA additionally requires a functional assessment and preserves the identified reinforcer, rerouting it — the one facet with a meaningfully distinct precondition); concurrent-choice/matching arms retain a degraded payoff for the problem behavior and win by relative payoff, not withholding.


**Risk.** Session-scoped rate management; reversible, no consent surface.


**Why it works.** Behaviour allocates across concurrently available options roughly in proportion to the reinforcement each yields — the matching law. That is why paying an alternative reduces the target without ever withholding reinforcement: the target's relative payoff falls even when its absolute payoff does not. The functional-assessment step matters because reinforcers are not interchangeable; an alternative only competes if it produces the same consequence the problem behaviour was producing, at lower response cost. Directly falsifiable: if allocation were insensitive to relative rather than absolute payoff, differential reinforcement would fail whenever the problem behaviour still worked at all — the graded-concurrent-choice results say otherwise. [established; matching law; functional assessment / response-effort effects]


**Worked examples.**

- *Pay the behavior only under a rate ceiling*
  - "delivers reinforcement… contingent on the number of responses within a period not exceeding a predetermined criterion." — Cooper, Heron & Heward (2020), Applied Behavior Analysis, 3rd ed.
- *The ceiling made visible as a depleting card*
  - "No additional points were awarded if more than one box was left empty, because we wanted the children to use the opportunities." — Cooper, Heron & Heward (2020), Applied Behavior Analysis, 3rd ed.
- *Reinforce absence only at the sampling instant*
  - "reinforcement is contingent on the absence of the problem behavior at the exact time each interval ends … Occurrences of the problem behavior between those moments have no effect" — Cooper, Heron & Heward (2020), Applied Behavior Analysis, 3rd ed.
- *Per-response reset tightens the feedback*
  - "The second response, however, resets the time interval, providing a consequence for the problem behavior." — Cooper, Heron & Heward (2020), Applied Behavior Analysis, 3rd ed.


**Realizations** (6): `differential-reinforcement-of-incompatible-behavior`, `functional-reinforcer-rerouting`, `graded-concurrent-choice-architecture`, `omission-contingency-leak-guard`, `omission-reinforcement-dro`, `rate-differential-allocation`


**See also.** `baseline-keyed-criterion-calibration` — the differential-reinforcement family whose criteria this calibration procedure parameterizes.; `differential-reinforcement-low-rate` — parent schedule family: DRL is the license-in-moderation arm of the differential-reinforcement parametric umbrella.; `functional-reinforcer-rerouting` — schedule-family axis: rerouting realizes the DRA arm of differential reinforcement with the maintaining reinforcer as the payoff.; `graded-concurrent-choice-architecture` — schedule-family axis: the graded menu is the concurrent-choice arm of differential reinforcement, tuned by the matching law.; `noncontingent-reinforcement` — sibling behavioral-schedule techniques that each name the other as the choice to rule out: one reinforces something other than the target behavior, the other delivers the maintaining reinforcer on a time schedule with no contingency at all. The contingency-versus-no-contingency fork is exactly the decision a reader needs.; `omission-reinforcement-dro` — parent schedule family: DRO is the reinforce-the-absence arm of the differential-reinforcement parametric umbrella.; `reinforcement-leak-proofing` — disjoint levers on the same arranged contingency: one decides that nothing outside the contingency pays, the other decides which other behaviour earns reinforcement. Both are commonly needed together and each entry already gestures at the other's territory.; `removal-from-reinforcement-timeout` — two neighbouring reduction procedures from the same behavioural family that already carve against each other on the same siblings. The time-out entry's sunset design explicitly plans migration onto the differential-reinforcement procedures, so a reader choosing a reduction method benefits from seeing both.; `shaping-successive-approximation` — shaping is differential reinforcement run with a moving criterion to build a response that does not yet exist, so a reader choosing between them needs both; the separator is direction and target, since differential reinforcement proper reduces an existing behavior by paying its absence, a competitor, or an alternative.


<a id="entry-306"></a>

### discrimination-training-differential-reinforcement

[#306](#entry-306) · [Back to teaching-by-reinforced-trials](#genus-134) · [Contents](#contents)

*risk: low · family: contingency-engineering*

Build ANTECEDENT (stimulus) control by differential reinforcement: reinforce the target response in the presence of a discriminative stimulus and withhold/degrade it in the SD's absence until responding concentrates under the SD and drops under S-delta. The cue's control is a product of the reinforcement HISTORY, not any intrinsic property; the SD is permissive (raises rate) not coercive. Realizations: (discriminative-stimulus-occasion-setting) the plain single-cue product — a cue signalling responding will now pay off; (audience-as-discriminative-stimulus) audience identity as an SD via a differential history across audiences, selecting emitted verbal content; (match-to-sample-contingency / matching-to-sample-relational-training) four-term MTS with a mandatory observing response + anti-recency rotation, so the correct comparison is conditional on the sample (a RELATION, not a fixed mapping) — the atomic trial the derived-relations harvest design is built from; (conditional-discrimination-four-term-contingency) the contingency-structure statement of that same four-term unit (sample selects which three-term unit is live); (contextual-function-selection) the five-term extension where a higher-order context cue gates WHICH conditional relation is reinforced while every relation stays live; (multiple-exemplar-concept-training) trains a concept/class boundary by reinforcing responding across varied nondefining features with non-exemplar contrast; (precursor-discrimination-training) trains discrimination of a target behavior and its ONSET to an accuracy criterion (product = a detection repertoire); (prerequisite-discrimination-gate) installs the observer's discrimination of a model's consequence first, as the bottleneck for observational learning. COMPOUND/CONVERGENT CONTROL facets (control the parts lack until they coincide): (convergent-multi-cue-control) conjunctive LRFFC control across function/feature/class; (convergent-multiple-control) a verbal antecedent stacked on a nonverbal one to DISAMBIGUATE among latent answers; (converging-cue-recall-lift) correlated cues added to LIFT a sub-threshold response a weak SD alone cannot pull; (joint-compound-stimulus-control) two already-controlling antecedents converge and the match itself becomes a new SD.


**When to reach for this.** Reach for DISCRIMINATION / STIMULUS CONTROL when you want a cue to GAIN evocative control over an already-emittable voluntary response through a reinforcement HISTORY (reinforce-in-presence / extinguish-in-absence is load-bearing). Choose it over: respondent/evaluative pairing (Pavlovian NS+US eliciting an INVOLUNTARY response — here voluntary responding is consequated); motivating-operation engineering (produces an MO / value shift, not a discriminated operant); a declared/verbal trigger install (installs a cue-response pair by declaration, no schedule); derived/generative-relations training (teaches a subset and HARVESTS untaught closure — this trains the discriminations directly, trial by trial). The compound-control facets differ only in WHY multiple antecedents are stacked: conjunctive (all must be satisfied), disambiguation (select among rival answers), weak-cue lift (pull a sub-threshold response), or convergence-as-new-SD.


**Risk.** Foundational behavioral-analytic principle from literature; no consent surface, no channel erosion, no out-of-session reach in the demonstrated material.


**Why it works.** Behaviour comes under antecedent control because organisms track which conditions predict reinforcement: reinforcing in a cue's presence and withholding in its absence makes the cue a reliable signal of payoff, and responding concentrates accordingly. The cue does not compel — it raises rate because it predicts availability, which is exactly why it loses control once the correlation with reinforcement breaks. Falsifiable and heavily replicated: response rate under the trained cue should exceed rate under S-delta and should fall toward baseline when reinforcement no longer correlates with it; the four- and five-term variants predict specifically that responding tracks the sample or context relation rather than any fixed stimulus–response mapping. [established; stimulus control / differential reinforcement; conditional discrimination]


**Worked examples.**

- *Reinforce under the cue, extinguish without it*
  - "Stimulus discrimination training entails reinforcing responses in the presence of the SD and not reinforcing responses in the presence of the S∆." — Cooper, Heron & Heward (2020), Applied Behavior Analysis, 3rd ed.
- *A second cue decides which cue is live*
  - "the response that will produce reinforcement in the presence of a particular stimulus depends on (is conditional on) the presence or absence of other stimuli" — Cooper, Heron & Heward (2020), Applied Behavior Analysis, 3rd ed.
- *Reinforcement selects the cue, not just the act*
  - "Reinforcement selects not just certain forms of behavior; it also selects the environmental conditions that in the future will evoke instances of the response class." — Cooper, Heron & Heward (2020), Applied Behavior Analysis, 3rd ed.
- *Prompt-priming seeds a first approximation*
  - "the priming procedure can initiate early response components and facilitate shaping" — Cooper, Heron & Heward (2020), Applied Behavior Analysis, 3rd ed.


**Realizations** (13): `audience-as-discriminative-stimulus`, `conditional-discrimination-four-term-contingency`, `contextual-function-selection`, `convergent-multi-cue-control`, `convergent-multiple-control`, `converging-cue-recall-lift`, `discriminative-stimulus-occasion-setting`, `joint-compound-stimulus-control`, `match-to-sample-contingency`, `matching-to-sample-relational-training`, `multiple-exemplar-concept-training`, `precursor-discrimination-training`, `prerequisite-discrimination-gate`


**See also.** `antecedent-manipulation` — both operate on antecedents, but discrimination training BUILDS a cue's evocative control through a differential reinforcement history, whereas antecedent manipulation EDITS an already-functioning situation (remove the cue, dissolve the motivating operation, preclude the topography) with no consequence applied at all.; `become-the-discriminative-stimulus` — the second is a specific relational instance of the first's general principle: a person becomes the discriminative stimulus through a history of reliably mediating a want. A reader working the interpersonal case gains from the general reinforcement-history account, and the general entry gains a concrete inter-agent realization it does not otherwise cover.; `conditioned-reinforcer-manufacture` — complementary halves of operant control — one builds a cue's ANTECEDENT evocative power through differential reinforcement, the other manufactures a CONSEQUENCE that can itself select behavior; a designer typically needs both, and the tell is which side of the three-term contingency the new stimulus occupies.; `contingency-discriminability-design` — both are about how a cue or contingency becomes detectable to the subject, and one explicitly manipulates discriminability of the reinforcement schedule while the other builds control by a reinforcement history. A reader designing stimulus control genuinely needs to know that detectability of the contingency is a separate lever they can set opaque or transparent.; `contingency-function-substrate-principles` — one is the flagship deployable contingency technique; the other is the design-principle substrate stating how a stimulus's function is assigned by arrangement, where leverage lives, and what onset a consequence needs. Reference-and-instance rather than rivals, but a reader choosing how to schedule a cue should read both.; `counterconditioning-and-cue-response-weakening` — both are cue-and-response procedures that a reader can easily mis-select between. One builds a cue's evocative control over an already-emittable voluntary response through reinforcement history. The other tears down a stimulus's control over an aversive or interfering response by pairing an incompatible state against it or severing the link. Building antecedent control and dismantling it are the two directions of the same axis, and the entries' own boundary notes lean on each other.; `derived-relations-installation` — a deliberate design-level contrast that both discriminators already carry: one trains each discrimination directly, trial by trial, and its four-term trial is the atomic unit the other is built from; the other teaches only a spanning subset and harvests untaught relations, certified under extinction probe. The link is close to mandatory for correct selection.; `dual-function-chain-stimulus` — the chain entry is built out of the same discriminative relation the stimulus-control entry trains, and already names it as its nearest boundary. Cross-reference so a reader can tell a presence/absence differential that builds one cue's control from a serial architecture where each junction is reinforcer backward and cue forward.; `impoverished-context-permission` — same antecedent stimulus-control axis — concentrating a behavior under one narrow stimulus condition via its reinforcement history.; `motivating-operation-engineering` — antecedent siblings that pair constantly in practice: one builds a cue's evocative control through a differential reinforcement history, the other shifts how much the consequence is worth right now without delivering anything.; `reinforcement-leak-proofing` — complementary levers on one contingency: one builds a cue's control by reinforcing in its presence and withholding in its absence, the other closes every path by which reinforcement reaches the behavior outside the arranged contingency. Discrimination training fails outright if the leaks are open, so a reader working on either needs the other.; `scaffold-fade-control-transfer` — adjacent halves of stimulus control: one builds cue control through a reinforce-in-presence, withhold-in-absence history; the other moves existing control to the natural cue by fading an added support. Anyone selecting between them needs the pair.; `shaping-successive-approximation` — complementary halves of the same differential-reinforcement engine, and the boundary is easy to get wrong: one differentiates the ANTECEDENT (a cue gains control through reinforce-in-presence / withhold-in-absence), the other differentiates the RESPONSE (a moving reinforced window builds a behavior that does not yet exist). A reader reaching for either should confirm which side of that line their case falls on.; `verbal-operant-teaching` — both are reinforcement-based teaching entries and explicitly cite each other in their own boundary text: one builds nonverbal cue control, the other installs the verbal operant itself. The reader arriving at either needs the boundary stated.


<a id="entry-809"></a>

### relational-emergence-probe

[#809](#entry-809) · [Back to teaching-by-reinforced-trials](#genus-134) · [Contents](#contents)

*risk: low · family: measurement*

GENERALIZATION / EMERGENCE PROBE — a behavior-analytic assessment arrangement that certifies whether a repertoire, stimulus relation, or class exists by probing responses the trained response alone cannot satisfy, with programmed consequences WITHHELD during the probe (run in extinction) so emergence is not confounded with fresh reinforcement and the probe deliberately teaches nothing. The lever is measurement — it produces evidence FOR THE OPERATOR over a learner's repertoire. Realizations (all sharing the same unreinforced-probe-in-extinction lever): (a) relational/derived-relations probes — reflexivity/symmetry/transitivity probes in extinction to operationalize 'comprehension', and unreinforced probe trials on untrained pairings after node-sharing training; (b) relational-prompt battery ('similar to / different from / an example of') that cannot be answered without emitting a relation, making a latent network observable as active relating; (c) discriminandum probes — a visible reinforcer whose presence/removal is the copy/withhold discriminandum; a criterion offloaded into an instrument delivering continuously-coupled feedback; (d) untrained-example stopping-rule — teach only a subset of possible examples, then probe UNtrained examples; untrained-item performance (not mastery of taught items) is the stop/continue rule, converting an open-ended teach-everything problem into a measurable closed loop (add examples and re-probe until untrained responding is consistent). Across all forms the probe scores untaught/derived responses under extinction; it does not convince the subject a state is real and it is not mastery-of-taught criterion training.


**When to reach for this.** Reach for the emergence/generalization probe when you must certify that an UNTRAINED response, relation, or class has emerged (or decide whether teaching is done) WITHOUT contaminating the measure by reinforcing it — the tell is unreinforced probe trials run in extinction scored on untaught/derived items. Use the stopping-rule realization when the question is 'has teaching generalized enough to stop?'; use the relational/discriminandum realizations when the question is 'does this stimulus relation or class exist?'.


**Risk.** Pure assessment arrangements (probes in extinction); no state push, no consent surface.


**Why it works.** Reinforcing a probe trial teaches the very response the probe is meant to detect, confounding measurement with training; running probes in extinction keeps the measure independent of the manipulation. That derived relations emerge untrained after node-sharing training is a well-replicated finding in stimulus-equivalence research, and it is falsifiable in the ordinary experimental sense — subjects who fail symmetry or transitivity probes are routinely observed, which is what makes the probe informative rather than ceremonial. [established; stimulus equivalence / derived relational responding; extinction probes to avoid measurement reactivity]


**Worked examples.**

- *Symmetry and transitivity probes define comprehension*
  - "accurate selection of the directly trained option, in and of itself, did not reveal an answer. Further indicators, beyond the explicitly reinforced behavior patterns, are needed" — Cooper, Heron & Heward (2020), Applied Behavior Analysis, 3rd ed.
- *Probe trials carry no programmed consequence*
  - "transitivity tests for relations between stimuli that were never presented together during training but that share a trained relation with a nodal stimulus" — Cooper, Heron & Heward (2020), Applied Behavior Analysis, 3rd ed.
- *Prompts that cannot be answered without relating*
  - "all of these questions demand an active response; how you understand beer is evident in how you respond to it ... all of the required responses involve relating the target word to something else" — Cooper, Heron & Heward (2020), Applied Behavior Analysis, 3rd ed.
- *The criterion moved into an instrument*
  - "voice volume activated a light display… Higher voice volume produced a brighter light… The teacher shaped voice volume by increasing the sensitivity threshold of the relay device." — Cooper, Heron & Heward (2020), Applied Behavior Analysis, 3rd ed.


**Realizations** (1): `untrained-probe-stopping-rule`


**See also.** `derived-relations-installation` — one is the measurement arrangement that certifies untaught responses under extinction; the other is the training design whose payload is exactly those untaught responses. The probe is how the installation is verified, so each entry is incomplete without pointing at the other.


<a id="entry-1313"></a>

### respondent-stimulus-pairing

[#1313](#entry-1313) · [Back to teaching-by-reinforced-trials](#genus-134) · [Contents](#contents)

*risk: medium · family: contingency-engineering · kind: principle*

Operate on the RESPONDENT (reflex) arc via stimulus presentation, not consequences on voluntary behavior. BUILD direction (respondent-stimulus-pairing): present a neutral stimulus just before or simultaneous with an unconditioned stimulus that already elicits a response; after repeated pairings the formerly neutral stimulus alone elicits a conditioned response — an automatic, involuntary reaction the subject did not have and did not choose, transferring by temporal contiguity (forward/simultaneous strongest, backward/delayed weaker). EVALUATIVE facet (valence-transfer-pairing): pair a stimulus that already reliably evokes a positive emotional response (liked music) with a neutral target (a product, an ad), contiguously and repeatedly, until the target itself elicits the affect and biases downstream choice toward it — affect installed with no argument about the target's merits. DECAY direction facet (respondent-habituation): present an eliciting stimulus repeatedly within a short span with no consequence or pairing, and the elicited response's magnitude decays and may vanish (massed re-exposure blunts reactivity on an intact unconditioned reflex arc); SPACING the same exposures preserves the response — presentation TIMING is the lever.


**When to reach for this.** Reach for RESPONDENT CONDITIONING when the target is an INVOLUNTARY (reflex/affective) response and the lever is stimulus PRESENTATION, not consequation of voluntary behavior. To install an elicited response or affect, pair NS+US by contiguity (order-sensitivity forward > backward is the procedural marker); to install a biasing VALENCE onto a choice target, use an already-evocative affective stimulus; to DECAY an existing reflex, re-present the eliciting stimulus massed (no pairing). Choose it over: discrimination/stimulus-control and any declared-trigger install (which consequate/instruct VOLUNTARY responding — no reflex elicited); motivating-operation engineering (which shifts a reinforcer's VALUE, not a reflex); conditioned-reinforcer manufacture (pairing that transfers reinforcing FUNCTION delivered as a consequence, not elicited affect).


**Risk.** Installs involuntary conditioned responses the subject 'did not have and did not choose' (medium); consent/bounding obligations attach at the applied-species level (the arousal-cue conditioning species already requires explicit consent), not at the principle altitude.


**Why it works.** Organisms respond to predictors, not to mere co-occurrence: a stimulus that reliably precedes a biologically significant one comes to elicit preparatory responding, which is why forward pairing beats backward and why a repeatedly-presented stimulus with no consequence loses its power. The same contiguity route carries affect as well as reflex, installing liking or disliking without any argument about the target. This is among the best-replicated findings in psychology and makes sharp, falsifiable predictions about order and timing. [established; Pavlovian conditioning; evaluative conditioning; habituation and the spacing effect]


**Worked examples.**

- *Neutral cue paired until it elicits by itself*
  - "After several trials consisting of the sound of the metronome followed by the presentation of food, the dogs began salivating in response to the sound of the metronome" — Cooper, Heron & Heward (2020), Applied Behavior Analysis, 3rd ed.


**Realizations** (2): `respondent-habituation`, `valence-transfer-pairing`


**See also.** `class-wide-function-transfer` — same axis of attaching a reaction to a stimulus — there by direct pairing with an eliciting stimulus, here by propagation through class structure.; `conditioned-reinforcer-manufacture` — both discriminators already cite each other by name as the primary confusion: pairing that transfers reinforcing function delivered as a consequence versus pairing that elicits an involuntary response or valence. Contiguous pairing is the shared surface and the operant/respondent split is the line, so the pointer is exactly what a classifier needs.; `within-session-conditioning-loop` — both build an automatic response by repeated pairing, but one presents a stimulus to elicit an involuntary reflex while the other fires an installed cue and rewards the response inside the session. The elicit-versus-consequate distinction is the classic confusion these two need each other to resolve.


<a id="entry-766"></a>

### self-instruction-antecedent-training

[#766](#entry-766) · [Back to teaching-by-reinforced-trials](#genus-134) · [Contents](#contents)

*risk: low · family: contingency-engineering*

Teach the subject to emit their OWN stimuli — verbal self-directives, covert intraverbals/imagery, self-textual reads of stable landmarks, or a self-arranged environmental mark — that then function as antecedent discriminative cues for the subject's OWN subsequent behavior, transferring control of performance from an external prompter to a self-generated stimulus the subject carries everywhere. Installation proceeds by teaching each component across exemplars, optionally driving the verbal mediator covert via an audibility-fading ladder (aloud -> whisper -> lip -> silent). REALIZATIONS: (self-instruction-antecedent-training) directly teach self-directives/step-prompts/produced intraverbals as antecedent cues, faded to covert, yielding self-paced/emergent responding; (self-generated-antecedent-cueing) the subject manufactures covert SDs (self-echoics, self-textual reads of landmarks) and feeds them in sequence to prompt a multi-step action the environment alone would not evoke; (covert-self-priming) a self-directed priming sequence where a topic-SD covertly evokes self-intraverbals/imagery that pre-strengthen content for a later turn; (self-supplied-covert-cue) trains deliberate on-cue emission of covert imagery whose response-product overlaps the target and acts as an added private SD, expanding output; (chain-priming-future-cue) execute the first physical link of a chain NOW so the partial completion is a self-arranged environmental SD that confronts the future self and EVOKES the next link.


**When to reach for this.** Reach for SELF-INSTRUCTION / SELF-CUEING when the subject supplies their OWN antecedent (a self-generated SD, self-directive, covert image, or self-arranged mark) to steer their OWN behavior — control is subject-manufactured, not operator-issued. Choose it over: operator-delivered cueing / discrimination training (the SD is issued by the operator there); self-administered CONTINGENCY (which relocates the measurement-and-CONSEQUENCE loop into the subject — this relocates the ANTECEDENT/cue, not the reinforcer); rule-governed precommitment (which binds the future self by a STAKE/foreclosure — the partial-completion facet here EVOKES the next response rather than foreclosing a choice). The facets differ only by which self-generated antecedent (verbal directive / covert intraverbal / covert image / physical partial-completion).


**Risk.** Clinical/educational self-instruction training (ABA textbook material); no consent surface, no channel erosion, self-help-directed.


**Why it works.** Self-produced stimuli travel with the person, so transferring cue control from an operator to the subject's own verbalisation or environmental mark removes the dependence on an external prompter and lets responding generalise to settings the trainer never visited. The audibility fade works because the covert form retains the same discriminative function once the response is reliable, and the partial-completion variant exploits the Zeigarnik-style pull of an unfinished action plus the simple fact that an altered environment is a physical reminder. Falsifiable: if faded-to-silent self-instruction produced no better maintenance in novel settings than operator-delivered prompting, the transfer claim fails. [established; self-instruction training / stimulus control transfer; generalisation via self-mediated cues]


**Worked examples.**

- *Self-talk pacing each link of a chain*
  - "Self-instruction consists of self-generated verbal responses, covert or overt, that function as response prompts for a desired behavior… guide oneself through a behavior chain or sequence of tasks" — Cooper, Heron & Heward (2020), Applied Behavior Analysis, 3rd ed.
- *A naming loop enterable from any point*
  - "the entire cycle could be initiated from any point… the acquisition of new instances of naming would require teaching only one component of the cycle." — Cooper, Heron & Heward (2020), Applied Behavior Analysis, 3rd ed.
- *A scripted verdict after each self-check*
  - "making self-evaluative statements, e.g., 'I'm not in the shaded area. I need to work faster.'" — Cooper, Heron & Heward (2020), Applied Behavior Analysis, 3rd ed.
- *Producing the answer rather than selecting it*
  - "production of an oral response rather than the more typical selection of a stimulus… (i.e., topography-based rather than selection-based responding)." — Cooper, Heron & Heward (2020), Applied Behavior Analysis, 3rd ed.


**Realizations** (4): `chain-priming-future-cue`, `covert-self-priming`, `self-generated-antecedent-cueing`, `self-supplied-covert-cue`


**See also.** `antecedent-manipulation` — both edit the antecedent rather than the consequence, and the only thing separating them is who supplies it -- the subject manufacturing their own carried cue versus the operator editing the situation upstream. Without the pointer a reader will file self-cueing under situational editing and lose the control-locus distinction.; `convergent-multiple-control` — both recruit supplemental self-generated stimuli as antecedents, 766 as a full transfer of control to the subject's own cues.; `scaffold-fade-control-transfer` — both concern where control of a response sits and how it moves. One has the subject manufacture their own antecedent cue; the other fades an operator-supplied support until the natural cue takes over. A reader choosing a control-transfer route benefits from seeing both handoff shapes.; `self-induction-re-entry-training` — both make the subject supply their own antecedent. One is a portable cue for deliberate re-entry into a conditioned state; the other trains self-generated cues that steer ordinary subsequent behavior. Same lever, different target.; `self-management-self-administered-contingency` — complementary halves of relocating behavioral control into the subject: one moves the measurement-and-consequence loop inside, the other moves the antecedent cue inside. Each is defined partly by not being the other, so the cross-reference is load-bearing.


<a id="entry-760"></a>

### verbal-operant-teaching

[#760](#entry-760) · [Back to teaching-by-reinforced-trials](#genus-134) · [Contents](#contents)

*risk: medium · family: contingency-engineering*

Install a verbal operant — the ability to NAME (tact), ASK for (mand), COMPREHEND (listener/receptive), or classify (concept) — via reinforced trials and prompt-fade over the learner's existing repertoire, so an interior state or referent the learner could not previously report or request comes under verbal control (and thus becomes steerable by reference to it). REALIZATIONS: PRIVATE-EVENT TACTING — (proxy-taught-private-tacts) tact a visible correlate of an inaccessible internal state ('ouch' modeled while limping), reinforce the copy, fade the public prompt until the private stimulus alone controls the word; (leak-timed-private-state-labeling) supply+reinforce the label at the exact moment an involuntary tell certifies the private stimulus is present. COMPREHENSION — (evoke-and-check-comprehension) a verbal stimulus evokes a receptive selection/answer that is the unit shaped, making covert understanding observable and reinforceable. MAND — (mand-for-information) frame lack of information as a deprivation so asking is an evocable operant reinforced by the answer; (mand-frame-graft) graft a not-yet-instructable response onto a moment of already-strong MO, then fade to ordinary control; (specific-reinforcement-mand-extinction) reinforce by delivering exactly what the words specify, flipping the driving MO to abolishing and ending the mand; (form-carries-motivation) design the response FORM (sign/icon) so it specifies the reinforcer at stake, opening selection-based communication. CONCEPT/FUNCTION — (verbal-concept-induction) install a concept via a stated definition + examples/nonexamples over existing verbal repertoire (no reinforced trials), transferring to novel instances; (verbal-function-altering-instruction) a single rule changes the behavioral function of a not-yet-present stimulus (turns a future neutral stimulus into an SD) by language alone.


**When to reach for this.** Reach for VERBAL-OPERANT TEACHING when the target is a NAMING, ASKING, COMPREHENDING, or classifying repertoire over an external referent or an interior state — installing the verbal operant itself. Choose it over: autoclitic-training (which installs a SECONDARY form modifying the learner's own primary utterance, not a new referent-naming/asking operant); discrimination/stimulus-control (which builds nonverbal cue control — this installs verbal behavior); motivating-operation engineering (which manipulates a consequence's VALUE — the mand facets here TEACH the ask riding an MO rather than engineering value for its own sake); self-instruction/self-cueing (where the learner's own verbal behavior is a self-generated SD steering their OWN action, not an operator-taught tact/mand). Facets differ by which operant (tact/mand/listener/concept) and by public vs private referent.


**Risk.** Durable but bounded — installs a lasting self-report repertoire (identity-adjacent: how the subject narrates interior states) yet does not erode the refusal channel and is a benign clinical/developmental teaching sequence in source.


**Why it works.** Behaviour that is reliably reinforced in the presence of a stimulus comes under that stimulus's control; teaching a name or a request is just arranging that contingency over an existing repertoire. The private-event case rests on the standard behaviour-analytic account that a community can only reinforce a private tact by using a public correlate as proxy, which predicts that private labels are learned less precisely than public ones — a prediction that has empirical support in interoceptive-accuracy work. Falsifiable: if reinforced trials over a public correlate never transferred control to the private stimulus after the correlate was faded, the mechanism fails. [established; operant discriminative control; verbal operants and proxy-taught private events]


**Worked examples.**

- *Teaching a private-state label via a visible proxy*
  - "observable overt collateral behavior can inform the community of a private stimulus (e.g., a child limping)… provide and teach an appropriate response form (e.g., "ouch")… thus allowing for echoic-to-tact transfer" — Cooper, Heron & Heward (2020), Applied Behavior Analysis, 3rd ed.


**Realizations** (8): `evoke-and-check-comprehension`, `form-carries-motivation`, `leak-timed-private-state-labeling`, `mand-for-information`, `mand-frame-graft`, `specific-reinforcement-mand-extinction`, `verbal-concept-induction`, `verbal-function-altering-instruction`


**See also.** `derived-relations-installation` — both build verbal repertoires, but verbal-operant teaching directly shapes each naming, asking, or comprehending response by reinforced trials, while derived-relations installation deliberately teaches only a spanning subset and harvests untaught relations under extinction probe.; `discrimination-training-differential-reinforcement` — both are reinforcement-based teaching entries and explicitly cite each other in their own boundary text: one builds nonverbal cue control, the other installs the verbal operant itself. The reader arriving at either needs the boundary stated.; `motivating-operation-engineering` — explicitly cross-referenced in both directions already: one engineers how much a consequence is worth without delivering anything, the other teaches the asking repertoire that rides on that value. A practitioner building a request-making repertoire needs the value-side move, and vice versa.; `rule-governed-behavior-install` — adjacent behavioral levers with a live boundary. One installs a naming, asking or comprehending repertoire through reinforced trials; the other governs later behavior by an advance verbal statement of a contingency. They overlap where a single stated rule alters what a not-yet-present stimulus means, with no trials run.


<a id="genus-306"></a>

## test-drive-the-change (2)

The ask is framed as a small, bounded, abortable experiment, so agreement is cheap and the want gets tested rather than assumed.

[cheap-reversible-trial-frame](#entry-1143) · [experiential-consent-trial](#entry-861)


<a id="entry-1143"></a>

### cheap-reversible-trial-frame

[#1143](#entry-1143) · [Back to test-drive-the-change](#genus-306) · [Contents](#contents)

*risk: medium · family: framing*

When a stance or precondition blocks the procedure — an all-or-nothing behavioral commitment ("I'll never give up X") or a required belief the subject rejects — the operator reframes the ask as a small, explicitly temporary, reversible experiment: a fixed trial window (a "three-month moratorium") during which the disputed behavior is suspended, or a "suspend disbelief / adopt the reverse assumption for a bounded trial period". Because agreeing now no longer means agreeing forever, perceived stakes drop and the blocking precondition stops gating: the deadlock reopens as a space to generate resources, or the procedure proceeds without its precondition belief.


**When to reach for this.** Time-boxing/reversibility is the lever — assent is made cheap by reframing commitment as a bounded experiment rather than an identity claim.


**Risk.** Bounded and reversible by construction, but it neutralizes a precondition/stance the subject rejected (the residual reads it as consent-laundering-adjacent), which caps it above low.


**Why it works.** Resistance to a request scales with its perceived permanence and cost to self-concept, so bounding it in time and declaring it reversible drops the stakes below the threshold at which the identity-defending objection fires. Once the trial is underway, self-perception works in the operator's favour: the subject observes themselves complying without external coercion and infers a correspondingly softened attitude, so the bounded trial often does not revert cleanly. Falsifiable: the same request framed as permanent should draw more refusals than the time-boxed version, and post-trial attitudes should differ from pre-trial ones despite the "nothing is being asked of you long-term" framing. [plausible; foot-in-the-door; reduced perceived stakes; self-perception theory]


**Worked examples.**

- *A bounded moratorium replaces an all-or-nothing stance*
  - "engage in negotiation to establish a three-month moratorium on sexual activities outside of this relationship during which time he will have a chance to try out some of the new behaviors" — Bandler & Grinder (1982), Reframing
- *Belief waived in favour of time-boxed pretense*
  - "Ask them to pretend. You can even agree that they aren't responsible, but you've discovered that by going through certain 'psychological' steps, people are often able to have a healing impact" — Bandler & Grinder (1982), Reframing


**See also.** `objection-truce` — both lower the cost of assent by bounding it — a time-limited truce with a guaranteed later objection slot, and a reversible trial window that suspends a blocking stance. Both also flag the same degradation into manufactured consent if the bound is not honored.; `parts-work-procedure-craft` — both unstick a blocked negotiation without conceding the substantive content, so a practitioner facing a deadlock benefits from both; the difference is where the give comes from — one manufactures tradeable currency and turn discipline between internal parties, the other lowers the price of a single assent by making the commitment explicitly temporary and reversible.; `rehearsed-pre-commitment` — two ways of making a contested agreement cheap to give: relocate the decision upstream to a moment when judgment is intact, or time-box it so agreeing now does not mean agreeing permanently. Both route around a refusal without eroding it, and belong side by side when classifying consent engineering.


<a id="entry-861"></a>

### experiential-consent-trial

[#861](#entry-861) · [Back to test-drive-the-change](#genus-306) · [Contents](#contents)

*risk: low · stated only — not demonstrated in corpus · family: safety*

Treats wanting as a hypothesis to be tested experientially before anything is installed: build one example fantasy, verify it from OUTSIDE for gross safety, then enter it and verify the subject actually LIKES the internal experience — all before deciding to want the part at all. Adds an explicit safety screen plus a commit/abort decision, so a consciously-desired-but-actually-aversive install is caught before it lands. Positive governance: the operator's install is blocked pending the subject's lived endorsement — a consent-VALIDITY gate that generates evidence rather than soliciting affirmation.


**When to reach for this.** Who is constrained: the OPERATOR — no install proceeds without a passed safety screen and a lived, endorsed trial (commit/abort). A consent checkpoint SOLICITS an affirmative "yes"; this TESTS the want empirically and can return abort — evidence-generating rather than assent-collecting. An objection-truce negotiates with a dissenting part to buy clean ACCESS to the trial; this move IS the trial and its gate.


**Risk.** A consent-validity safeguard that narrows the operator's license; no coercive surface.


**Why it works.** Rests on the finding that people are bad at predicting their own hedonic reactions to novel states — wanting and liking are separable, and stated preference frequently diverges from experienced response. Substituting a lived trial for a verbal endorsement replaces a self-report known to be unreliable with a sample of the actual outcome, which is why the gate can return abort against the subject's own stated wish. Falsifiable in an unusually direct way: if trials rarely returned abort — if subjects' pre-trial wanting reliably predicted their in-trial liking — the procedure would be redundant ceremony. [established; wanting/liking dissociation; affective forecasting error]


**Worked examples.**

- *Try the want before installing it*
  - "Sometimes you think that you want a part, but when you try it out, you don't like it." — Bandler & Grinder (1982), Reframing


**See also.** `belief-outcome-gate` — both are operator-side gates that can block an install from proceeding, and both are constraints on the operator rather than moves performed on the subject. One gates on the operator's foresight about downstream fallout and holds even against an explicit request to proceed; the other gates on the subject's lived, tested endorsement and can return abort. Useful pair when choosing which kind of restraint to write.; `consent-checkpoint` — both constrain the operator before proceeding, and the contrast is the useful part. One solicits an affirmative opt-in and waits for it; the other tests the want empirically by building and entering an example, then commits or aborts on the lived result. Choose by whether assent is collected or evidence is generated.; `desire-without-obligation` — direct inverses on the who-is-constrained axis. One blocks the install pending a lived, endorsed trial that can return abort; the other brackets every ask with a denial of compulsion precisely to make the installed craving read as self-authored. The second is the counterfeit of the first.; `objection-truce` — directly coupled in practice: the truce with a dissenting part is what buys clean access to the experiential trial, and the trial is the gate the truce serves. One negotiates a time-bounded pause with a guaranteed later objection slot; the other tests the want empirically and can return abort.; `procedure-well-formedness-QA` — two gates that both constrain the operator before anything is installed, at different stages: one tests whether the authored procedure is correct and transferable, the other tests whether the subject actually likes the experience and can return abort. A reader auditing a script's governance layer wants both and needs the artifact-versus-lived-trial distinction.; `stakeholder-set-success-threshold` — a pair worth reading together as two placements of the same governance bar: both strip the operator of unilateral go/no-go, one by relocating the definition of success to the people who must live with the result and re-checking it against the real-world reason, the other by blocking the install until the subject has lived the experience and can abort. One constrains what counts as done, the other what is allowed to start.; `suitability-screening` — both are positive-governance gates that constrain the operator's own license before anything is installed. One screens the subject's fitness and can decline outright; the other tests the want empirically and can return abort. Same family, different evidence standard.; `time-boxed-consent-contract` — both are governance structures that condition a deal on the subject's continuing endorsement, and they compose directly: an experiential trial supplies the evidence for the yes, a time bound plus a re-open channel is what that yes is granted under. A reader designing a consent-valid install will want both halves.


<a id="genus-229"></a>

## the-voice-moves-in (3)

The operator's words are escalated from external audio into the listener's inner reality — filling the mind, becoming their thoughts and will, or hardening into a persistent device.

[gradient-word-reification-into-device](#entry-1155) · [voice-absorption](#entry-40) · [voice-as-mind-substrate](#entry-43)


<a id="entry-1155"></a>

### gradient-word-reification-into-device

[#1155](#entry-1155) · [Back to the-voice-moves-in](#genus-229) · [Contents](#contents)

*risk: high · bounded · family: tethering*

Escalates "my words" from abstract suggestion through a stepwise gradient (words -> force -> field -> device) where each step is a small extrapolation of the last, until the words are declared to have formed into a solid external device (a hypnotic chastity belt) that feels "solid and absolute" and less negotiable than a command — and the device is claimed to persist awake as well as in trance, extending control past the session boundary. The gradient itself is the mechanism: it walks the listener from figurative image to literal object by increments too small to reject.


**When to reach for this.** The abstract-to-object gradient plus out-of-session persistence is the tell, not a figurative image.


**Risk.** The reified device is claimed to persist AWAKE, i.e. out-of-session reach without bounding; must ship inside a host supplying entry/exit/aftercare.


**Why it works.** The stepwise escalation is a foot-in-the-door structure applied to belief rather than behaviour: each increment is small enough that rejecting it would be inconsistent with the increment just accepted, and consistency pressure carries the listener across a distance she would have refused in one step. Whether the terminal claim (a felt physical device persisting outside the session) actually lands is not established — that is an expectancy-driven somatic report, and its durability is the weak link. Testable: acceptance of the final claim should be substantially higher after the gradient than after presenting the endpoint alone. [plausible; foot-in-the-door / incremental commitment and consistency]


**Worked examples.**

- *Words walked by steps into a solid device*
  - **Setup.** Mid-session, deep; the subject has already agreed they can feel the operator's words physically.
  - **The move.** You already feel my words landing on your skin — you told me so. Feel them collecting now, low, around your hips. Enough of them collected together and it has weight. Enough weight and it's a field, humming, tight against you. The field has an edge. The edge closes, front and back, and clicks. That's not a rule anymore, that's hardware: your hand simply will not pass through it, awake or under. It opens for washing, three minutes, and then it closes again.
  - **Why it lands.** The operator starts from something already accepted — her words are being felt in the body — and takes one small step at a time: the words gather, the gathering has weight, the weight becomes a field, the field takes a shape, and the shape closes around the listener's hips as an object. At no point is a leap large enough to argue with, and at the end the thing is spoken of as hardware rather than instruction: hands simply will not pass through it, awake or in trance, with a narrow carve-out for washing that makes it feel like a device with rules rather than a blanket ban.


**See also.** `closed-vocabulary-lexical-narrowing` — shares the words-as-operative-objects axis: language itself escalated into the controlling apparatus.; `felt-substance-state-binding` — both turn an abstraction into a felt concrete object that carries a state, and they are easy to conflate. The split: one walks the operator's words up a stepwise gradient until they are a solid external device claimed to persist while awake; the other welds a tactile substance to a state and turns the material's descriptors into an adjustable dial.; `object-as-causal-agent-of-cognition` — both hand causal authority to a thing rather than the operator, but by different routes: one declares an already-present object the active cause of the mind-state, the other walks abstract words up an incremental gradient until they are claimed to have condensed into a solid device. The gradient is the lever in the second and absent from the first, so they stay separate — but a writer building object-attributed control will want both.; `thought-string-reused-as-restraint` — both reify something abstract into a persistent physical object that then constrains the listener, and both explicitly distinguish themselves from the same neighboring externalization entry. They differ in what is objectified (the operator's words versus the listener's cognition), so a reader landing on one should see the other.


<a id="entry-40"></a>

### voice-absorption

[#40](#entry-40) · [Back to the-voice-moves-in](#genus-229) · [Contents](#contents)

*risk: low · family: attention*

The operator's speech is installed as the listener's sole standing input — attended-to not as external speech but as the substance filling the listener's mind — so analytic listening dissolves into a single receptive channel and later suggestion arrives on a pre-cleared line. Realized by asserting/repeating that the voice fills mental space, replaces inner monologue, or becomes the listener's own thoughts (saturated exclusivity 'only my words matter', words-as-substance filling an emptied mind, recursive listen-to-the-listening binding, progressive sensory subtraction to a voice-only field, the standing every-word-is-descent idle deepener, and the self-sealing wrinkle where an apparent counter-thought is pre-labeled as operator content). Further realized forms, parametric surfaces on the one narrow-to-the-voice-as-sole-channel lever: (a) kinesthetic envelopment — the voice is figured as a warm physical covering ('wrapped up warm in my words') so hearing becomes being held, with a silence-becomes-cold aversion hook; (b) appetitive recode — the voice channel is re-skinned as an ever-sweetening cravable object the listener chases, so absorption self-amplifies via their own wanting; (c) trust-transfer delivery — the voice is first merged INTO an imagined vehicle (hands), then the vehicle is faded and declared gone, transferring the vehicle's rapport/trust-bank onto the voice; (d) meaning-to-sound relocation — attention is moved from parsed meaning to the voice's acoustic carrier (words demoted as 'indistinct', voice reframed as originating inside the listener's own mind), starving the channel through which claims would be judged.


**When to reach for this.** Reach for voice-absorption when the VOICE'S own pull is the lever — it fills/replaces mental space as the sole standing channel. Choose it OVER fixation — that narrows onto a target that need not be the voice; here the voice itself becomes the field. vs environmental-dissociation — that SUBTRACTS competing external input so the voice is what remains; here the voice's filling/pull does the work, not subtraction. vs cognitive-quieting — that empties thought; here the voice occupies the emptied line. An escalating voice-as-will substitution that ratchets past receptive-channel into identity/will belongs to the deeper voice-as-mind-substrate staircase, not here. The reward-surface skins (kinesthetic warmth with a cold-aversion hook; appetitive craving chased forward) and the delivery paths (trust-transfer from a dismantled vehicle; meaning-to-sound acoustic relocation, which additionally disables proposition-evaluation) are all realizations of THIS lever, not separate techniques.


**Risk.** Session-scoped receptive-channel absorption, reversible, no durable identity or refusal-channel erosion in the core members. One named-persona member's self-sealing wrinkle is a boundary note, not a risk escalation.


**Why it works.** Continuous speech is a hard-to-ignore channel — spoken language is processed obligatorily and consumes phonological working-memory capacity, which is why irrelevant speech reliably disrupts concurrent verbal rehearsal. Saturating that capacity with the operator's voice leaves little room for the subvocal rehearsal that counter-argument requires, and counter-arguing is what predicts resistance to persuasion. Directing attention from meaning to acoustic properties independently degrades comprehension of propositional content, so claims arrive with less evaluation. Testable: recall of, and counter-argument production against, embedded propositions should be lower under voice-saturating framing than under identical content delivered without it. [plausible; irrelevant-speech effect / phonological loop interference; counter-arguing as the mediator of resistance]


**Worked examples.**

- *The world subtracted until only the voice is left*
  - **Setup.** Middle third; induction complete, subject settled and unmoving.
  - **The move.** Your hands are getting harder to move — that's fine, you don't need them. The room is going now, the walls, the light behind your eyelids; there's no floor under you anymore. Your body is somewhere behind you, out of reach, and when it's gone entirely there is only this voice left in the dark, and nothing else at all.
  - **Why it lands.** Over the middle third the perceptual world is narrated as shrinking: the body gets harder to move, then the room stops mattering, then the body slips away, then everything except the voice disappears, until there is nothing left but the voice. Each stage is framed as something receding rather than something present, so the listener is not asked to ignore anything — it is simply leaving. What remains is the only sensory anchor available, and it is the operator's.
- *Listening to the instruction to listen*
  - **Setup.** Very first lines of the recording; nothing else has been offered to attend to yet.
  - **The move.** Don't listen to the words yet. Just listen to the fact that you're listening — notice that right now, the only thing you're doing is receiving my voice. Stay on that, and keep listening to yourself listening.
  - **Why it lands.** There is no garden and no staircase — the opening gives the listener nothing to attend to except the instruction to attend. The only available object is the channel itself, so attention narrows onto a single stream before any content has been put on it. By the time anything is actually suggested, the listener has already agreed to the line it will arrive on.
- *Words poured in as fast as thought is emptied*
  - **Setup.** After a clearing/emptying passage has begun; subject reporting or accepting a quieting mind.
  - **The move.** Every thought you let go leaves a space behind it, and my words pour straight into that space — thick and warm, like water filling a glass from the bottom up. Watch the level climb: past your jaw, behind your eyes, up to the top of your skull. There's no room left for anything of yours to move back into.
  - **Why it lands.** The emptying and the filling run at the same time: as thought is cleared out, the operator's speech is described as a substance flooding in to occupy the vacated space, so nothing of the listener's own can move back into it. The listener is asked to picture the level climbing, which makes them a participant in their own replacement, and every gap that opens is claimed the moment it appears.
- *Even an apparent counter-thought pre-labeled as hers*
  - **Setup.** Late deepening; the voice-replaces-inner-speech claim has already been made once.
  - **The move.** You aren't thinking your own thoughts anymore — you're thinking mine. And if a thought comes up right now saying "no, that one was me, that one I made myself," listen carefully: I put that one there too. Every word in your head is mine, including that one, including the next one.
  - **Why it lands.** The claim is not merely that the voice accompanies the listener's inner speech but that it has replaced it — and then the seal: any thought that arrives protesting that the listener is still generating thoughts of their own is itself the operator's words. That forecloses the only vantage point from which the claim could be tested, and turns the thought of resisting into one more piece of compliance.


**Realizations** (4): `meaning-to-sound-substitution`, `vehicle-to-voice-trust-transfer`, `voice-as-envelopment`, `voice-channel-appetitive-recode`


**See also.** `bait-and-switch-contract-arc` — the voice-only attentional field that serves as this arc's mid-script bridge between the opening contract and the closing delivery.; `environmental-dissociation` — both end with the operator's voice as the only relevant input and are routinely run together, but the lever is opposite in direction: one subtracts competing external stimuli until the voice is what remains, the other has the voice fill and replace mental space by its own pull.; `inner-voice-medium-colonization` — adjacent occupations of the same channel: one installs the operator's voice as the sole standing input filling mental space, the other recolors the register of the listener's own inner monologue so any future thought carries the new identity. A reader choosing between them benefits from the cut: whose voice is being installed, and whether the effect is content-bearing (occupying the line) or content-independent (retinting the carrier).; `internal-voice-cultivation` — adjacent levers on the same channel: one makes the operator's voice the sole standing input with no specific propositional cargo; the other plants exact first-person sentences felt as self-generated. Useful together when a passage does both at once.; `operator-voice-absence` — both are about the voice's source and standing, and they sit at opposite ends of one axis: in one the operator's voice is absent entirely so the content arrives authored as self, in the other the operator's voice becomes the sole standing channel filling mental space. The contrast is informative precisely because both remove the ordinary external-speaker stance by opposite means.


<a id="entry-43"></a>

### voice-as-mind-substrate

[#43](#entry-43) · [Back to the-voice-moves-in](#genus-229) · [Contents](#contents)

*risk: high · consent-required · bounded · family: persistence*

A graded presuppositional staircase that promotes the operator's voice from external audio all the way to the listener's will and identity. It opens asserting the voice is already inside the head, then ratchets in strict-superset stages (voice between the ears, words become your thoughts, voice IS the sound of your thoughts, fills every crevice, becomes your whole world), ending with forced first-person recitation and 'my will is your will'. Collapses the perceptual distance between external audio and interior monologue by presupposition rather than argument; each stage is a superset of the last so the identity/will substitution lands as one more step on a staircase already climbed, feeling already-accomplished rather than argued for.


**When to reach for this.** Exceeds voice-absorption (which stops at replacing inner dialogue with a suggestion-receptive channel) by continuing to ratchet the same voice-is-thoughts move through will and identity substitution. The tell is the graded staircase with no single decisive assertion point.


**Risk.** Escalates to will/identity substitution ('my will is your will') by presupposition, reaching durable identity scope and eroding the vantage from which the listener could refuse — meets the high bar (durable identity scope + refusal-channel erosion), unlike the session-scoped voice-absorption core it descends past.


**Why it works.** Source-monitoring error is the operative mechanism: people distinguish self-generated thought from perceived speech by inferential cues (vividness, effort, contextual detail), not by a tagged label, and those cues can be degraded until internally and externally sourced content are confused. Presupposing each stage rather than asserting it exploits a separate documented feature of language — presupposed content is accepted with less scrutiny than asserted content, because processing a presupposition requires accommodating it before it can be challenged. The graded superset structure means no single step is large enough to trigger the contrast that would prompt rejection. Falsifiable: subjects should show elevated source-attribution errors for operator-supplied content after this staircase relative to an identical-content asserted-not-presupposed control. [plausible; source-monitoring framework; presupposition accommodation; incremental-commitment/foot-in-the-door gradation]


**Worked examples.**

- *A staircase from audio to thoughts to will*
  - **Setup.** Opening of a deep session, subject already responsive and eyes closed; used as a full arc across ten-plus minutes.
  - **The move.** My voice isn't coming from the speakers — it's already inside your head, in the space right behind your eyes. My words are turning into your thoughts as you hear them; that sound you think with, that's me. I'm in every crevice now, I'm the whole of your world, so say it for me: your voice is my thoughts, your will is my will.
  - **Why it lands.** The recording does not work toward getting the voice inside; it opens with the voice already there, and then climbs. First it occupies the space behind the eyes. Then the operator's words are said to be turning into the listener's thoughts. Then the voice is declared to be the sound those thoughts are made of. Then it saturates everything, then it is the whole of the listener's world, and finally the listener is made to state it in the first person. Each step is a strict superset of the one before, so when the substitution of will arrives it is not a new claim but one more rung on a staircase already climbed, and there is no self left standing apart from the voice to object with.


**See also.** `inner-voice-medium-colonization` — both take over the inner monologue rather than its contents, but one escalates the operator's voice through a presuppositional staircase from external audio to the listener's will, while the other leaves authorship alone and merely recolors the register every future thought is heard in.; `referent-deletion-voice-monopoly` — shares the voice-to-interior axis: the operator's voice promoted stepwise until it is the listener's whole remaining world.


<a id="genus-215"></a>

## thinking-handed-over (3)

Techniques that hand the listener's thinking, deciding, or authorship to the operator or an 'automatic' inner agent, so obedience feels like rest and the listener ends up structurally unable to run themselves.

[control-transfer-cognitive-delegation](#entry-182) · [induced-incapacity-to-operator-dependency](#entry-662) · [subconscious-agent-authorship-offload](#entry-194)


<a id="entry-182"></a>

### control-transfer-cognitive-delegation

[#182](#entry-182) · [Back to thinking-handed-over](#genus-215) · [Contents](#contents)

*risk: medium · family: authorship-shift*

The operator volunteers to perform the listener's own cognition/control — thinking, deciding, worrying, self-suppression — and frames the handoff as felt relief rather than loss, so obedience reads as frictionless rest. The listener is given permission to stop generating thought while the operator (or an operator-supplied binary decision-engine) becomes the entity that reasons or holds control. Set up variously by partitioning the self into a thinking-conscious mind that is evicted and a receptive remainder, by timing the handoff to an exhaustion point so it arrives as rescue-by-contrast, by smuggling the transfer under an already-accepted somatic binding, or by narrowing scope to the meta-evaluative self-monitoring layer. The delegated faculty and the framing are parameters, in three main forms: (a) GENERAL COGNITION — thinking/deliberation handed off as absorptive relief; (b) FEAR-DEFUSING SUBSTITUTION — operator-control offered as a strictly-superior REPLACEMENT for the listener's own self-suppression ('a much better method of control'), specifically neutralizing a previously-manufactured fear of being uncontrolled so barriers release while feeling safe; (c) FINITE-SPACE VOICE-DISPLACEMENT — the voice reframed as a spatial occupant with a one-in-one-out scarcity claim (finite mental space, each unit of voice in = one unit of thought out, 'I am thinking for you now'), emptiness reframed as the receipt for having received the operator rather than as loss.


**When to reach for this.** The delegate is the OPERATOR (or an operator-supplied decision-engine) and the delegated faculty is general cognition/control, offered as relief. Variant tells: the fear-defusing substitution reads as operator-control replacing self-control to defuse a manufactured fear of being uncontrolled; the finite-space voice-displacement reads as an explicit one-in-one-out displacement economy — voice physically evicts thought unit-for-unit. Sibling techniques a writer picks INSTEAD: subconscious-agent-authorship-offload delegates to the listener's OWN internal layer (subconscious / autonomous thoughts), NOT the operator — the recipient is the line; induced-incapacity-to-operator-dependency weaponizes a manufactured decision-INCAPACITY into 'you can't decide, so I decide' (a dependency lock-in, not relief); self-touch-reattribution reattributes a specific physical act just performed; critical-faculty-deactivation-claim claims the faculty is simply switched OFF. Not a bare drop command, and not ownership-as-identity language.


**Risk.** Session-scoped cognitive relief with no channel erosion or durable identity claim.


**Why it works.** Deliberation is metabolically and subjectively costly, and people reliably prefer options that reduce decision effort — an offer to take over thinking is accepted because it is genuinely relieving, not because a defense was defeated. Framing the transfer as relief rather than loss also changes what is evaluated: the listener assesses an offer of rest rather than an offer of control, and loss-framed and gain-framed versions of the same transfer produce different acceptance rates. The finite-space variant additionally trades on the fact that people accept vivid spatial metaphors for mental processes uncritically; there is no actual displacement economy in cognition, and that clause should be read as persuasive imagery rather than mechanism. [plausible; cognitive-effort avoidance; framing effects on acceptance]


**Worked examples.**

- *Conscious mind evicted, operator takes its desk*
  - **Setup.** Late induction; the conscious/deep-mind split has been asserted and repeated, and the subject is unresponsive to the surface frame.
  - **The move.** There's the part of you that argues, and there's the part underneath that already wants this — and the arguing part isn't a resident here, it's a guest, and it's been standing in the doorway long enough. Step back now. You don't get a vote on this one. That seat is mine while you're under: I'll do the thinking, I'll make the calls, and the part of you that's left just gets to sit there and be told.
  - **Why it lands.** The listener is first divided into two parties: a thinking, arguing surface mind and a deeper one that wants to comply. The model is asserted and never argued for. The first party is then steadily demoted — downgraded to a visitor with no standing — and the vacancy it leaves is filled by the operator, who volunteers for the post in the same recurring formula each time it comes round. What the listener experiences is permission to stop working, delivered as relief; what changes hands is who decides.
- *I will do the worrying for you*
  - **Setup.** Progressive relaxation already underway; the subject's shoulders and jaw have visibly let go.
  - **The move.** Let your shoulders go now — you don't have to keep checking whether they're low enough, because I'm the one keeping an eye on that from here. I'll do the worrying about your shoulders, and about your hands, and about whether you're doing this properly. That's not your job anymore. In fact you can stop deciding things altogether for a while; I'll think, and you'll rest, and honestly doesn't that already feel lighter than holding it all yourself?
  - **Why it lands.** It presents as an ordinary part-by-part relaxation pass, except that each stage comes coupled to a handover: this region no longer requires the listener's attention, because the operator has assumed the worrying about it. The scope then widens from worry to thinking and choosing outright. The ease the listener is genuinely feeling gets credited to the handing over, so yielding becomes the source of the relief rather than its cost.
- *Handover timed to the exhaustion point*
  - **Setup.** The subject has been counting down silently and unaided for two or three minutes and has visibly lost the thread.
  - **The move.** You've lost your place, haven't you. Good — leave it with me. I'll take the count from here: seven, six, five — you don't have to keep track of anything now, not the number, not where you are in it. The counting is mine and the resting is yours, and you'll notice how much easier the next thirty seconds are than the last two minutes were.
  - **Why it lands.** The listener has been counting unaided for long enough to lose the thread, and at precisely that point the operator assumes the count: a brief one, and no need for you to keep track — the work is hers now, the listener has only to rest. The relief of stopping is immediate and real, and the contrast is what does the deepening. Control changes hands inside a single sentence, in an unbroken paragraph, with nothing to mark the seam.
- *Only the self-monitoring layer handed over*
  - **Setup.** Immediately before a long sequence of posture and positioning instructions the subject would otherwise grade themselves against.
  - **The move.** Before we start on the positions — you're going to want to ask whether you're doing it right, whether it's enough, whether it's too much, whether you look ridiculous. Hand all of that to me. Judging your own performance while you're down here is a silly thing to spend a mind on, and it's mine to do now anyway. I'll tell you if something needs correcting. Until I do, there is nothing for you to assess.
  - **Why it lands.** The handover here is narrow and precise: not thinking in general, but the running self-assessment — am I doing this right, is it enough, is it too much. The specific anxieties are named first so the listener recognises them, then the whole appraising function is assigned to someone else and the practice of appraising is called silly. It is placed immediately before a long run of posture instructions the listener would otherwise have spent the whole time grading themselves against.


**Realizations** (2): `control-substitution`, `voice-displacement-scarcity`


**See also.** `blank-then-authorship-handoff` — both relocate authorship of mental content to the operator, and the boundary is easy to miss. One hands off the ongoing faculty of thinking and frames the handoff as relief; the other first blanks the ideational stream and then substitutes who authors what fills it. Reach for the blanking form only when a clearing step precedes a wholesale reality-substitution clause.; `ceded-agency-as-comfort-precedent` — these are typically sequential: small decisions resolved for the listener and cashed as comfort lower the threshold for handing over cognition wholesale. Reading the precedent-builder alongside the full handoff shows the setup-and-payoff relationship rather than two interchangeable moves.; `cognitive-quieting` — both empty the thinking channel and both frame the emptying as relief rather than demand. They differ in where cognition goes: one has thought simply depart, the other hands it to the operator who performs it instead. A writer choosing an emptying move should compare them directly.; `cognitive-sourcing-monopoly` — adjacent and easy to confuse: one hands the listener's cognition to the operator as felt relief, the other claims the operator constitutively supplies the faculty in the first place.
