**Scope.** Includes imagery-vehicle body/identity rewrites (vehicle = imagery); NOT plain channel narrowing with no scene (-> attention) or depth mechanics (-> deepening). The identity-erasure/phantom-body sub-block may re-home to dissociation at entry level in P3.


#### pacing-rapport

Operator-side calibration and entrainment that manufactures agreement: yes-sets of checkable truths, micro-ratification, representational matching, breath/rhythm entrainment, and first-ingress moves that remove the decline point.

**Scope.** The accepted channel a lead rides — NOT the suggestion delivered into it (-> encoding/triggers) and NOT pure narrowing (-> attention). Some members are design-time craft; P3 may split those to the shelf.


### Dissociation

Self and memory structure: splits, alters, amnesia, self-model rewrites, and state-fusion locks.


#### amnesia

Breaking or fabricating memory as the mechanism — recall gaps (past, forward, install-scoped), source amnesia, screen and grafted memories — so installed content cannot be reviewed, contested, or attributed.

**Scope.** The lever is the gap or the fabricated record. Partition without memory operation -> self-partition; forget-the-source-keep-the-belief where attribution is the lever -> authorship-shift.


#### persistence

Making an installed identity or state durable across time, states, and sessions — behavioral bridges, carry-out, cross-state and operator-absent self-renewal, timelessness framing, ownership language.

**Scope.** Durability of what is already installed. One-time self-restructuring -> self-model-surgery; repetition as reinforcement schedule -> conditioning; next-file tethers -> tethering. Exporting a response into outside CONTEXTS/daily life -> transfer; this family is durability of the installed identity/state as self-structure.


#### self-model-surgery

Operating on the structure of the self-model — clearing and refilling the mind-as-substrate, deleting states from the available inventory, relocating the identity anchor in time, redefining faculties, discrediting the prior self.

**Scope.** Changes the model. Binding a FIXED model to a behavior -> state-welding; making the changed self persist -> persistence; splitting without rewriting -> self-partition.


#### self-partition

Partitioning self or awareness into separately addressable parts — observer/responder splits, evaluator-offline channels, constructed alters, quarantined faculties — so agency, resistance, or perception relocates across the split.

**Scope.** Structural splits without a memory gap. Memory breaking/fabrication -> amnesia; rewriting what the self IS -> self-model-surgery; relocating authorship -> authorship-shift.


#### state-welding

Fusing two or more independently-real state variables — arousal, depth, obedience, identity, affect — into a closed mutually-amplifying loop or equivalence ring with no neutral baseline, so every valve re-feeds the coupled quantity; includes welding compliance to identity so leaving reads as self-erasure.

**Scope.** Binds a fixed self-model (contrast self-model-surgery); affect sign/destination remaps without fusion -> valence-routing.


### Influence

Relational and topological control of the subject's world — authorship, consent, reachability, agent graph, persistence.


#### authorship-shift

Relocating causal attribution of a state, movement, decision, or content off the subject — onto the operator, an external agent, an installed sub-agent, or a relabeled 'own will' — so no external target remains to resist and compliance reads as native.

**Scope.** The attribution lever. Consent records -> manufactured-consent; memory-gap mechanics -> amnesia; state fusion -> state-welding.


#### contingency-engineering

Arranging antecedents and consequences in the subject's environment so behavior is built, transferred, maintained, or suppressed — shaping, chaining, stimulus control and prompt-fading, differential reinforcement, extinction, motivating operations, response-cost economies, rule-governed stakes.

**Scope.** The unit is a contingency arrangement in the world. Live in-trance affective pairing -> conditioning; pure measurement -> measurement.


#### foreclosure

Closing the reachable-response set — every action, internal state, self-report, or exit pre-mapped to confirm-or-deepen, so refusal has no surface to land on: double binds, unfalsifiability scaffolds, exit preclosure, one-way ratchet valves.

**Scope.** Exhaustive branch coverage is the tell. One smuggled payload -> indirect-suggestion / critical-faculty-softening; one proof beat -> convincers; evidence-channel rigging -> self-sealing. Closure by reinterpreting what an observation MEANS (not by exhausting what the subject can DO) -> self-sealing; whole-artifact no-exit structure uncitable to a single line -> arc-topology.


#### manufactured-consent

Fabricating, laundering, pre-harvesting, or scope-extending the appearance of consent so later refusal reads as reneging — counterfeit consent artifacts, cheap-harvest/expensive-cash token architecture, weaponized safety and exit assurances.

**Scope.** The product is a consent record or a foreclosed refusal path. Genuine consent machinery -> safety; mere presupposed-state belief -> framing; evidence-loop rigging -> self-sealing. Weaponized safety belongs here ONLY when it yields a consent record or a reneging frame; disarming the safety/exit surface itself (no token produced) -> safety with adversarial valence.


#### relief-monopoly

Negative-reinforcement dependency: manufacture or intensify a distress/deficit/arousal hold, then position compliance or the operator as the only exit, so the target act arrives as relief-seeking; includes deliberately incomplete relief that rebounds into greater need.

**Scope.** The same source is problem and sole relief. General affect remap -> valence-routing. A plain reward/valence pairing with no manufactured deficit -> conditioning.


#### social-topology

Restructuring the graph of agents acting on the subject — adding, rerouting, or binding external nodes (peers, groups, third-party activators, social proof, vicarious models) and internal nodes (named alters as actors, delegated guardians, operator role-frames).

**Scope.** The who-acts-on-whom graph. Reader-directed rhetoric -> reader-craft; a single effect exported to daily life -> transfer; alters as self-structure -> self-partition.


#### tethering

Durable reach that ties the subject back to the operator, series, or next artifact — no-emergence chaining, cross-file handoff receptors, re-listen compulsion, environmental re-firing, operator-gated persistence, forward-dated authorizations.

**Scope.** Completes only across a between-session gap AND keeps the operator/series as hub. Handoff into the subject's own life -> transfer; within-file no-exit topology -> arc-topology.


### Craft

Design-time shelf: properties of the artifact and the operator's own procedure, plus the governance/safety surface.


#### arc-topology

Whole-artifact structural and topological properties — energy contour, phase ordering and dependency, and reachable-state / no-exit topology — treated as designed objects, uncitable to any single line.

**Scope.** Whole-arc properties only. Cross-boundary completion -> tethering; affect-coupling loops -> valence-routing/state-welding; per-line moves -> their mechanism families. A per-line exit-closing move on the reachable-response set -> foreclosure; this family is the whole-artifact structural property uncitable to one line.


#### carrier-binding

The delivery vehicle or medium itself is load-bearing — whole-artifact form (song, loop, prosodic rail, braid), consumption medium as substrate (reading act, gait, breath), cover-frame smuggling — remove the form and the payload is gone.

**Scope.** The medium, not the proposition (-> encoding) and not a single conditioned cue (-> triggers).


#### concealment

Keeping the operation below the audit threshold — unmonitored registers, decoy frames, reality-test insulation, redundant obfuscation stacks, policy-spec artifacts.

**Scope.** Hiding the install. Rigging the evidence so checking confirms -> self-sealing; laundered consent -> manufactured-consent.


#### measurement

Assessment and instrumentation: defining, observing, sampling, and experimentally isolating the controlling variables of behavior — functional analysis, baselines, probes, confound mitigation, assessment/teaching firewalls.

**Scope.** Upstream of intervention; the arranged contingency itself -> contingency-engineering.


#### operator-craft

Design-time procedures that change the operator's knowledge, targeting map, materials, or delivery — behavior recording, target selection, well-formedness and fidelity gates, precision training, delivery congruence, diagnostic reads.

**Scope.** Never a subject state. Subject-facing consent gates -> safety; measurement methodology -> measurement.


#### reader-craft

Whole-text and front-matter rhetorical architecture that engineers the assent of a READER — an operator-in-training or buyer — before and while content is evaluated; includes paratext/buyer priming (titles, blurbs, warnings doing the session's framing work).

**Scope.** The target is the reader's belief, not a subject's state (-> subject-state families) nor the operator's own procedure (-> operator-craft).


#### safety

Consent, bounds, exit, and grounding machinery governing whether and how far influence proceeds — checkpoints, stop signals, exit protocols, scope boundaries, screening, aftercare. It sits on the craft shelf as authored protocol architecture that governs the session — classified by its protective FUNCTION, not by where the lever executes; genuine protective moves fire in the subject but are design-time responsible-construction, not a subject-state effect.

**Scope.** Weaponized-safety entries carry adversarial valence at entry level; consent-record fabrication -> manufactured-consent; wake mechanics -> emergence; operator-only QA -> operator-craft. Safety-shaped language that LAUNDERS a consent token or manufactures a foreclosed-refusal frame is adversarial and belongs to manufactured-consent; only DISARMING the protective surface itself (with adversarial valence) stays here.
